ityevaṃ ghoṣayantaśca garjantaśca plavaṅgamāḥ .abhyadhāvanta laṅkāyāḥ prākāraṃ kāmarūpiṇaḥ .. 6.42.21 ....
vīrabāhuḥ subāhuśca nalaśca vanagocaraḥ .nipīḍyopaniviṣṭāste prākāraṃ hariyūthapāḥ .etasminnantare cakruḥ skandhāvāraniveśanam .. 6.42.22 ....
pūrvadvāraṃ tu kumudaḥ koṭībhirdaśabhirvṛtaḥ .āvṛtya balavāṃstasthau haribhirjitakāśibhiḥ .. 6.42.23 ....
sāhāyyārthaṃ tu tasyaiva niviṣṭaḥ praghaso hariḥ .panasaśca mahābāhurvānarairbahubhirvṛtaḥ .. 6.42.24 ....
dakṣiṇaṃ dvāramāgamya vīraḥ śatavaliḥ kapiḥ .āvṛtya balavāṃstasthau viṃśatyā koṭibhirvṛtaḥ .. 6.42.25 ....
suṣeṇaḥ paścimadvāraṃ gatastārāpitā hariḥ .āvṛtya balavāṃstasthau ṣaṣṭikoṭibhirāvṛtaḥ .. 6.42.26 ....
uttaraṃ dvāramāsādya rāmaḥ saumitriṇā saha .āvṛtya balavāṃstasthau sugrīvaśca harīśvaraḥ .. 6.42.27 ....
golāṅgūlo mahākāyo gavākṣo bhīmadarśanaḥ .vṛtaḥ koṭyā mahāvīryastasthau rāmasya pārśvataḥ .. 6.42.28 ....
ṛkṣāṇāṃ bhīmavegānāṃ dhūmraḥ śatrunibarhaṇaḥ .vṛtaḥ koṭyā mahāvīryastastho rāmasya pārśvataḥ .. 6.42.29 ....
sannaddhastu mahāvīryo gadāpāṇirvibhīṣaṇaḥ .vṛto yattaistu sacivaistasthau tatra mahābalaḥ .. 6.42.30 ....
gajo gavākṣo gavayaḥ śarabho gandhamādanaḥ .samantāt paridhāvanto rarakṣurharivāhinīm .. 6.42.31 ....
tataḥ kopaparītātmā rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ .niryāṇaṃ sarvasainyānāṃ drutamājñāpayattadā .. 6.42.32 ....
etacchutvā tato vākyaṃ rāvaṇasya mukhodgatam .sahasā bhīmanirghoṣamudghuṣṭaṃ rajanīcaraiḥ .. 6.42.33 ....
tataḥ pracoditā bheryaścandrapāṇḍarapuṣkarāḥ .hemakoṇāhatā bhīmā rākṣasānāṃ samantataḥ .. 6.42.34 ....
vineduśca mahāghoṣāḥ śaṅkhāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ .rākṣasānāṃ sughorāṇāṃ mukhamārutapūritāḥ .. 6.42.35 ....
te babhuḥ śubhanīlāṅgāḥ saśaṅkā rajanīcarāḥ .vidyunmaṇḍalasannaddhāḥ sabalākā ivāmbudāḥ .. 6.42.36 ....
niṣpatanti tataḥ sainyā hṛṣṭā rāvaṇacoditāḥ .samaye pūryamāṇasya vegā iva mahodadheḥ .. 6.42.37 ....
tato vānarasainyena mukto nādaḥ samantataḥ .malayaḥ pūrito yena sa sānuprasthakandaraḥ .. 6.42.38 ....
śaṅkhadundubhisaṅghuṣṭaḥ siṃhanādastarasvinām .pṛthivīṃ cāntarikṣaṃ ca sāgaraṃ caiva nādayan .. 6.42.39 ....
gajānāṃ bṛṃhitaiḥ sārdhaṃ hayānāṃ heṣitairapi .rathānāṃ nemighoṣaiśca rakṣasāṃ vadanasvanaḥ .. 6.42.40 ....
etasminnantare ghoraḥ saṅgrāmaḥ samavartata .rakṣasāṃ vānarāṇāṃ ca yathā devāsure purā .. 6.42.41 ....
te gadābhiḥ pradīptābhiḥ śaktiśūlaparaśvadhaiḥ .nijaghnurvānarān ghorāḥ kathayantaḥ svavikramān .. 6.42.42 ....
rājā jayati sugrīva iti śabdo mahānabhūt .. 6.42.43 ....
rājan jaya jayetyuktvā svasvanāmakathāntataḥ .tathā vṛkṣairmahākāyāḥ parvatāgraiśca vānarāḥ .nijaghnustāni rakṣāṃsi nakhairdantaiśca vegitāḥ .. 6.42.44 ....
rākṣasāstvapare bhīmāḥ prākārasthā mahīgatān .bhindipālaiśca khaḍgaiśca śūlaiścaiva vyadārayan .. 6.42.45 ....
vānarāścāpi saṅkruddhāḥ prākārasthān mahīgatāḥ .rākṣasān pātayāmāsuḥ samāplutya plavaṅgamāḥ .. 6.42.46 ....
sa samprahārastumulo māṃsaśoṇitakardamaḥ .rakṣasāṃ vānarāṇāṃ ca sambabhūvādbhutopamaḥ .. 6.42.47 ..
yuddhyātāṃ tu tatasteṣāṃ vānarāṇāṃ mahātmanām .rakṣasāṃ sambabhūvātha balakopaḥ sudāruṇaḥ .. 6.43.1 ....
te hayaiḥ kāñcanāpīḍairdhvajaiścāgniśikhopamaiḥ .rathaiścādityasaṅkāśaiḥ kavacaiśca manoramaiḥ .. 6.43.2 ....
niryayū rākṣasavyāghrā nādayanto diśo daśa .rākṣasā bhīmakarmāṇo rāvaṇasya jayaiṣiṇaḥ .. 6.43.3 ....
vānarāṇāmapi camūrbṛhatī jayamicchatām .abhyadhāvata tāṃ senāṃ rakṣasāṃ kāmarūpiṇām .. 6.43.4 ....
etasminnantare teṣāmanyonyamabhidhāvatām .rakṣasāṃ vānarāṇāṃ ca dvandvayuddhamavartata .. 6.43.5 ....
aṅgadenendrajit sārdhaṃ vāliputreṇa rākṣasaḥ .ayudhyata mahātejāstryambakeṇa yathā 'ntakaḥ .. 6.43.6 ....
prajaṅghena ca sampātirnityaṃ durmarṣaṇo raṇe .jambumālinamārabdho hanumānapi vānaraḥ .. 6.43.7 ....
saṅgataḥ sumahākrodho rākṣaso rāvaṇānujaḥ .samare tīkṣṇavegena mitraghnena vibhīṣaṇaḥ .. 6.43.8 ....
tapanena gajaḥ sārdhaṃ rākṣasena mahābalaḥ .nikumbhena mahātejā nīlo 'pi samayuddhyata .. 6.43.9 ....
vānarendrastu sugrīvaḥ praghasena samāgataḥ .saṅgataḥ samare śrīmān virūpākṣeṇa lakṣmaṇaḥ .. 6.43.10 ....
āgniketuśca durdharṣo raśmiketuśca rākṣasaḥ .suptaghno yajñakopaśca rāmeṇa saha saṅgatāḥ .. 6.43.11 ....
vajramuṣṭistu maindena dvividānaśaniprabhaḥ .rākṣasābhyāṃ sughorābhyāṃ kapimukhyau samāgatau .. 6.43.12 ....
vīraḥ pratapano ghoro rākṣaso raṇadurdharaḥ .samare tīkṣṇavegena nalena samayuddhyata .. 6.43.13 ....
dharmasya putro balavān suṣeṇa iti viśrutaḥ .sa vidyunmālinā sārdhamayudhyata mahākapiḥ .. 6.43.14 ....
vānarāścāpare bhīmā rākṣasairaparaiḥ saha .dvandvaṃ samīyurbahudhā yuddhāya bahubhiḥ saha .. 6.43.15 ....
tatrāsīt sumahadyuddhaṃ tumulaṃ romaharṣaṇam .rakṣasāṃ vānarāṇāṃ ca vīrāṇāṃ jayamicchatām .. 6.43.16 ....
harirākṣasadehebhyaḥ prabhṛtāḥ keśaśādvalāḥ .śarīrasaṅghāṭavahāḥ prasasruḥ śoṇitāpagāḥ .. 6.43.17 ....
ājaghānendrajit kruddho vajreṇeva śatakratuḥ .aṅgadaṃ gadayā vīraṃ śatrusainyavidāraṇam .. 6.43.18 ....
tasya kāñcanacitrāṅgaṃ rathaṃ sāśvaṃ sasārathim .jaghāna samare śrīmānaṅgado vegavān kapiḥ .. 6.43.19 ....
sampātistu tribhirbāṇaiḥ prajaṅghena samāhataḥ .nijaghānāśvakarṇena prajaṅghaṃ raṇamūrdhani .. 6.43.20 ....
jambumālī rathasthastu rathaśaktyā mahābalaḥ .bibheda samare kruddho hanūmantaṃ stanāntare .. 6.43.21 ....
tasya taṃ rathamāsthāya hanūmān mārutatmajaḥ .pramamātha talenāśu saha tenaiva rakṣasā .. 6.43.22 ....
nadan pratapano ghoro nalaṃ so 'pyanvadhāvata .. 6.43.23 ....
nalaḥ pratapanasyāśu pātayāmāsa cakṣuṣī .bhinnagātraḥ śaraistīkṣṇaiḥ kṣiprahastena rakṣasā .. 6.43.24 ....
grasantamiva sainyāni praghasaṃ vānarādhipaḥ .sugrīvaḥ saptaparṇena nirbibheda jaghāna ca .. 6.43.25 ....
agniketuśca durdharṣo raśmiketuśca rākṣasaḥ .suptaghno yajñakopaśca rāmaṃ nirbibhiduḥ śaraiḥ .. 6.43.26 ....
teṣāṃ caturṇāṃ rāmastu śirāṃsi niśitaiḥ śarai .kruddhaścaturbhiściccheda ghorairagniśikhopamaiḥ .. 6.43.27 ....
vajramuṣṭistu maindena muṣṭinā nihato raṇe .papāta sarathaḥ sāśvaḥ purāṭṭa iva bhūtale .. 6.43.28 ....
nikumbhastu raṇe nīlaṃ nīlāñjanacayaprabham .nirbibheda śaraistīkṣṇaiḥ karairmeghamivāṃśumān .. 6.43.29 ....
punaḥ śaraśatenātha kṣiprahasto niśācaraḥ .bibheda samare nīlaṃ nikumbhaḥ prajahāsa ca .. 6.43.30 ....
tasyaiva rathacakreṇa nīlo viṣṇurivāhave .śiraściccheda samare nikumbhasya ca sāratheḥ .. 6.43.31 ....
vajrāśanisamasparśo dvivido 'pyaśaniprabham .jaghāna giriśṛṅgeṇa miṣatāṃ sarvarakṣasām .. 6.43.32 ....
dvividaṃ vānarendraṃ tu nagayodhinamāhave .śarairaśani saṅkāśaiḥ sa vivyādhāśaniprabhaḥ .. 6.43.33 ....
sa śarairatividdhāṅgo dvividaḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ .sālena sarathaṃ sāśvaṃ nijaghānāśaniprabham .. 6.43.34 ....
vidyunmālī rathasthastu śaraiḥ kāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ .suṣeṇaṃ tāḍayāmāsa nanāda ca muhurmuhuḥ .. 6.43.35 ....
taṃ rathasthamatho dṛṣṭvā suṣeṇo vānarottamaḥ .giriśṛṅgeṇa mahatā rathamāśu nyapātayat .. 6.43.36 ....
lāghavena tu saṃyukto vidyunmālī niśācaraḥ .apakramya rathāttūrṇaṃ gadāpāṇiḥ kṣitau sthitaḥ .. 6.43.37 ....
tataḥ krodhasamāviṣṭaḥ suṣeṇo haripuṅgavaḥ .śilāṃ sumahatīṃ gṛhya niśācaramabhidravat .. 6.43.38 ....
tamāpatantaṃ gadayā vidyunmālī niśācaraḥ .vakṣasyabhijaghānāśu suṣeṇaṃ harisattamam .. 6.43.39 ....
gadāprahāraṃ taṃ ghoramacintya plavagottamaḥ .tāṃ śilāṃ pātayāmāsa tasyorasi mahāmṛdhe .. 6.43.40 ....
śilāprahārābhihato vidyunmālī niśācaraḥ .niṣpiṣṭahṛdayo bhūmau gatāsurnipapāta ha .. 6.43.41 ....
evaṃ tairvānaraiḥ śūraiḥ śūrāste rajanīcarāḥ .dvandve vimṛditāstatra daityā iva divaukasaiḥ .. 6.43.42 ....
nihataiḥ kuñjarairmattaistathā vānararākṣasaiḥ .cakrākṣayugadaṇḍaiśca bhagnairdharaṇisaṃśritaiḥ .babhūvāyodhanaṃ ghoraṃ gomāyugaṇasaṅkulam .. 6.43.43 ....
kabandhāni samutpeturdikṣu vānararakṣasām .vimarde tumule tasmin devāsuraraṇopame .. 6.43.44 ....
vidāryamāṇā haripuṅgavaistadā niśācarāḥ śoṇitadigdhagātrāḥ .punaḥ suyuddhaṃ tarasā samāsthitā divākarasyāstamayābhikāṅkṣiṇaḥ .. 6.43.45 ..
yuddhyatāmeva teṣāṃ tu tadā vānararakṣasām .ravirastaṃ gato rātriḥ pravṛttā prāṇahāriṇī .. 6.44.1 ....
anyonyaṃ baddhavairāṇāṃ ghorāṇāṃ jayamicchatām .sampravṛttaṃ niśāyuddhaṃ tadā vānararakṣasām .. 6.44.2 ....
rākṣaso 'sīti harayo hariścāsīti rākṣasāḥ .anyonyaṃ samare jaghnustasmiṃstamasi dāruṇe .. 6.44.3 ....
jahi dāraya caihīti kathaṃ vidravasīti ca .evaṃ sutumulaḥ śabdastasmiṃstamasi śuśruve .. 6.44.4 ....
kālāḥ kāñcanasannāhāstasmiṃstamasi rākṣasāḥ .samprādṛśyanta śailendrā dīptauṣadhivanā iva .. 6.44.5 ....
tasmiṃstamasi duṣpāre rākṣasāḥ krodhamūrcchitāḥ .paripeturmahāvegā bhakṣayantaḥ plavaṅgamān .. 6.44.6 ....
te hayān kāñcanāpīḍān dhvajāṃścāgniśikhopamān .āplutya daśanaistīkṣṇairbhīmakopā vyadārayan .. 6.44.7 ....
vānarā balino yuddhe 'kṣobhayan rākṣasīṃ camūm .kuñjarān kuñjarārohān patākādhvajino sthān .cakarṣuśca dadaṃśuśca daśanaiḥ krodhamūrcchitāḥ .. 6.44.8 ....
lakṣmaṇaścāpi rāmaśca śarairāśīviṣopamaiḥ .dṛśyādṛśyāni rakṣāṃsi pravarāṇi nijaghnatuḥ .. 6.44.9 ....
turaṅgakhuravidhvastaṃ rathanemisamutthitam .rurodha karṇanetrāṇi yuddhyatāṃ dharaṇīrajaḥ .. 6.44.10 ....
vartamāne mahāghore saṅgrāme romaharṣaṇe .rudhirodā mahāghorā nadyastatra prasusruvuḥ .. 6.44.11 ....
tato bherīmṛdaṅgānāṃ paṇavānāṃ ca nisvanaḥ .śaṅkhaveṇusvanonmiśraḥ sambabhūvādbhutopamaḥ .. 6.44.12 ....
hatānāṃ stanamānānāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca nisvanaḥ .śastānāṃ vānarāṇāṃ ca sambabhūvātidāruṇaḥ .. 6.44.13 ....
hatairvānaravīraiśca śaktiśūlaparaśvadhaiḥ .nihataiḥ parvatāgraiśca rākṣasaiḥ kāmarūpibhiḥ .. 6.44.14 ....
śastrapuṣpopahārā ca tatrāsīdyuddhamedinī .durjñeyā durniveśā ca śoṇitāsrāvakardamā .. 6.44.15 ....
sā babhūva niśā ghorā harirākṣasahāriṇī .kālarātrīva bhūtānāṃ sarveṣāṃ duratikramā .. 6.44.16 ....
tataste rākṣasāstatra tasmiṃstamasi dāruṇe .rāmamevābhyavartanta saṃsṛṣṭāḥ śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ .. 6.44.17 ....
teṣāmāpatatāṃ śabdaḥ kruddhānāmapi garjatām .udvarta iva saptānāṃ samudrāṇāṃ praśuśruve .. 6.44.18 ....
teṣāṃ rāmaḥ śaraiṣṣaṅbhiṣṣaḍ jaghāna niśācarān .nimeṣāntaramātreṇa śitairagniśikhopamaiḥ .. 6.44.19 ....
yamaśatruśca durdharṣo mahāpārśvamahodarau .vajradaṃṣṭro mahākāyastau cobhau śukasāraṇau .. 6.44.20 ....
te tu rāmeṇa bāṇaughaiḥ sarve marmasu tāḍitāḥ .yuddhādapasṛtāstatra sāvaśeṣāyuṣo 'bhavan .. 6.44.21 ....
tatra kāñcanacitrāṅgaiḥ śarairagniśikhopamaiḥ .diśaścakāra vimalāḥ pradiśaśca mahābalaḥ .. 6.44.22 ....
ye tvanye rākṣasā bhīmā rāmasyābhimukhe sthitāḥ .te 'pi naṣṭāḥ samāsādya pataṅga iva pāvakam .. 6.44.23 ....
suvarṇapuṅkhairviśikhaiḥ sampatadbhiḥ sahasraśaḥ .babhūva rajanī citrā khadyotairiva śāradī .. 6.44.24 ....
rākṣasānāṃ ca ninadairharīṇāṃ cāpi nisvanaiḥ .sā babhūva niśā ghorā bhūyo ghoratarā tadā .. 6.44.25 ....
tena śabdena mahatā pravṛddhena samantataḥ .trikūṭaḥ kandarākīrṇaḥ pravyāharadivācalaḥ .. 6.44.26 ....
golāṅgūlā mahākāyāstamasā tulyavarcasaḥ .sampariṣvajya bāhubhyāṃ bhakṣayan rajanīcarān .. 6.44.27 ....
aṅgadastu raṇe śatruṃ nihantuṃ samupasthitaḥ .rāvaṇiṃ nijaghānāśu sārathiṃ ca hayānapi .. 6.44.28 ....
vartamāne tadā ghore saṅgrāme bhṛśadāruṇe .indrajittu rathaṃ tyaktvā hatāśvo hatasārathiḥ .aṅgadena mahākāyastatraivāntaradhīyata .. 6.44.29 ....
tatkarma vāliputrasya sarve devāḥ saharṣibhiḥ .tuṣṭuvuḥ pūjanārhasya tau cobhau rāmalakṣmaṇau .. 6.44.30 ....
prabhāvaṃ sarvabhūtāni vidurindrajito yudhi .tena te taṃ mahātmānaṃ tuṣṭā dṛṣṭvā pradharṣitam .. 6.44.31 ....
tataḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ kapayaḥ sasugrīvavibhīṣaṇāḥ .sādhu sādhviti neduśca dṛṣṭvā śatruṃ pradharṣitam .. 6.44.32 ....
indrajittu tadā tena nirjito bhīmakarmaṇā .saṃyuge vāliputreṇa krodhaṃ cakre sudāruṇam .. 6.44.33 ....
etasminnantare rāmo vānarān vākyamabravīt .. 6.44.34 ....
sarve bhavantastiṣṭhantu kapirājena saṅgatāḥ .. 6.44.35 ....
sa brahmaṇā dattavarastrailokyaṃ bādhate bhṛśam .bhavatāmarthasiddhyarthaṃ kālena sa samāgataḥ .adyaiva kṣamitavyaṃ me bhavanto vigatajvarāḥ .. 6.44.36 ....
so 'ntardhānagataḥ pāpo rāvaṇī raṇakarkaśaḥ .adṛśyo niśitān bāṇān mumocāśanivarcasaḥ .. 6.44.37 ....
sa rāmaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ caiva ghorairnāgamayaiḥ śaraiḥ .bibheda samare kruddhaḥ sarvagātreṣu rākṣasaḥ .. 6.44.38 ....
māyayā saṃvṛtastatra mohayan rāghavau yudhi .adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ kūṭayodhī niśācaraḥ .babandha śarabandhena bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau .. 6.44.39 ....
tau tena puruṣavyāghrau kruddhenāśīviṣaiḥ śaraiḥ .sahasā nihatau vīrau tadā praikṣanta vānarāḥ .. 6.44.40 ....
prakāśarūpastu yadā na śaktastau bādhituṃ rākṣasarājaputraḥ .māyāṃ prayoktuṃ samupājagāma babandha tau rājasutau mahātmā .. 6.44.41 ..
sa tasya gatimanvicchan rājaputraḥ pratāpavān .dideśātibalo rāmo daśa vānarayūthapān .. 6.45.1 ....
dvau suṣeṇasya dāyādau nīlaṃ ca plavagarṣabham .aṅgadaṃ vāliputraṃ ca śarabhaṃ ca tarasvinam .. 6.45.2 ....
vinataṃ jāmbavantaṃ ca sānuprasthaṃ mahābalam .ṛṣabhaṃ carṣabhaskandhamādideśa parantapaḥ .. 6.45.3 ....
te samprahṛṣṭā harayo bhīmānudyamya pādapān .ākāśaṃ viviśuḥ sarve mārgamāṇā diśo daśa .. 6.45.4 ....
teṣāṃ vegavatāṃ vegamiṣubhirvegavattaraiḥ .astravit paramāstraistu vārayāmāsa rāvaṇiḥ .. 6.45.5 ....
taṃ bhīmavegā harayo nārācaiḥ kṣatavigrahāḥ .andhakāre na dadṛśurmeghaiḥ sūryamivāvṛtam .. 6.45.6 ....
rāmalakṣmaṇayoreva sarvadehabhidaḥ śarān .bhṛśamāveśayāmāsa rāvaṇiḥ samitiñjayaḥ .. 6.45.7 ....
nirantaraśarīrau tau bhrātarau rāmalakṣṇau .kruddhenendrajitā vīrau pannagaiḥ śaratāṃ gataiḥ .. 6.45.8 ....
tayoḥ kṣatajamārgeṇa susrāva rudhiraṃ bahu .tāvubhau ca prakāśete puṣpitāviva kiṃśukau .. 6.45.9 ....
tataḥ paryantaraktākṣo bhinnāñjanacayopamaḥ .rāvaṇirbhrātarau vākyamantardhānagato 'bravīt .. 6.45.10 ....
yuddhyamānamanālakṣyaṃ śakro 'pi tridaśeśvaraḥ .draṣṭumāsādituṃ vāpi na śaktaḥ kiṃ punaryuvām .. 6.45.11 ....

sa niryāto mahāvīryo dhūmrākṣo rākṣasairvṛtaḥ .prahasan paścimadvāraṃ hanūmān yatra yūthapaḥ .rathapravaramāsthāya kharayuktaṃ kharasvanam .. 6.51.29 ....

vavarṣa rudhiraṃ devaḥ sañcacāla ca medinī .pratilobhaṃ vavau vāyurnirghātasamanisvanaḥ .. 6.51.33 ....
timiraughāvṛtāstatra diśaśca na cakāśire .. 6.51.34 ....
sa tūtpātāṃstadā dṛṣṭvā rākṣasānāṃ bhayāvahān .prādurbhūtān sughorāṃśca dhūmrākṣo vyathito 'bhavat .. 6.51.35 ....

tataḥ subhīmo bahubhirniśācarairvṛto 'bhiniṣkramya raṇotsuko balī .dadarśa tāṃ rāghavabāhupālitāṃ mahaughakalpāṃ bahuvānarīṃ camūm .. 6.51.37 ..
dhūmrākṣaṃ prekṣya niryāntaṃ rākṣasaṃ bhīmavikramam .vinedurvānarāḥ sarve prahṛṣṭā yuddhakāṅkṣiṇaḥ .. 6.52.1 ....
teṣāṃ sutumulaṃ yuddhaṃ sañjajñe harirakṣasām .anyonyaṃ pādapairghoraṃ nighnatāṃ śūlamudgaraiḥ .. 6.52.2 ....
ghoraiśca parighaiścitraistriśūlaiścāpi saṃhataiḥ .rākṣasairvānarā ghorairvinikṛttāḥ samantataḥ .. 6.52.3 ....
vānarai rākṣasāścāpi drumairbhūmau samīkṛtāḥ .rākṣasāścāpi saṅkruddhā vānarānniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ .vivyadhurghorasaṅkāśaiḥ kaṅkapatrairajihmagaiḥ .. 6.52.4 ....
te gadābhiśca bhīmābhiḥ paṭṭiśaiḥ kūṭamudgaraiḥ .. 6.52.5 ..ścāpi saṅkruddhā vānarānniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ...
vidāryamāṇā rakṣobhirvānarāste mahābalāḥ .amarṣājjanitoddharṣāścakruḥ karmāṇyabhītavat .. 6.52.6 ....
śaranirbhinnagātrāste śūlanirbhinnadehinaḥ .jagṛhuste drumāṃstatra śilāśca hariyūthapāḥ .. 6.52.7 ....

rākṣasā mathitāḥ kecidvānarairjitakāśibhiḥ .vavamū rudhiraṃ kecinmukhai rudhirabhojanāḥ .. 6.52.10 ....
pārśveṣu dāritāḥ kecit kecidrāśīkṛtā drumaiḥ .śilābhiścūrṇitāḥ kecit keciddantairvidāritāḥ .. 6.52.11 ....
dhvajairvimathitairbhagnaiḥ kharaiśca vinipātitaiḥ .rathairvidhvaṃsitaiścāpi patitai rajanīcaraiḥ .. 6.52.12 ....

sainyaṃ tu vidrutaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhūmrākṣo rākṣasarṣabhaḥ .krodhena kadanaṃ cakre vānarāṇāṃ yuyutsatām .. 6.52.18 ....
prāsaiḥ pramathitāḥ kecidvānarāḥ śoṇitasravāḥ .mudgarairāhatāḥ kecit patitā dharaṇītale .. 6.52.19 ....

tatsubhīmaṃ mahāyuddhaṃ harirākṣasasaṅkulam .prababhau śabdabahulaṃ śilāpādapasaṅkulam .. 6.52.23 ....
dhanurjyātantrimadhuraṃ hikkātālasamanvitam .mandastanitasaṅgītaṃ yuddhagāndharvamābabhau .. 6.52.24 ....
dhūmrākṣastu dhanuṣpāṇirvānarān raṇamūrdhani .hasan vidrāvayāmāsa diśastu śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ .. 6.52.25 ....
dhūmrākṣeṇārditaṃ sainyaṃ vyathitaṃ dṛśya mārutiḥ .abhyavartata saṅkruddhaḥ pragṛhya vipulāṃ śilām .. 6.52.26 ....
krodhāddviguṇatāmrākṣaḥ pitṛtulyaparākramaḥ .śilāṃ tāṃ pātayāmāsa dhūmrākṣasya rathaṃ prati .. 6.52.27 ....
āpatantīṃ śilāṃ dṛṣṭvā gadāmudyamya sambhramāt .rathādāplutya vegena vasudhāyāṃ vyatiṣṭhata .. 6.52.28 ....
sā pramathya rathaṃ tasya nipapāta śilā bhuvi .sacakrakūbaraṃ sāśvaṃ sadhvajaṃ saśarāsanam .. 6.52.29 ....
sa bhaṅktvā tu rathaṃ tasya hanumān mārutātmajaḥ .rakṣasāṃ kadanaṃ cakre saskandhaviṭapairdrumaiḥ .. 6.52.30 ....
vibhinnaśiraso bhūtvā rākṣasāḥ śoṇitokṣitāḥ .drumaiḥ pravyathitāścānye nipeturdharaṇītale .. 6.52.31 ....
vidrāvya rāsakṣaṃ sainyaṃ hanumān mārutātmajaḥ .gireḥ śikharamādāya dhūmrākṣamabhidudruve .. 6.52.32 ....
tamāpatantaṃ dhūmrākṣo gadāmudyamya vīryavān .vinardamānaḥ sahasā hanumantamabhidravat .. 6.52.33 ....
tataḥ kruddhastu vegena gadāṃ tāṃ bahukaṇṭakām .pātayāmāsa dhūmrākṣo mastake tu hanūmataḥ .. 6.52.34 ....
tāḍitaḥ sa tayā tatra gadayā bhīmarūpayā .. 6.52.35 ....
sa kapirmārutabalastaṃ prahāramacintayan .dhūmrākṣasya śiromadhye giriśṛṅgamapātayat .. 6.52.36 ....

dhūmrākṣaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭavā hataśeṣā niśācarāḥ .trastāḥ praviviśurlaṅkāṃ vadhyamānāḥ plavaṅgamaiḥ .. 6.52.38 ....
sa tu pavanasuto nihatya śatruṃ kṣatajavahāḥ saritaśca sannikīrya .ripuvadhajanitaśramo mahātmā mudamagamat kapibhiśca pūjyamānaḥ .. 6.52.39 ..
dhūmrākṣaṃ nihataṃ śrutvā rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ .krodhena mahatā ' 'viṣṭo niśvasannurago yathā .. 6.53.1 ....
dīrghamuṣṇaṃ viniśvasya krodhena kaluṣīkṛtaḥ .abravīdrākṣasaṃ śūraṃ vajradaṃṣṭraṃ mahābalam .. 6.53.2 ....
gaccha tvaṃ vīra niryāhi rākṣasaiḥ parivāritaḥ .jahi dāśarathiṃ rāmaṃ sugrīvaṃ vānaraiḥ saha .. 6.53.3 ....
tathetyuktvā drutataraṃ māyāvī rākṣaseśvaraḥ .nirjagāma balai sārdhaṃ bahubhiḥ parivāritaḥ .. 6.53.4 ....
nāgairaśvaiḥ kharairuṣṭraiḥ saṃyuktaḥ susāmāhitaḥ .patākādhvajacitraiśca rathaiśca samalaṅkṛtaḥ .. 6.53.5 ....
tato vicitrakeyūramukuṭaiśca vibhūṣitaḥ .tanutrāṇi ca saṃruddhya sadhanurniryayau drutam .. 6.53.6 ....
patākālaṅkṛtaṃ dīptaṃ taptakāñcanabhūṣaṇam .rathaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā samārohaccamūpatiḥ .. 6.53.7 ....
yaṣṭibhistomaraiścitraiḥ śūlaiśca musalairapi .bhindipālaiśca pāśaiśca śaktibhiḥ paṭṭiśairapi .. 6.53.8 ....
khaḍgaiścakrairgadābhiśca niśitaiśca paraśvadhaiḥ .padātayaśca niryānti vividhāḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ .vicitravāsasaḥ sarve dīptā rākṣasapuṅgavāḥ .. 6.53.9 ....
gajā madotkaṭāḥ śūrāścalanta iva parvatāḥ .te yuddhakuśalai rūḍhāstomarāṅkuśapāṇibhiḥ .. 6.53.10 ....
anye lakṣaṇasaṃyuktāḥ śūrārūḍhā mahābalāḥ .. 6.53.11 ....
tadrākṣasabalaṃ ghoraṃ viprasthitamaśobhata .prāvṛṭkāle yathā meghā nardamānāḥ savidyutaḥ .. 6.53.12 ....
nissṛtā dakṣiṇadvārādaṅgado yatra yūthapaḥ .teṣāṃ niṣkramamāṇānāmaśubhaṃ samajāyata .. 6.53.13 ....
ākāśādvighanāttīvrā ulkāścābhyapataṃstadā .vamantyaḥ pāvakajvālāḥ śivā ghoraṃ vavāśire .. 6.53.14 ....
vyāharanti mṛgā ghorā rakṣasāṃ nidhanaṃ tadā .samāpatanto yodhāstu prāskhalan bhayamohitāḥ .. 6.53.15 ....
etānautpātikān dṛṣṭvā vajradaṃṣṭro mahābalaḥ .dhairyamālambya tejasvī nirjagāma raṇotsukaḥ .. 6.53.16 ....
tāṃstu niṣkramato dṛṣṭvā vānarā jitakāśinaḥ .praṇeduḥ sumahānādān pūrayaṃśca diśo daśa .. 6.53.17 ....
tataḥ pravṛttaṃ tumulaṃ harīṇāṃ rākṣasaiḥ saha .ghorāṇāṃ bhīmarūpāṇāmanyonyavadhakāṅkṣiṇām .. 6.53.18 ....
niṣpatanto mahotsāhā bhinnadehaśirodharāḥ .rudhirokṣitasarvāṅgā nyapatan jagatītale .. 6.53.19 ....
kecidanyonyamāsādya śūrāḥ parighapāṇayaḥ .cikṣipurvividhaṃ śastraṃ samareṣvanivartinaḥ .. 6.53.20 ....
drumāṇāṃ ca śilānāṃ ca śastrāṇāṃ cāpi nisvanaḥ .śrūyate sumahāṃstatra ghoro hṛdayabhedanaḥ .. 6.53.21 ....
rathanemisvanastatra dhanuṣaścāpi nisvanaḥ .śaṅkhabherīmṛdaṅgānāṃ babhūva tumulaḥ svanaḥ .. 6.53.22 ....
kecidastrāṇi saṃsṛjya bāhuyuddhamakurvata .. 6.53.23 ....
talaiśca caraṇaiścāpi muṣṭibhiśca drumairapi .jānubhiśca hatāḥ kecidbhinnadehāśca rākṣasāḥ .śilābhiścūrṇitāḥ kecidvānarairyuddhadurmadaiḥ .. 6.53.24 ....
vajradaṃṣṭro bhṛśaṃ bāṇai raṇe vitrāsayan harīn .cacāra lokasaṃhāre pāśahasta ivāntakaḥ .. 6.53.25 ....
balavanto 'straviduṣo nānāpraharaṇā raṇe .jaghnurvānarasainyāni rākṣasāḥ krodhamūrcchitāḥ .. 6.53.26 ....
nighnuto rākṣasān dṛṣṭvā sarvān vālisuto raṇe .krodhena dviguṇāviṣṭaḥ saṃvartaka ivānalaḥ .. 6.53.27 ....
tān rākṣasagaṇān sarvān vṛkṣamudyamya vīryavān .aṅgadaḥ krodhatāmrākṣaḥ siṃhaḥ kṣudramṛgāniva .cakāra kadanaṃ ghoraṃ śakratulyaparākramaḥ .. 6.53.28 ....
aṅgadābhihatāstatra rākṣasā bhīmavikramāḥ .vibhinnaśirasaḥ peturvikṛttā iva pādapāḥ .. 6.53.29 ..iva ...
rathairaśvairdhvajaiścitraiḥ śarīrairharirakṣasām .rudhireṇa ca sañchannā bhūmirbhayakarī tadā .. 6.53.30 ....
hārakeyūravastraiśca śastraiśca samalaṅkṛtā .bhūmirbhāti raṇe tatra śāradīva yathā niśā .. 6.53.31 ....
aṅgadasya ca vegena tadrākṣasabalaṃ mahat .prākampata tadā tatra pavanenāmbudo yathā .. 6.53.32 ..
balasya ca nighātena aṅgadasya jayena ca .rākṣasaḥ krodhamāviṣṭo vajradaṃṣṭro mahābalaḥ .. 6.54.1 ....
sa visphārya dhanurghoraṃ śakrāśanisamasvanam .vānarāṇāmanīkāni prākiraccharavṛṣṭibhiḥ .. 6.54.2 ....
rākṣasāścāpi mukhyāste ratheṣu samavasthitāḥ .nānāpraharaṇāḥ śūrāḥ prāyuddhyanta tadā raṇe .. 6.54.3 ....
vānarāṇāṃ tu śūrā ye sarve te plavagarṣabhāḥ .āyuddhyanta śilāhastāḥ samavetāḥ samantataḥ .. 6.54.4 ....
tatrāyudhasahasrāṇi tasminnāyodhane bhṛśam .rākṣasāḥ kapimukhyeṣu pātayāñcakrire tadā .. 6.54.5 ....
vānarāścāpi rakṣassu girīn vṛkṣān mahāśilāḥ .pravīrāḥ pātayāmāsurmattavāraṇasannibhāḥ .. 6.54.6 ....
śūrāṇāṃ yuddhyamānānāṃ samareṣvanivartinām .tadrākṣasagaṇānāṃ ca suyuddhaṃ samavartata .. 6.54.7 ....
prabhinnaśirasaḥ kecidbhinnaiḥ pādaiśca bāhubhiḥ .śastrairarpitadehāstu rudhireṇa samukṣitāḥ .. 6.54.8 ....
harayo rākṣasāścaiva śerate gāṃ samāśritāḥ .kaṅkagṛdhravalairāḍhyā gomāyugaṇasaṅkulāḥ .. 6.54.9 ....
kabandhāni samutpeturbhīruṇāṃ bhīṣaṇāni vai .. 6.54.10 ....
bhujapāṇiśiraśchinnāśchinnakāyāśca bhūtale .vānarā rākṣasāścāpi nipetustatra vai raṇe .. 6.54.11 ....
tato vānarasainyena hanyamānaṃ niśācaram .prābhajyata balaṃ sarvaṃ vajradaṃṣṭrasya paśyataḥ .. 6.54.12 ....
rākṣasān bhayavitrastān hanyamānān plavaṅgamaiḥ .dṛṣṭvā sa roṣatāmrākṣo vajradaṃṣṭraḥ pratāpavān .. 6.54.13 ....
praviveśa dhanuṣpāṇistrāsayan harivāhinīm .śarairvidārayāmāsa kaṅkapatrairajihmagaiḥ .. 6.54.14 ....
bibheda vānarāṃstatra saptāṣṭau nava pañca ca .vivyādha paramakruddho vajradaṃṣṭraḥ pratāpavān .. 6.54.15 ....
trastāḥ sarve harigaṇāḥ śaraiḥ saṅkṛttakandharāḥ .aṅgadaṃ sampradhāvanti prajāpatimiva prajāḥ .. 6.54.16 ....
tato harigaṇān bhagnān dṛṣṭvā vālisutastadā .krodhena vajradaṃṣṭraṃ tamudīkṣantamudaikṣata .. 6.54.17 ....
vajradaṃṣṭro 'ṅgadaścobhau saṅgatau harirākṣasau .ceratuḥ paramakruddhau harimattagajāviva .. 6.54.18 ....

dṛṣṭvā ' 'patantaṃ taṃ vṛkṣamasambhrāntaśca rākṣasaḥ .ciccheda bahudhā so 'pi nikṛttaḥ patito bhuvi .. 6.54.21 ....
taṃ dṛṣṭvā vajradaṃṣṭrasya vikramaṃ plavagarṣabhaḥ .pragṛhya vipulaṃ śailaṃ cikṣepa ca nanāda ca .. 6.54.22 ....
samāpatantaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā rathādāplutya vīryavān .gadāpāṇirasambhrāntaḥ pṛthivyāṃ samatiṣṭhata .. 6.54.23 ....
sā 'ṅgadena gadā ' 'kṣiptā gatvā tu raṇamūrdhani .. 6.54.24 ....
sacakrakūbaraṃ sāśvaṃ pramamātha rathaṃ tadā .. 6.54.25 ....
tato 'nyaṃ girimākṣipya vipulaṃ drumabhūṣitam .vajradaṃṣṭrasya śirasi pātayāmāsa so 'ṅgadaḥ .. 6.54.26 ....
abhavacchoṇitodgārī vajradaṃṣṭraḥ sa mūrcchitaḥ .muhūrtamabhavanmūḍho gadāmāliṅgya niḥśvasan .. 6.54.27 ....
sa labdhasañjño gadayā vāliputramavasthitam .jaghāna paramakruddho vakṣodeśe niśācaraḥ .gadāṃ tyaktvā tatastatra muṣṭiyuddhamavartata .. 6.54.28 ....
anyonyaṃ jaghnatustatra tāvubhau harirākṣasau .rudhirodgāriṇo tau tu praharairjanitaśramau .babhūvatuḥ suvikrāntāvaṅgārakabudhāviva .. 6.54.29 ....
tataḥ paramatejasvī aṅgadaḥ kapikuñjaraḥ .utpāṭya vṛkṣaṃ sthitavān bahupuṣpaphalāñcitam .. 6.54.30 ....
jagrāha cārṣabhaṃ carma khaḍgaṃ ca vipulaṃ śubham .kiṅkiṇījālasañchannaṃ carmaṇā ca pariṣkṛtam .. 6.54.31 ....
vicitrāṃśceraturmārgān ruṣitau kapirākṣasau .jaghnatuśca tadā 'nyonyaṃ nirdayaṃ jayakāṅkṣiṇau .. 6.54.32 ....
vraṇaiḥ sāstrairaśobhetāṃ puṣpitāviva kiṃśukau .yuddhyamānau pariśrāntau jānubhyāmavanīṃ gatau .. 6.54.33 ....
nimeṣāntaramātreṇa aṅgadaḥ kapikuñjaraḥ .udatiṣṭhata dīptākṣo daṇḍāhata ivoragaḥ .. 6.54.34 ....
nirmalena sudhautena khaḍgenāsya mahacchiraḥ .jaghāna vajradaṃṣṭrasya vālisūnurmahābalaḥ .. 6.54.35 ....
rudhirokṣitagātrasya babhūva patitaṃ dvidhā .saroṣaparivṛttākṣaṃ śubhaṃ khaḍgahataṃ śiraḥ .. 6.54.36 ....
vajradaṃṣṭraṃ hataṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasā bhayamohitāḥ .trastāḥ pratyapatan laṅkāṃ vadhyamānāḥ plavaṅgamai .viṣaṇṇavadanā dīnā hriyā kiñcidavāṅmukhāḥ .. 6.54.37 ....

śīghraṃ niryāntu durdharṣā rākṣasā bhīmavikramāḥ .akampanaṃ puraskṛtya sarvaśastraprakovidam .. 6.55.2 ....
eṣa śāstā ca goptā ca netā ca yudhi sammataḥ .bhūtikāmaśca me nityaṃ nityaṃ ca samarapriyaḥ .. 6.55.3 ....
eṣa jeṣyati kākutsthau sugrīvaṃ ca mahābalam .vānarāṃścāparān ghorān haniṣyati parantapaḥ .. 6.55.4 ....
parigṛhya sa tāmājñāṃ rāvaṇasya mahābalaḥ .balaṃ santvarayāmāsa tadā laghuparākramaḥ .. 6.55.5 ....
tato nānāpraharaṇā bhīmākṣā bhīmadarśanāḥ .niṣpetū rakṣasāṃ mukhyā balādhyakṣapracoditāḥ .. 6.55.6 ....
rathamāsthāya vipulaṃ taptakāñcanakuṇḍalaḥ .meghābho meghavarṇaśca meghasvanamahāsvanaḥ .rākṣasaiḥ saṃvṛto bhīmaistadā niryātyakampanaḥ .. 6.55.7 ....
na hi kampayituṃ śakyaḥ surairapi mahāmṛdhe .akampanastatasteṣāmāditya iva tejasā .. 6.55.8 ....
tasya nirdhāvamānasya saṃrabdhasya yuyatsayā .akasmāddainyamāgacchaddhayānāṃ rathavāhinām .. 6.55.9 ....
vyasphurannayanaṃ cāsya savyaṃ yuddhābhinandinaḥ .vivarṇo mukhavarṇaśca gadgadaścābhavat svanaḥ .. 6.55.10 ....
abhavat sudine cāpi durdinaṃ rūkṣamārutam .ūcuḥ khagā mṛgāḥ sarve vācaḥ krūrā bhayāvahāḥ .. 6.55.11 ....
sa siṃhopacitaskandhaḥ śārdūlasamavikramaḥ .tānutpātānacintyaiva nirjagāma raṇājiram .. 6.55.12 ....
tadā nirgacchatastasya rakṣasaḥ saha rākṣasaiḥ .babhūva sumahānnādaḥ kṣobhayanniva sāgaram .. 6.55.13 ....
tena śabdena vitrastā vānarāṇāṃ mahācamūḥ .drumaśailapraharaṇā yoddhuṃ samavatiṣṭhata .. 6.55.14 ....
teṣāṃ yuddhaṃ mahāraudraṃ sañjajñe harirakṣasām .rāmarāvaṇayorarthe samabhityaktajīvinām .. 6.55.15 ....
sarve hyati balāḥ śūrāḥ sarve parvatasannibhāḥ .harayo rākṣasāścaiva parasparajighāṃsavaḥ .. 6.55.16 ....
teṣāṃ vinardatāṃ śabdaḥ saṃyuge 'titarasvinām .suśruve sumahān krodhādanyonyamabhigarjatām .. 6.55.17 ....
rajaścāruṇavarṇābhaṃ subhīmamabhavadbhṛśam .udbhūtaṃ harirakṣobhiḥ saṃrurodha diśo daśa .. 6.55.18 ....
anyonyaṃ rajasā tena kauśeyoddhūtapāṇḍunā .saṃvṛtāni ca bhūtāni dadṛśurna raṇājire .. 6.55.19 ....
na dhvajā na patākā vā carma vā turago 'pi vā .āyudhaṃ syandanaṃ vā 'pi dadṛśe tena reṇunā .. 6.55.20 ....
śabdaśca sumahāṃsteṣāṃ nardatāmabhidhāvatām .śrūyate tumule yuddhe na rūpāṇi cakāśire .. 6.55.21 ....
harīneva susaṅkruddhā harayo jaghnurāhave .rākṣasāścāpi rakṣāṃsi nijaghnustimire tadā .. 6.55.22 ....
parāṃścaiva vinighnantaḥ svāṃśca vānararākṣasāḥ .rudhirārdrāṃ tadā cakrurmahīṃ paṅkānulepanām .. 6.55.23 ....
tatastu rudhiraugheṇa siktaṃ vyapagataṃ rajaḥ .śarīraśavasaṅkīrṇā babhūva ca vasundharā .. 6.55.24 ....
drumaśaktiśilāprāsairgadāparighatomaraiḥ .harayo rākṣasāścaiva jaghnuranyonyamojasā .. 6.55.25 ....
bāhubhiḥ parighākārairyuddhyantaḥ parvatopamāḥ .harayo bhīmakarmāṇo rākṣasān jaghnurāhave .. 6.55.26 ....
rākṣasāstvapi saṅkruddhāḥ prāsatomarapāṇayaḥ .kapīnnijaghnire tatra śastraiḥ paramadāruṇaiḥ .. 6.55.27 ....
akampanaḥ susaṅkruddho rākṣasānāṃ camūpatiḥ .saṃharṣayati tān sarvān rākṣasān bhīmavikramān .. 6.55.28 ....
harayastvapi sakṣāṃsi mahādrumamahāśmabhiḥ .vidārayantyabhikramya śastrāṇyācchidya vīryataḥ .. 6.55.29 ....
etasminnantare vīrā harayaḥ kumudo nalaḥ .maindaśca dvividaḥ kruddhāścakrurvegamanuttamam .. 6.55.30 ....
te tu vṛkṣairmahāvegā rākṣasānāṃ camūmukhe .kadanaṃ sumahaccakrurlīlayā hariyūthapāḥ .mamanthū rākṣasān sarve vānarā gaṇaśo bhṛśam .. 6.55.31 ..
taddṛṣṭvā sumahat karma kṛtaṃ vānarasattamaiḥ .krodhamāhārayāmāsa yudhi tīvramakampanaḥ .. 6.56.1 ....
krodhamūrcchitarūpastu dhūnvan paramakārmukam .dṛṣṭvā tu karma śatrūṇāṃ sārathiṃ vākyamabravīt .. 6.56.2 ....
tatraiva tāvattvaritaṃ rathaṃ prāpaya sārathe .yatraite bahavo ghnanti subahūn rākṣasān raṇe .. 6.56.3 ....
ete 'tra balavanto hi bhīmakāyāśca vānarāḥ .drumaśailapraharaṇāstiṣṭhanti pramukhe mama .. 6.56.4 ....
etānnihantumicchāmi samaraślāghino hyaham .etaiḥ pramathitaṃ sarvaṃ dṛśyate rākṣasaṃ balam .. 6.56.5 ....
tataḥ prajavanāśvena rathena rathināṃ varaḥ .harīnabhyahanat krodhāccharajālairakampanaḥ .. 6.56.6 ....
na sthātuṃ vānarāḥ śekuḥ kiṃ punaryoddhumāhave .akampanaśarairbhagnāḥ sarva eva vidudruvuḥ .. 6.56.7 ....
tān mṛtyuvaśamāpannānakampanavaśaṃ gatān .samīkṣya hanumān jñātīnupatasthe mahābalaḥ .. 6.56.8 ....
taṃ mahāplavagaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve plavagayūthapāḥ .sametya samare vīrāḥ saṃhṛṣṭāḥ paryavārayan .. 6.56.9 ....
avasthitaṃ hanūmantaṃ te dṛṣṭvā hariyūthapāḥ .babhūvurbalavanto hi balavantaṃ samāśritāḥ .. 6.56.10 ....
akampanastu śailābhaṃ hanūmantamavasthitam .mahendra iva dhārābhiḥ śarairabhivavarṣa ha .. 6.56.11 ....
acintayitvā bāṇaughān śarīre patitān śitān .akampanavadhārthāya mano dadhre mahābalaḥ .. 6.56.12 ....
sa prasahya mahātejā hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ .abhidudrāva tadrakṣaḥ kampayanniva medinīm .. 6.56.13 ....
tasyābhinardamānasya dīpyamānasya tejasā .babhūva rūpaṃ durdharṣaṃ dīptasyeva vibhāvasoḥ .. 6.56.14 ....
ātmānamapraharaṇaṃ jñātvā krodhasamanvitaḥ .śailamutpāṭayāmāsa vegena haripuṅgavaḥ .. 6.56.15 ....
taṃ gṛhītvā mahāśailaṃ pāṇinaikena mārutiḥ .sa vinadya mahānādaṃ bhrāmayāmāsa vīryavān .. 6.56.16 ....
tatastamabhidudrāva rākṣasendramakampanam .purā hi namuciṃ saṅkhye vajreṇeva purandaraḥ .. 6.56.17 ....
akampanastu taddṛṣṭvā giriśṛṅgaṃ samudyatam .dūrādeva mahābāṇairardhacandrairvyadārayat .. 6.56.18 ....
tatparvatāgramākāśe rakṣobāṇavidāritam .viśīrṇaṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā hanumān krodhamūrcchitaḥ .. 6.56.19 ....
so 'śvakarṇaṃ samāsādya roṣadarpānvito hariḥ .tūrṇamutpāṭayāmāsa mahāgirimivocchritam .. 6.56.20 ....
taṃ gṛhītvā mahāskandhaṃ so 'śvakarṇaṃ mahādyutiḥ .prahasya parayā prītyā bhrāmayāmāsa saṃyuge .. 6.56.21 ....
pradhāvannūruvegena prabhañjaṃstarasā drumān .hanumān paramakruddhaścaraṇairdārayat kṣitim .. 6.56.22 ....
gajāṃśca sagajārohān sarathān rathinastathā .jaghāna hanumān dhīmān rākṣasāṃśca padātigān .. 6.56.23 ....
tamantakamiva kruddhaṃ samare prāṇahāriṇam .hanumantamabhiprekṣya rākṣasā vipradudruvuḥ .. 6.56.24 ....
tamāpatantaṃ saṅkruddhaṃ rākṣasānāṃ bhayāvaham .dadarśākampano vīraścukrodha ca nanāda ca .. 6.56.25 ....
sa caturdaśabhirbāṇaiḥ śitairdehavidāraṇaiḥ .nirbibheda hanūmantaṃ mahāvīryamakampanaḥ .. 6.56.26 ....
sa tadā pratividdhastu bahvībhiḥ śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ .hanumān dadṛśe vīraḥ prarūḍha iva sānumān .. 6.56.27 ....
virarāja mahākāyo mahāvīryo mahāmanāḥ .puṣpitāśokasaṅkāśo vidhūma iva pāvakaḥ .. 6.56.28 ....
tato 'nyaṃ vṛkṣamutpāṭya katvā vegamanuttamam .śirasyabhijaghānāśu rākṣasendramakampanam .. 6.56.29 ....
sa vṛkṣeṇa hatastena sakrodhena mahātmanā .rākṣaśo vānarendreṇa papāta ca mamāra ca .. 6.56.30 ....
taṃ dṛṣṭvā nihataṃ bhūmau rākṣasendramakampanam .vyathitā rākṣasāḥ sarve kṣitikampa iva drumāḥ .. 6.56.31 ....
tyaktapraharaṇāḥ sarve rākṣasāste parājitāḥ .laṅkāmabhiyayustrastā vānaraistairabhidrutāḥ .. 6.56.32 ....
te muktakeśāḥ sambhrāntā bhagnamānāḥ parājitāḥ .sravacchramajalairaṅgaiḥ śvasanto vipradudruvuḥ .. 6.56.33 ....
anyonyaṃ pramamanthuste viviśurnagaraṃ bhayāt .pṛṣṭhataste susammūḍhāḥ prekṣamāṇā muhurmuhuḥ .. 6.56.34 ....
teṣu laṅkāṃ praviṣṭeṣu rākṣaseṣu mahābalāḥ .sametya harayaḥ sarve hanumantamapūjayan .. 6.56.35 ....
so 'pi prahṛṣṭastān sarvān harīn pratyabhyapūjayat .hanumān sattvasampanno yathārhamanukūlataḥ .. 6.56.36 ....
vineduśca yathāprāṇaṃ harayo jitakāśinaḥ .cakarṣuśca punastatra saprāṇānapi rākṣasān .. 6.56.37 ....
sa vīraśobhāmabhajanmahākapiḥ sametya rakṣāṃsi nihatya mārutiḥ .mahāsuraṃ bhīmamamitranāśanaṃ yathaiva viṣṇurbalinaṃ camūmukhe .. 6.56.38 ....
apūjayan devagaṇāstadā kapiṃ svayaṃ ca rāmo 'tibalaśca lakṣmaṇaḥ .tathaiva sugrīvamukhāḥ plavaṅgamā vibhīṣaṇaścaiva mahābalastathā .. 6.56.39 ..
akampanavadhaṃ śrutvā kruddho vai rākṣaseśvaraḥ .kiñciddīnamukhaścāpi sacivāṃstānudaikṣata .. 6.57.1 ....
sa tu dhyātvā muhūrtaṃ tu mantribhiḥ saṃvicārya ca .tatastu rāvaṇaḥ pūrvadivase rākṣasādhipaḥ .purīṃ pariyayau laṅkāṃ sarvān gulmānavekṣitum .. 6.57.2 ....
tāṃ rākṣasagaṇairguptāṃ gulmairbahubhirāvṛtām .dadarśa nagarīṃ laṅkāṃ patākādhvajamālinīm .. 6.57.3 ....
ruddhāṃ tu nagarīṃ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ .uvācāmarṣataḥ kāle prahastaṃ yuddhakovidam .. 6.57.4 ....
purasyopaniviṣṭasya sahasā pīḍitasya vā .nānyaṃ yuddhāt prapaśyāmi mokṣaṃ yuddhaviśārada .. 6.57.5 ....
ahaṃ vā kumbhakarṇo vā tvaṃ vā senāpatirmama .indrajidvā nikumbho vā vaheyurbhāramīdṛśam .. 6.57.6 ....
sa tvaṃ balamataḥ śīghramādāya parigṛhya ca .vijayāyābhiniryāhi yatra sarve vanaukasaḥ .. 6.57.7 ....
niryāṇādeva te nūnaṃ capalā harivāhinī .nardatāṃ rākṣasendrāṇāṃ śrutvā nādaṃ draviṣyati .. 6.57.8 ....
capalā hyavinītāśca calacittāśca vānarāḥ .na sahiṣyanti te nādaṃ siṃhanādamiva dvipāḥ .. 6.57.9 ....
vidrute ca bale tasmin rāmaḥ saumitriṇā saha .avaśaste nirālambaḥ prahasta vaśameṣyati .. 6.57.10 ....
āpat saṃśayitā śreyo na tu nissaṃśayīkṛtā .pratilomānulomaṃ vā yadvā no manyase hitam .. 6.57.11 ....
rāvaṇenaivamuktastu prahasto vāhinīpatiḥ .rākṣasendramuvācedamasurendramivośanā .. 6.57.12 ....
rājan mantritapūrvaṃ naḥ kuśalaiḥ saha mantribhiḥ .vivādaścāpi no vṛttaḥ samavekṣya parasparam .. 6.57.13 ....
pradānena tu sītāyāḥ śreyo vyavasitaṃ mayā .apradāne punaryuddhaṃ dṛṣṭametattathaiva naḥ .. 6.57.14 ....
so 'haṃ dānaiśca mānaiśca satataṃ pūjitastvayā .sāntvaiśca vividhaiḥ kāle kiṃ na kuryāṃ priyaṃ tava .. 6.57.15 ....
na hi me jīvitaṃ rakṣyaṃ putradāradhanāni vā .tvaṃ paśya māṃ juhūṣantaṃ tvadarthaṃ jīvitaṃ yudhi .. 6.57.16 ....
evamuktvā tu bhartāraṃ rāvaṇaṃ vāhinīpatiḥ .uvācedaṃ balādhyakṣān prahastaḥ purataḥ sthitān .. 6.57.17 ....
samānayata me śīghraṃ rākṣasānāṃ mahadbalam .. 6.57.18 ....
madbāṇaśatavegena hatānāṃ ca raṇājire .adya tṛpyantu māṃsādāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ kānanaukasām .. 6.57.19 ....
ityuktāste prahastena balādhyakṣāḥ kṛtatvarāḥ .balamudyojayāmāsustasmin rākṣasamandire .. 6.57.20 ....
sā babhūva muhūrtena tigmanānāvidhāyudhaiḥ .laṅkā rākṣasavīraistairgajairiva samākulā .. 6.57.21 ....
hutāśanaṃ tarpayatāṃ brāhmaṇāṃśca namasyatām .ājyagandhaprativahaḥ surabhirmāruto vavau .. 6.57.22 ....
srajaśca vividhākārā jagṛhustvabhimantritāḥ .saṅgrāmasajjāḥ saṃhṛṣṭā dhārayan rākṣasāstadā .. 6.57.23 ....
sadhanuṣkāḥ kavacino vegādāplutya rākṣasāḥ .rāvaṇaṃ prekṣya rājānaṃ prahastaṃ paryavārayan .. 6.57.24 ....
athāmantrya ca rājānaṃ bherīmāhatya bhairavām .āruroha rathaṃ divyaṃ prahastaḥ sajjakalpitam .. 6.57.25 ....
hayairmahājavairyuktaṃ samyak sūtasusaṃyatam .mahājaladanirghoṣaṃ sākṣāccandrārkabhāsvaram .. 6.57.26 ....
uragadhvajadurddharṣaṃ suvarūthaṃ svapaskaram .suvarṇajālasaṃyuktaṃ prahasantamiva śriyā .. 6.57.27 ....
tatastaṃ rathamāsthāya rāvaṇārpitaśāsanaḥ .laṅkāyā niryayau tūrṇaṃ balena mahatā vṛtaḥ .. 6.57.28 ....
tato dundubhinirghoṣaḥ parjanyaninadopamaḥ .vāditrāṇāṃ ca ninadaḥ pūrayanniva sāgaram .śuśruve śaṅkhaśabdaśca prayāte vāhinīpatau .. 6.57.29 ....
ninadantaḥ svarān ghorān rākṣasā jagmuragrataḥ .bhīmarūpā mahākāyāḥ prahastasya purassarāḥ .. 6.57.30 ....
narāntakaḥ kumbhahanurmahānādaḥ samunnataḥ .prahastasacivā hyete niryayuḥ parivārya tam .. 6.57.31 ....
vyūḍhenaiva sughoreṇa pūrvadvārāt sa niryayau .gajayūthanikāśena balena mahatā vṛtaḥ .. 6.57.32 ....
sāgarapratimaughena vṛtastena balena saḥ .prahasto niryayau tūrṇaṃ kālāntakayamopamaḥ .. 6.57.33 ....
tasya niryāṇaghoṣeṇa rākṣasānāṃ ca nardatām .laṅkāyāṃ sarvabhūtāni vinedurvikṛtaiḥ svaraiḥ .. 6.57.34 ....
vyabhramākāśamāviśya māṃsaśoṇitabhojanāḥ .maṇḍalānyapasavyāni khagāścakrū rathaṃ prati .. 6.57.35 ....
vamantyaḥ pāvakajvālāḥ śivā ghoraṃ vavāśire .antarikṣāt papātolkā vāyuśca paruṣo vavau .. 6.57.36 ....
anyonyamabhisaṃrabdhā grahāśca na cakāśire .. 6.57.37 ....
meghāśca kharanirghoṣā rathasyopari rakṣasaḥ .vavṛṣū rudhiraṃ cāsya siṣicuśca purassarān .. 6.57.38 ....
ketumūrdhani gṛdhro 'sya nilīno dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ .tudannubhayataḥ pārśvaṃ samagrāmaharat prabhām .. 6.57.39 ....
sāratherbahuśaścāsya saṅgrāmamavagāhataḥ .pratodo nyapataddhastāt sūtasya hayasādinaḥ .. 6.57.40 ....
niryāṇaśrīśca yā 'syāsīdbhāsvarā vasudurlabhā .sā nanāśa muhūrtena same ca skhalitā hayāḥ .. 6.57.41 ....
prahastaṃ tvabhiniryāntaṃ prakhyātabalapauruṣam .yudhi nānāpraharaṇā kapisenā 'bhyavartata .. 6.57.42 ....
atha ghoṣaḥ sutumulo harīṇāṃ samajāyata .vṛkṣānārujatāṃ caiva gurvīrāgṛhṇatāṃ śilāḥ .. 6.57.43 ....
nadatāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca vānarāṇāṃ ca garjatām .ubhe pramudite sainye rakṣogaṇavanaukasām .. 6.57.44 ....
vegitānāṃ samarthānāmanyonyavadhakāṅkṣiṇām .parasparaṃ cāhvayatāṃ ninādaḥ śrūyate mahān .. 6.57.45 ....
tataḥ prahastaḥ kapirājavāhinīmabhipratasthe vijayāya durmatiḥ .vivṛddhavegāṃ ca viveśa tāṃ camūṃ yathā mumūrṣuḥ śalabho vibhāvasum .. 6.57.46 ..
tataḥ prahastaṃ niryāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīmaparākramam .uvāca sasmitaṃ rāmo vibhīṣaṇamarindamaḥ .. 6.58.1 ....
ka eṣa sumahākāyo balena mahatā vṛtaḥ .ācakṣva me mahābāho vīryavantaṃ niśācaram .. 6.58.2 ....
rāghavasya vacaḥ śrutvā pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇaḥ .. 6.58.3 ....
eṣa senāpatistasya prahasto nāma rākṣasaḥ .laṅkāyāṃ rākṣasendrasya tribhāgabalasaṃvṛtaḥ .vīryavānastravicchūraḥ prakhyātaśca parākrame .. 6.58.4 ....
tataḥ prahastaṃ niryāntaṃ bhīmaṃ bhīmaparākramam .garjantaṃ sumahākāyaṃ rākṣasairabhisaṃvṛtam .. 6.58.5 ....
dadarśa mahatī senā vānarāṇāṃ balīyasām .atisañjātaroṣāṇāṃ prahastamabhigarjatām .. 6.58.6 ....
khaḍgaśaktyṛṣṭibāṇāśca śūlāni musalāni ca .gadāśca parighāḥ prāsā vividhāśca paraśvadhāḥ .. 6.58.7 ....
dhanūṃṣi ca vicitrāṇi rākṣasānāṃ jayaiṣiṇām .pragṛhītānyaśobhanta vānarānabhidhāvatām .. 6.58.8 ....
jagṛhuḥ pādapāṃścāpi puṣpitān vānararṣabhāḥ .śilāśca vipulā dīrghā yoddhukāmāḥ plavaṅgamāḥ .. 6.58.9 ....
teṣāmanyonyamāsādya saṅgrāmaḥ sumahānabhūt .bahūnāmaśmavṛṣṭiṃ ca śaravṛṣṭiṃ ca varṣatām .. 6.58.10 ....
bahavo rākṣasā yuddhe bahūn vānarayūthapān .vānarā rākṣasāṃścāpi nijaghnurbahavo bahūn .. 6.58.11 ....
śūlaiḥ pramathitāḥ kecit kecicca paramāyudhaiḥ .parighairāhatāḥ kecit kecicchinnāḥ paraśvadhaiḥ .. 6.58.12 ....
nirucchvāsāḥ kṛtāḥ kecit patitā dharaṇītale .vibhinnahṛdayāḥ kecidiṣusandhānasanditāḥ .. 6.58.13 ....
keciddvidhā kṛtāḥ khaḍgaiḥ sphurantaḥ patitā bhuvi .vānarā rākṣasaiḥ śūlaiḥ pārśvataścāvadāritāḥ .. 6.58.14 ....
vānaraiścāpi saṅkruddhai rākṣasaughāḥ samantataḥ .pādapairgiriśṛṅgaiśca sampiṣṭā vasudhātale .. 6.58.15 ....

taṃ śailaśṛṅgairmusalairgadābhirvṛkṣaistalairmudgaramuṣṭibhiśca .sukhaprasuptaṃ bhuvi kumbhakarṇaṃ rakṣāṃsyudagrāṇi tadā nijaghnuḥ .. 6.60.40 ....
tasya niḥśvāsavātena kumbhakarṇasya rakṣasaḥ .rākṣasā balavanto 'pi sthātuṃ nāśaknuvan puraḥ .. 6.60.41 ....
tataḥ parihitā gāḍhaṃ rākṣasā bhīmavikramāḥ .. 6.60.42 ....
mṛdaṅgapaṇavān bherīḥ śaṅkhakumbhagaṇāṃstadā .daśarākṣasasāhasrā yugapat paryavādayan .. 6.60.43 ....
nīlāñjanacayākārāste tu taṃ pratyabodhayan .abhighnanto nadantaśca naiva saṃvivide tu saḥ .. 6.60.44 ....
yadā cainaṃ na śekuste pratibodhayituṃ tadā .tato gurutaraṃ yatnaṃ dāruṇaṃ samupākraman .. 6.60.45 ....
aśvānuṣṭrān kharānnāgān jaghnurdaṇḍakaśāṅkuśaiḥ .bherīśaṅkhamṛdaṅgāṃśca sarvaprāṇairavādayan .. 6.60.46 ....
nijaghnuścāsya gātrāṇi mahākāṣṭhakaṭaṅkaraiḥ .mudgarairmusalaiścaiva sarvaprāṇasamudyataiḥ .. 6.60.47 ....
tena śabdena mahatā laṅkā samabhipūritā .saparvatavanā sarvā so 'pi naiva prabudhyate .. 6.60.48 ....
tataḥ sahasraṃ bherīṇāṃ yugapat samahanyata .mṛṣṭakāñcanakoṇānāmāsaktānāṃ samantataḥ .. 6.60.49 ....
evamapyatinidrastu yadā naiva prabudhyate .śāpasya vaśamāpannastataḥ kruddhā niśācarāḥ .mahākrodhasamāviṣṭāḥ sarve bhīmaparākramāḥ .. 6.60.50 ....
tadrakṣo bodhayiṣyantaścakruranye parākramam .. 6.60.51 ....
stataḥ kruddhā niśācarāḥ .anye bherīḥ samājaghnuranye cakrurmahāsvanam .keśānanye pralulupuḥ karṇāvanye daśanti ca .. 6.60.52 ....
udakumbhaśatānyanye samasiñcanta karṇayoḥ .na kumbhakarṇaḥ paspande mahānidrāvaśaṃ gataḥ .. 6.60.53 ....
anye ca balinastasya kūṭamudgarapāṇayaḥ .mūrdhni vakṣasi gātreṣu pātayan kūṭamudgarān .. 6.60.54 ....
rajjubandhanabaddhābhiḥ śataghnībhiśca sarvataḥ .vadhyamāno mahākāyo na prābudhyata rākṣasaḥ .. 6.60.55 ....
vāraṇānāṃ sahasraṃ tu śarīre 'sya pradhāvitam .kumbhakarṇastato buddhaḥ sparśaṃ paramabudhyata .. 6.60.56 ....
sa pātyamānairgiriśṛṅgavṛkṣairacintayaṃstān vipulān prahārān .nidrākṣayāt kṣudbhayapīḍitaśca vijṛmbhamāṇaḥ sahasotpapāta .. 6.60.57 ....
sa nāgabhogācalaśṛṅgakalpau vikṣipya bāhū giriśṛṅgasārau .vivṛtya vaktraṃ vaḍavāmukhābhaṃ niśācaro 'sau vikṛtaṃ jajṛmbhe .. 6.60.58 ....
tasya jājṛmbhamāṇasya vaktraṃ pātālasannibham .dadṛśe meruśṛṅgāgre divākara ivoditaḥ .. 6.60.59 ....
sa jṛmbhamāṇo 'tibalaḥ pratibuddho niśācaraḥ .niḥśvāsaścāsya sañjajñe parvatādiva mārutaḥ .. 6.60.60 ....
rūpamuttiṣṭhatastasya kumbhakarṇasya tadbabhau .tapānte sabalākasya meghasyeva vivarṣataḥ .. 6.60.61 ....
tasya dīptāgnisadṛśe vidyutsadṛśavarcasī .dadṛśāte mahānetre dīptāviva mahāgrahau .. 6.60.62 ....
tatastvadarśayan sarvān bhakṣyāṃśca vividhān bahūn .varāhān mahiṣāṃścaiva sa babhakṣa mahābalaḥ .. 6.60.63 ....
adan bubhukṣito māṃsaṃ śoṇitaṃ tṛṣitaḥ piban .medaḥkumbhāṃśca madyaṃ ca papau śakraripustadā .. 6.60.64 ....
tatastṛpta iti jñātvā samutpeturniśācarāḥ .śirobhiśca praṇamyainaṃ sarvataḥ paryavārayan .. 6.60.65 ....
nidrāviśa 'danetrastu kaluṣīkṛtalocanaḥ .cārayan sarvato dṛṣṭiṃ tān dadarśa niśācarān .. 6.60.66 ....
sa sarvān sāntvayāmāsa nairṛtānnairṛtarṣabhaḥ .bodhanād vismitaścāpi rākṣasānidamabravīt .. 6.60.67 ....
kimarthamahamādṛtya bhavadbhiḥ pratibodhitaḥ .kaccit sukuśalaṃ rājño bhayavāneṣa vā na kim .. 6.60.68 ....
athavā dhruvamanyebhyo bhayaṃ paramupasthitam .yadarthamevaṃ tvaritairbhavadbhiḥ pratibodhitaḥ .. 6.60.69 ....
adya rākṣasarājasya bhayamutpāṭayāmyaham .pātayiṣye mahendraṃ vā śātayiṣye tathā 'nalam .. 6.60.70 ....
na hyalpakāraṇe suptaṃ bodhayiṣyati māṃ guruḥ .tadākhyātārthatattvena matprabodhanakāraṇam .. 6.60.71 ....
evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ saṃrabdhaṃ kumbhakarṇaṃ mahābalam .yūpākṣaḥ sacivo rājñaḥ kṛtāñjaliruvāca ha .. 6.60.72 ....
na no daivakṛtaṃ kiñcidbhayamasti kadācana .mānuṣānno bhayaṃ rājaṃstumulaṃ samprabādhate .. 6.60.73 ....
na daityadānavebhyo vā bhayamasti hi tādṛśam .yādṛśaṃ mānuṣaṃ rājan bhayamasmānupasthitam .. 6.60.74 ....
vānaraiḥ parvatākārairlaṅkeyaṃ parivāritā .sītāharaṇasantaptādrāmānnastumulaṃ bhayam .. 6.60.75 ....
ekena vānareṇeyaṃ pūrvaṃ dagdhā mahāpurī .kumāro nihataścākṣaḥ sānuyātraḥ sakuñjaraḥ .. 6.60.76 ....
svayaṃ rakṣodhipaścāpi paulastyo devakaṇṭakaḥ .mṛteti saṃyuge mukto rāmeṇādityatejasā .. 6.60.77 ....
yanna daivaiḥ kṛto rājā nāpi daityairna dānavaiḥ .kṛtaḥ sa iha rāmeṇa vimuktaḥ prāṇasaṃśayāt .. 6.60.78 ....
sa yūpākṣavacaḥ śrutvā bhrāturyudhi parājayam .kumbhakarṇo vivṛttākṣo yūpākṣamidamabravīt .. 6.60.79 ....
sarvamadyaiva yūpākṣa harisainyaṃ salakṣmaṇam .rāghavaṃ ca raṇe hatvā paścāddrakṣyāmi rāvaṇam .. 6.60.80 ....
rākṣasāṃstarpayiṣyāmi harīṇāṃ māṃsaśoṇitaiḥ .rāmalakṣmaṇayoścāpi svayaṃ pāsyāmi śoṇitam .. 6.60.81 ....
tattasya vākyaṃ bruvato niśamya sagarvitaṃ roṣavivṛddhadoṣam .mahodaro nairṛtayodhamukhyaḥ kṛtāñjalirvākyamidaṃ babhāṣe .. 6.60.82 ....
rāvaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā guṇadoṣau vimṛśya ca .paścādapi mahābāho śatrūn yudhi vijeṣyasi .. 6.60.83 ....
mahodaravacaḥ śrutvā rākṣasaiḥ parivāritaḥ .kumbhakarṇo mahātejāḥ sampratasthe mahābalaḥ .. 6.60.84 ....
taṃ samutthāpya bhīmākṣaṃ bhīmarūpaparākramam .rākṣasāstvaritā jagmurdaśagrīvaniveśanam .. 6.60.85 ....
tato gatvā daśagrīvamāsīnaṃ paramāsane .ūcurbaddhāñjalipuṭāḥ sarve eva niśācarāḥ .. 6.60.86 ....
prabuddhaḥ kumbhakarṇo 'yaṃ bhrātā te rākṣasarṣabha .kathaṃ tatraiva niryātu drakṣyasyenamihāgatam .. 6.60.87 ....
rāvaṇastvabravīddhṛṣṭo rākṣasāṃstānupasthitān .draṣṭumenamihecchāmi yathānyāyaṃ ca pūjyatām .. 6.60.88 ....
tathetyuktvā tu te sarve punarāgamya rākṣasāḥ .kumbhakarṇamidaṃ vākyamūcū rāvaṇacoditāḥ .. 6.60.89 ....
draṣṭuṃ tvāṃ kāṅkṣate rājā sarvarākṣasapuṅgavaḥ .gamane kriyatāṃ buddhirbhrātaraṃ sampraharṣaya .. 6.60.90 ....
kumbhakarṇastu durdharṣo bhrāturājñāya śāsanam .tathetyuktvā mahābāhuḥ śayanādutpapāta ha .. 6.60.91 ....
prakṣālya vadanaṃ hṛṣṭaḥ snātaḥ paramabhūṣitaḥ .pipāsustvarayāmāsa pānaṃ balasamīraṇam .. 6.60.92 ....
tataste tvaritāstasya rākṣasā rāvaṇājñayā .madyakumbhāṃśca vividhān kṣipramevopahārayan .. 6.60.93 ....
pītvā ghaṭasahasre dve gamanāyopacakrame .īṣatsamutkaṭo mattastejobalasamanvitaḥ .kumbhakarṇo babhau hṛṣṭaḥ kālāntakayamopamaḥ .. 6.60.94 ....
bhrātuḥ sa bhavanaṃ gacchan rakṣogaṇasamanvitaḥ .kumbhakarṇaḥ padanyāsairakampayata medinīm .. 6.60.95 ....
sa rājamārgaṃ vapuṣā prakāśayan sahasraraśmirdharaṇīmivāṃśubhiḥ .jagāma tatrāñjalimālayā vṛtaḥ śatakraturgehamiva svayambhuvaḥ .. 6.60.96 ....
taṃ rājamārgasthamamitraghātinaṃ vanaukasaste sahasā bahiḥ sthitāḥ .dṛṣṭvā 'prameyaṃ giriśṛṅgakalpaṃ vitatrasuste hariyūthapālāḥ .. 6.60.97 ....
keciccharaṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ sma rāmaṃ vrajanti kecidvyathitāḥ patanti .keciddiśaḥ sma vyathitāḥ prayānti kecidbhayārtā bhuvi śerate sma .. 6.60.98 ....
tamadriśṛṅgapratimaṃ kirīṭinaṃ spṛśantamādityamivātmatejasā .vanaukasaḥ prekṣya vivṛddhamadbhutaṃ bhayārditā dudruvire tatastataḥ .. 6.60.99 ..
tato rāmo bhahātejā dhanurādāya vīryavān .kirīṭinaṃ mahākāyaṃ kumbhakarṇaṃ dadarśa ha .. 6.61.1 ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasaśreṣṭhaṃ parvatākāradarśanam .kramamāṇamivākāśaṃ purā nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum .satoyāmbudasaṅkāśaṃ kāñcanāṅgadabhūṣaṇam .. 6.61.2 ..
dṛṣṭvā punaḥ pradudrāva vānarāṇāṃ mahācamūḥ .. 6.61.3 ..
vidrutāṃ vāhinīṃ dṛṣṭvā vardhamānaṃ ca rākṣasam .savismayamidaṃ rāmo vibhīṣaṇamuvāca ha .. 6.61.4 ..
ko 'sau parvatasaṅkāśaḥ kirīṭī harilocanaḥ .laṅkāyāṃ dṛśyate vīra savidyudiva toyadaḥ .. 6.61.5 ..
pṛthivyāḥ ketubhūto 'sau mahāneko 'tra dṛśyate .yaṃ dṛṣṭvā vānarāḥ sarve vidravanti tatastataḥ .. 6.61.6 ..
ācakṣva me mahān ko 'sau rakṣo vā yadi vā 'suraḥ .na mayaivaṃvidhaṃ bhūtaṃ dṛṣṭapūrvaṃ kadācana .. 6.61.7 ..
sa pṛṣṭo rājaputreṇa rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā .vibhīṣaṇo mahāprājñaḥ kākutsthamidamabravīt .. 6.61.8 ..
yena vaivasvato yuddhe vāsavaśca parājitaḥ .saiṣa viśravasaḥ putraḥ kumbhakarṇaḥ pratāpavān .asya pramāṇāt sadṛśo rākṣaso 'nyo na vidyate .. 6.61.9 ..
etena devā yudhi dānavāśca yakṣā bhujaṅgāḥ piśitāśanāśca .gandharvavidyādharakinnarāśca sahasraśo rāghava samprabhagrāḥ .. 6.61.10 ..
śūlapāṇiṃ virūpākṣaṃ kumbhakarṇaṃ mahābalam .hantuṃ na śekustridaśāḥ kālo 'yamiti mohitāḥ .. 6.61.11 ..
prakṛtyā hyeṣa tejasvī kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ .anyeṣāṃ rākṣasendrāṇāṃ varadānakṛtaṃ balam .. 6.61.12 ..
etena jātamātreṇa kṣudhārtena mahātmanā .bhakṣitāni sahasrāṇi sattvānāṃ subahūnyapi .. 6.61.13 ..
teṣu sambhakṣyamāṇeṣu prajā bhayanipīḍitāḥ .yānti sma śaraṇaṃ śakraṃ tamapyarthaṃ nyavedayan .. 6.61.14 ..
sa kumbhakarṇaṃ kupito mahendro jaghāna vajreṇa śitena vajrī .sa śakravajrābhihato mahātmā cacāla kopācca bhṛśaṃ nanāda .. 6.61.15 ..
tasya nānadyamānasya kumbhakarṇasya dhīmataḥ .śrutvā 'tinādaṃ vitrastā bhūyo bhūmirvitatrase .. 6.61.16 ..
tatra kopānmahendrasya kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ .vikṛṣyairāvatāddantaṃ jaghānorasi vāsavam .. 6.61.17 ..
kumbhakarṇaprahārārto vijajvāla sa vāsavaḥ .tato viṣeduḥ sahasā devabrahmarṣidānavāḥ .. 6.61.18 ..
prajābhiḥ saha śakraśca yayau sthānaṃ svayambhuvaḥ .kumbhakarṇasya daurātmyaṃ śaśaṃsuste prajāpateḥ .. 6.61.19 ..
prajānāṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ cāpi devānāṃ cāpi dharṣaṇam .āśramadhvaṃsanaṃ cāpi parastrīharaṇaṃ bhṛśam .. 6.61.20 ..
evaṃ prajā yadi tveṣa bhakṣayiṣyati nityaśaḥ .acireṇaiva kālena śūnyo loko bhaviṣyati .. 6.61.21 ..
vāsavasya vacaḥ śrutvā sarvalokapitāmahaḥ .rakṣāṃsyāvāhayāmāsa kumbhakarṇaṃ dadarśa ha .. 6.61.22 ..
kumbhakarṇaṃ samīkṣyaiva vitatrāsa prajāpatiḥ .dṛṣṭvā viśvāsya caivedaṃ svayambhūridamabravīt .. 6.61.23 ..
dhruvaṃ lokavināśāya paulastyenāsi nirmitaḥ .tasmāttvamadyaprabhṛti mṛtakalpaḥ śayiṣyase .. 6.61.24 ..
brahmaśāpābhibhūto 'tha nipapātāgrataḥ prabhoḥ .tataḥ paramasambhrānto rāvaṇo vākyamabravīt .. 6.61.25 ..
vivṛddhaḥ kāñcano vṛkṣaḥ phalakāle nikṛtyate .na naptāraṃ svakaṃ nyāyyaṃ śaptumevaṃ prajāpate .. 6.61.26 ..
na mithyāvacanaśca tvaṃ svapsyatyeṣa na saṃśayaḥ .kālastu kriyatāmasya śayane jāgare tathā .. 6.61.27 ..
rāvaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā svayambhūridamabravīt .. 6.61.28 ..
śayati hyeṣa ṣaṇmāsānekāhaṃ jāgariṣyati .ekenāhnā tvasau vīraścaran bhūmiṃ bubhukṣitaḥ .vyāttāsyo bhakṣayellokān sakruddha iva pāvakaḥ .. 6.61.29 ..
so 'sau vyasanamāpannaḥ kumbhakarṇamabodhayat .tvatparākramabhītaśca rājā samprati rāvaṇaḥ .. 6.61.30 ..
sa eṣa nirgato vīraḥ śibirādbhīmavikramaḥ .vānarān bhṛśasaṅkruddho bhakṣayan paridhāvati .. 6.61.31 ..
kumbhakarṇaṃ samīkṣyaiva harayo 'dya pravidrutāḥ .kathamenaṃ raṇe kruddhaṃ vārayiṣyanti vānarāḥ .. 6.61.32 ..
ucyantāṃ vānarāḥ sarve yantrametat samucchritam .iti vijñāya harayo bhaviṣyantīha nirbhayāḥ .. 6.61.33 ..
vibhīṣaṇavacaḥ śrutvā hetumat sumukheritam .uvāca rāghavo vākyaṃ nīlaṃ senāpatiṃ tadā .. 6.61.34 ..
gaccha sainyāni sarvāṇi vyūhya tiṣṭhasva pāvake .dvārāṇyādāya laṅkāyāścaryāścāpyatha saṅkramān .. 6.61.35 ..
śailaśṛṅgāṇi vṛkṣāṃśca śilāścāpyupasaṃhara .tiṣṭhantu vānarāḥ sarve sāyudhāḥ śailapāṇayaḥ .. 6.61.36 ..
rāghaveṇa samādiṣṭo nīlo haricamūpatiḥ .śaśāsa vānarānīkaṃ yathāvat kapikuñjaraḥ .. 6.61.37 ..
tato gavākṣaḥ śarabho hanumānaṅgadastathā .śailaśṛṅgāṇi śailābhā gṛhītvā dvāramabhyayuḥ .. 6.61.38 ..
rāmavākyamupaśrutya harayo jitakāśinaḥ .pādapairardayan vīrā vānarāḥ paravāhinīm .. 6.61.39 ..
tato harīṇāṃ tadanīkamugraṃ rarāja śailodyatadīptahastam .gireḥ samīpānugataṃ yathaiva mahanmahāmbhodharajālamugram .. 6.61.40 ..
ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe ekaṣaṣṭitamaḥ sargaḥ .. 61 ..
sa tu rākṣasaśārdūlo nidrāmadasamākulaḥ .rājamārgaṃ śriyā juṣṭaṃ yayau vipulavikramaḥ .. 6.62.1 ..
rākṣasānāṃ sahasraiśca vṛtaḥ paramadurjayaḥ .gṛhebhyaḥ puṣpavarṣeṇa kīryamāṇastadā yayau .. 6.62.2 ..
sa hemajālivitataṃ bhānubhāsvaradarśanam .dadarśa vipulaṃ ramyaṃ rākṣasendraniveśanam .. 6.62.3 ..
sa tattadā sūrya ivābhrajālaṃ praviśya rakṣodhipaterniveśam .dadarśa dūre 'grajamāsanasthaṃ svayambhuvaṃ śakra ivāsanastham .. 6.62.4 ..
bhrātuḥ sa bhavanaṃ gacchan rakṣogaṇasamanvitam .kumbhakarṇaḥ padanyāsairakampayata medinīm .. 6.62.5 ..
so 'bhigamya gṛhaṃ bhrātuḥ kakṣyāmabhivigāhya ca .dadarśodvignamāsīnaṃ vimāne puṣpake gurum .. 6.62.6 ..
atha dṛṣṭvā daśagrīvaḥ kumbhakarṇamupasthitam .tūrṇamutthāya saṃhṛṣṭaḥ sannikarṣamupānayat .. 6.62.7 ..
athāsīnasya paryaṅke kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ .bhrāturvavande caraṇau kiṃ kṛtyamiti cābravīt .. 6.62.8 ..
utpatya cainaṃ mudito rāvaṇaḥ pariṣasvaje .sa bhrātrā sampariṣvakto yathāvacchābhinanditaḥ .. 6.62.9 ..
kumbhakarṇaḥ śubhaṃ divyaṃ pratipede varāsanam .sa tadāsanamāśritya kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ .saṃraktanayanaḥ kopādrāvaṇaṃ vākyamabravīt .. 6.62.10 ..
kimarthamahamādṛtya tvayā rājan vibodhitaḥ .śaṃsa kasmādbhayaṃ te 'sti ko 'dya preto bhaviṣyati .. 6.62.11 ..
bhrātaraṃ rāvaṇaḥ kuddhaṃ kumbhakarṇamavasthitam .īṣattu parivṛttābhyāṃ netrābhyāṃ vākyamabravīt .. 6.62.12 ..
adya te sumahān kālaḥ śayānasya mahābala .sukhitastvaṃ na jānīṣe mama rāmakṛtaṃ bhayam .. 6.62.13 ..
eṣa dāśarathī rāmaḥ sugrīvasahito balī .samudraṃ sabalastīrtvā mūlaṃ naḥ parikṛntati .. 6.62.14 ..
hanta paśyasva laṅkāyāṃ vanānyupavanāni ca .setunā sukhamāgamya vānaraikārṇavīkṛtam .. 6.62.15 ..
ye rakṣasāṃ mukhyatamā hatāste vānarairyudhi .vānarāṇāṃ kṣayaṃ yuddhe na paśyāmi kadācana .. 6.62.16 ..
na cāpi vānarā yuddhe jitapūrvāḥ kadācana .. 6.62.17 ..
