tadastraṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā.hṛṣṭā nedustataḥ sarve kapayaḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ.sugrīvapramukhā vīrāḥ parivārya tu rāghavam .. 6.100.50 ..
tatastadastraṃ vinihatya rāghavaḥ prasahya tadrāvaṇabāhunissṛtam.mudā 'nvito dāśarathirmahāhave vineduruccairmuditāḥ kapīśvarāḥ .. 6.100.51 ..
ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe śatatamaḥ sargaḥ .. 100 ..
tasmin pratihate 'stre tu rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ .krodhaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ cakre krodhāccāstramanantaram .. 6.101.1 ..
mayena vihitaṃ raudramanyadastraṃ mahādyutiḥ .utsraṣṭuṃ rāvaṇo ghoraṃ rāghavāya pracakrame .. 6.101.2 ..
tataḥ śūlāni niścerurgadāśca musalāni ca .kārmukāddīpyamānāni vajrasārāṇi sarvaśaḥ .. 6.101.3 ..
mudgarāḥ kūṭapāśāśca dīptāścāśanayastathā .niṣpeturvividhāstīkṣṇā vātā iva yugakṣaye .. 6.101.4 ..
tadastraṃ rāghavaḥ śrīmānuttamāstravidāṃ varaḥ .jaghāna paramāstreṇa gāndharveṇa mahādyutiḥ .. 6.101.5 ..
tasmin pratihate 'stre tu rāghaveṇa mahātmanā .rāvaṇaḥ krodhatāmrākṣaḥ sauramastramudairayat .. 6.101.6 ..
tataścakrāṇi niṣpeturbhāsvarāṇi mahānti ca .kārmukādbhīmavegasya daśagrīvasya dhīmataḥ .. 6.101.7 ..
tairāsīdgaganaṃ dīptaṃ sampatadbhiritastataḥ .patadbhiśca diśo dīptāścandrasūryagrahairiva .. 6.101.8 ..
tāni ciccheda bāṇaughaiścakrāṇi sa tu rāghavaḥ .āyudhāni ca citrāṇi rāvaṇasya camūmukhe .. 6.101.9 ..
tadastraṃ tu hataṃ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ .vivyādha daśabhirbāṇai rāmaṃ sarveṣu marmasu .. 6.101.10 ..
sa viddho daśabhirbāṇairmahākārmukanissṛtaiḥ .rāvaṇena mahātejā na prākampata rāghavaḥ .. 6.101.11 ..
tato vivyādha gātreṣu sarveṣu samitiñjayaḥ .rāghavastu susaṅkruddho rāvaṇaṃ bahubhiḥ śaraiḥ .. 6.101.12 ..
etasminnantare kruddho rāghavasyānujo balī .lakṣmaṇaḥ sāyakān sapta jagrāha paravīrahā .. 6.101.13 ..
taiḥ sāyakairmahāvegai rāvaṇasya mahādyutiḥ .dhvajaṃ manuṣyaśīrṣaṃ tu tasya ciccheda naikadhā .. 6.101.14 ..
sāratheścāpi bāṇena śiro jvalitakuṇḍalam .jahāra lakṣmaṇaḥ śrīmān nairṛtasya mahābalaḥ .. 6.101.15 ..
tasya bāṇaiśca ciccheda dhanurgajakaropamam .lakṣmaṇo rākṣasendrasya pañcabhirniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ .. 6.101.16 ..
nīlameghanibhāṃścāsya sadaśvān parvatopamān .jaghānāplutya gadayā rāvaṇasya vibhīṣaṇaḥ .. 6.101.17 ..
hatāśvādvegavān vegādavaplutya mahārathāt .krodhamāhārayattīvraṃ bhrātaraṃ prati rāvaṇaḥ .. 6.101.18 ..
tataḥ śaktiṃ mahāśaktirdīptāṃ dīṃptāśanīmiva .vibhīṣaṇāya cikṣepa rākṣasendraḥ pratāpavān .. 6.101.19 ..
aprāptāmeva tāṃ bāṇaistribhiściccheda lakṣmaṇaḥ .athodatiṣṭhat sannādo vānarāṇāṃ tadā raṇe .. 6.101.20 ..
sā papāta tridhā cchinnā śaktiḥ kāñcanamālinī .savisphuliṅgā jvalitā maholkeva divaścyutā .. 6.101.21 ..
tataḥ sambhāvitatarāṃ kālenāpi durāsadām .jagrāha vipulāṃ śaktiṃ dīpyamānāṃ svatejasā .. 6.101.22 ..
sā vegitā balavatā rāvaṇena durāsadā .jajvāla sumahāghorā śakrāśanisamaprabhā .. 6.101.23 ..
etasminnantare vīro lakṣmaṇastaṃ vibhīṣaṇam .prāṇasaṃśayamāpannaṃ tūrṇamabhyavapadyata .. 6.101.24 ..
taṃ vimokṣayituṃ vīraścāpamāyamya lakṣmaṇaḥ .rāvaṇaṃ śaktihastaṃ vai śaravarṣairavākirat .. 6.101.25 ..
kīryamāṇaḥ śaraugheṇa visṛṣṭena mahātmanā .sa prahartuṃ manaścakre vimukhīkṛtavikramaḥ .. 6.101.26 ..
mokṣitaṃ bhrātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇena sa rāvaṇaḥ .lakṣmaṇābhimukhastiṣṭhannidaṃ vacanamabravīt .. 6.101.27 ..
mokṣitaste balaślāghin yasmādevaṃ vibhīṣaṇaḥ .vimucya rākṣasaṃ śaktistvayīyaṃ vinipātyate .. 6.101.28 ..
eṣā te hṛdayaṃ bhittvā śaktirlohitalakṣaṇā .madbāhuparighotsṛṣṭā prāṇānādāya yāsyati .. 6.101.29 ..
ityevamuktvā tāṃ śaktimaṣṭaghaṇṭāṃ mahāsvanām .mayena māyāvihitāmamoghāṃ śatrughātinīm .. 6.101.30 ..
lakṣmaṇāya samuddiśya jvalantīmiva tejasā .rāvaṇaḥ paramakruddhaścikṣepa ca nanāda ca .. 6.101.31 ..
sā kṣiptā bhīmavegena śakrāśanisamasvanā .śaktirabhyapatadvegāllakṣmaṇaṃ raṇamūrdhani .. 6.101.32 ..
tāmanuvyāharacchaktimāpatantīṃ sa rāghavaḥ .svastyastu lakṣmaṇāyeti moghā bhava hatodyamā .. 6.101.33 ..
rāvaṇena raṇe śaktiḥ kruddhenāśīviṣopamā .muktā ' 'śūrasyabhītasya lakṣmaṇasya mamajja sā .. 6.101.34 ..
nyapatat sā mahāvegā lakṣmaṇasya mahorasi .jihvevoragarājasya dīpyamānā mahādyutiḥ .. 6.101.35 ..
tato rāvaṇavegena sudūramavagāḍhayā .śaktyā nirbhinnahṛdayaḥ papāta bhuvi lakṣmaṇaḥ .. 6.101.36 ..
tadavasthaṃ samīpastho lakṣmaṇaṃ prekṣya rāghavaḥ .bhrātṛsnehānmahātejā viṣaṇṇahṛdayo 'bhavat .. 6.101.37 ..
sa muhūrtamanudhyāya bāṣpavyākulalocanaḥ .babhūva saṃrabdhataro yugānta iva pāvakaḥ .. 6.101.38 ..
na viṣādasya kālo 'yamiti sañcintya rāghavaḥ .cakre sutumulaṃ yuddhaṃ rāvaṇasya vadhe dhṛtaḥ .sarvayatnena mahatā lakṣmaṇaṃ sannirīkṣya ca .. 6.101.39 ..
sa dadarśa tato rāmaḥ śaktyā bhinnaṃ mahāhave .lakṣmaṇaṃ rudhirādigdhaṃ sapannagamivācalam .. 6.101.40 ..
tāmapi prahitāṃ śaktiṃ rāvaṇena balīyasā .yatnataste hariśreṣṭhā na śekuravamarditum .. 6.101.41 ..
arditāścaiva bāṇaughaiḥ kṣiprahastena rakṣasā .. 6.101.42 ..
saumitriṃ sā vinirbhidya praviṣṭā dharaṇītalam .. 6.101.43 ..
tāṃ karābhyāṃ parāmṛśya rāmaḥ śaktiṃ bhayāvahām .babhañja samare kruddho balavān vicakarṣa ca .. 6.101.44 ..
tasya niṣkarṣataḥ śaktiṃ rāvaṇena balīyasā .śarāḥ sarveṣu gātreṣu pātitā marmabhedinaḥ .. 6.101.45 ..
acintayitvā tān bāṇān samāśliṣya ca lakṣṇamam .abravīccha hanūmantaṃ sugrīvaṃ caiva rāghavaḥ .. 6.101.46 ..
lakṣmaṇaṃ parivāryeha tiṣṭhadhvaṃ vānarottamāḥ .. 6.101.47 ..
parākramasya kālo 'yaṃ samprāpto me cirepsitaḥ .pāpātmā 'yaṃ daśagrīvo vadhyatāṃ pāpaniścayaḥ .kāṅkṣataḥ stokakasyeva gharmānte meghadarśanam .. 6.101.48 ..
asmin muhūrte na cirāt satyaṃ pratiśṛṇomi vaḥ .arāvaṇamarāmaṃ vā jagaddrakṣyatha vānarāḥ .. 6.101.49 ..
rājyanāśaṃ vane vāsaṃ daṇḍake paridhāvanam .vaidehyāśca parāmarśaṃ rakṣobhiśca samāgamam .. 6.101.50 ..
prāptaṃ duḥkhaṃ mahadghoraṃ kleśaṃ ca nirayopamam .adya sarvamahaṃ tyakṣye nihatvā rāvaṇaṃ raṇe .. 6.101.51 ..
yadarthaṃ vānaraṃ sainyaṃ samānītamidaṃ mayā .sugrīvaśca kṛto rājye nihatvā vālinaṃ raṇe .. 6.101.52 ..
yadarthaṃ sāgaraḥ krāntaḥ seturbaddhaśca sāgare .so 'yamadya raṇe pāpaścakṣurviṣayamāgataḥ .. 6.101.53 ..
cakṣurviṣayamāgamya nāyaṃ jīvitumarhati .dṛṣṭiṃ dṛṣṭiviṣasyeva sarpasya mama rāvaṇaḥ .. 6.101.54 ..
svasthāḥ paśyata durdharṣā yuddhaṃ vānarapuṅgavāḥ .āsīnāḥ parvatāgreṣu mamedaṃ rāvaṇasya ca .. 6.101.55 ..
adya rāmasya rāmatvaṃ paśyantu mama saṃyuge .trayo lokāḥ sagandharvāḥ sadevāḥ sarṣicāraṇāḥ .. 6.101.56 ..
adya karma kariṣyāmi yallokāḥ sacarācarāḥ .sadevāḥ kathayiṣyanti yāvadbhūmirdhariṣyati .samāgamya sadā loke yathā yuddhaṃ pravartitam .. 6.101.57 ..
evamuktvā śitairbāṇaistaptakāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ .ājaghāna daśagrīvaṃ raṇe rāmaḥ samāhitaḥ .. 6.101.58 ..
atha pradīptairnārācairmusalaiścāpi rāvaṇaḥ .abhyavarṣattadā rāmaṃ dhārābhiriva toyadaḥ .. 6.101.59 ..
rāmarāvaṇamuktānāmanyonyamabhinighnatām .śarāṇāṃ ca śarāṇāṃ ca babhūva tumulaḥ svanaḥ .. 6.101.60 ..
te bhinnāśca vikīrṇāśca rāmarāvaṇayoḥ śarāḥ .antarikṣāt pradīptāgrā nipeturdharaṇītale .. 6.101.61 ..
tayorjyātalanirghoṣo rāmarāvaṇayormahān .trāsanaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sambabhūvādbhutopamaḥ .. 6.101.62 ..
sa kīryamāṇaḥ śarajālavṛṣṭibhirmahātmanā dīptadhanuṣmatā 'rditaḥ .bhayāt pradudrāva sametya rāvaṇo yathā 'nilenābhihato balāhakaḥ .. 6.101.63 ..
ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe ekottaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ .. 101 ..
śaktyā vinihataṃ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇena balīyasā .lakṣmaṇaṃ samare śūraṃ rudhiraughapariplutam .. 6.102.1 ..
sa dattvā tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ .visṛjanneva bāṇaughān suṣeṇaṃ vākyamabravīt .. 6.102.2 ..
eṣa rāvaṇavīryeṇa lakṣmaṇaḥ patitaḥ kṣitau .sarpavadveṣṭate vīro mama śokamudīrayan .. 6.102.3 ..
śoṇitārdramimaṃ vīraṃ prāṇairiṣṭatamaṃ mama .paśyato mama kā śaktiryoddhuṃ paryākulātmanaḥ .. 6.102.4 ..
ayaṃ sa samaraślāghī bhrātā me śubhalakṣaṇaḥ .yadi pañcatvamāpannaḥ prāṇairme kiṃ sukhena ca .. 6.102.5 ..
lajjatīva hi me vīryaṃ bhraśyatīva karāddhanuḥ .sāyakā vyavasīdanti dṛṣṭirbāṣpavaśaṃ gatā .avasīdanti gātrāṇi svapnayāne nṛṇāmiva .. 6.102.6 ..

cintā me vardhate tīvrā mumūrṣā copajāyate .. 6.102.7 ..sīdanti dṛṣṭirbāṣpavaśaṃ gatā .bhrātaraṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇena durātmanā .. 6.102.8 ...sīdanti dṛṣṭirbāṣpavaśaṃ gatā .viniṣṭanantaṃ duḥkhārthaṃ marmaṇyabhihataṃ bhṛśam .rāghavo bhrātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā priyaṃ prāṇaṃ bahiścaram .duḥkhena mahatā ' 'viṣṭo dhyānaśokaparāyaṇaḥ .. 6.102.9 ..
paraṃ viṣādamāpanno vilalāpākulendriyaḥ .. 6.102.10 ..
na hi yuddhena me kāryaṃ naiva prāṇairna sītayā .bhrātaraṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇaṃ raṇapāṃsuṣu .. 6.102.11 ..
kiṃ me rājyena kiṃ prāṇairyuddhe kāryaṃ na vidyate .yatrāyaṃ nihataḥ śete raṇamūrdhani lakṣmaṇaḥ .. 6.102.12 ..
deśe deśe kalatrāṇi deśe deśe ca bāndhavāḥ .taṃ tu deśaṃ na paśyāmi yatra bhrātā sahodaraḥ .. 6.102.13 ..
ityavaṃ vilapantaṃ taṃ śokavihvalitendriyam .viveṣṭamānaṃ karuṇamucchvasantaṃ punaḥpunaḥ .rāmamāśvāsayan vīraḥ suṣeṇo vākyamabravīt .. 6.102.14 ..
na mṛto 'yaṃ mahābāho lakṣmaṇo lakṣmivardhanaḥ .na cāsya vikṛtaṃ vaktraṃ nāpi śyāvaṃ na niṣprabham .. 6.102.15 ..
suprabhaṃ ca prasannaṃ ca mukhamasyābhilakṣyate .padmaraktatalau hastau suprasanne ca locane .. 6.102.16 ..
evaṃ na vidyate rūpaṃ gatāsūnāṃ viśāmpate .dīrghāyuṣastu ye martyāsteṣāṃ tu mukhamīddaśam .. 6.102.17 ..
nāyaṃ pretatvamāpanno lakṣmaṇo lakṣmivardhanaḥ .mā viṣādaṃ kṛthā vīra saprāṇo 'yamarindamaḥ .. 6.102.18 ..
ākhyāsyate prasuptasya srastagātrasya bhūtale .socchvāsaṃ hṛdayaṃ vīra kampamānaṃ muhurmuhuḥ .. 6.102.19 ..
evamuktvā tu vākyajñaḥ suṣeṇo rāghavaṃ vacaḥ .hanumantamuvācedaṃ hanumantamabhitvaran .. 6.102.20 ..
saumya śīghramito gatvā śailamoṣadhiparvatam .pūrvaṃ te kathito yo 'sau vīra jāmbavatā śubhaḥ .. 6.102.21 ..
dakṣiṇe śikhare tasya jātamoṣadhimānaya .viśalyakaraṇīṃ nāma viśalyakaraṇīṃ śubhām .. 6.102.22 ..
savarṇakaraṇīṃ cāpi tathā sañjīvanīmapi .sandhānakaraṇīṃ cāpi gatvā śīghramihānaya .. 6.102.23 ..
sañjīvanārthaṃ vīrasya lakṣmaṇasya mahātmanaḥ .ityevamukto hanumān gatvā cauṣadhiparvatam .cintāmabhyagamacchrīmānajānaṃstāṃ mahauṣadhim .. 6.102.24 ..
asmin hi śikhare jātāmoṣadhīṃ tāṃ sukhāvahām .pratarkeṇāvagacchāmi suṣeṇo 'pyevamabravīt .. 6.102.26 ..
agṛhya yadi gacchāmi viśalyakaraṇīmaham .kālātyayena doṣaḥ syādvaiklavyaṃ ca mahadbhavet .. 6.102.27 ..
iti sañcintya hanumān gatvā kṣipraṃ mahābalaḥ .āsādya parvataśreṣṭhaṃ triḥ prakampya gireḥ śiraḥ .. 6.102.28 ..
phullanānātarugaṇaṃ samutpāṭya mahābalaḥ .gṛhītvā hariśārdūlo hastābhyāṃ samatolayat .. 6.102.29 ..
sa nīlamiva jīmūtaṃ toyapūrṇaṃ nabhasthalāt .āpapāta gṛhītvā tu hanumān śikharaṃ gireḥ .. 6.102.30 ..
samāgamya mahāvegaḥ sannyasya śikharaṃ gireḥ .viśramya kiñciddhanumān suṣeṇamidamabravīt .. 6.102.31 ..
oṣadhiṃ nāvagacchāmi tāmahaṃ haripuṅgava .tadidaṃ śikharaṃ kṛtsnaṃ girestasyāhṛtaṃ mayā .. 6.102.32 ..
evaṃ kathayamānaṃ taṃ praśasya pavanātmajam .suṣeṇo vānaraśreṣṭho jagrāhotpāṭya cauṣadhīm .. 6.102.33 ..
vismitāstu babhūvuste raṇe vānararākṣasāḥ .dṛṣṭvā hanumataḥ karma surairapi suduṣkaram .. 6.102.34 ..
tataḥ saṅkṣodayitvā tāmoṣadhīṃ vānarottamaḥ .lakṣmaṇasya dadau nastaḥ suṣeṇaḥ sumahādyuteḥ .. 6.102.35 ..
saśalyastāṃ samāghrāya lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā .viśalyo virujaḥ śīghramudatiṣṭhanmahītalāt .. 6.102.36 ..
tamutthitaṃ te harayo bhūtalāt prekṣya lakṣmaṇam .sādhu sādhviti suprītāḥ suṣeṇaṃ pratyapūjayan .. 6.102.37 ..
ehyehītyabravīdrāmo lakṣmaṇaṃ paravīrahā .sasvaje snehagāḍhaṃ ca bāṣpapāryākulekṣaṇaḥ .. 6.102.38 ..
abravīcca pariṣvajya saumitriṃ rāghavastadā .diṣṭyā tvāṃ vīra paśyāmi maraṇāt punarāgatam .. 6.102.39 ..
na hi me jīvitenārthaḥ sītayā cāpi lakṣmaṇa .ko hi me vijayenārthastvayi pañcatvamāgate .. 6.102.40 ..
ityevaṃ vadatastasya rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ .khinnaḥ śithilayā vācā lakṣmaṇo vākyamabravīt .. 6.102.41 ..
tāṃ pratijñāṃ pratijñāya purā satyaparākrama .laghuḥ kaścidivāsattvo naivaṃ vaktumihārhasi .. 6.102.42 ..
na hi pratijñāṃ kurvanti vitathāṃ sādhavo 'nagha .lakṣaṇaṃ hi mahattvasya pratijñāparipālanam .. 6.102.43 ..
nairāśyamupagantuṃ te tadalaṃ matkṛte 'nagha .vadhena rāvaṇasyādya pratijñāmanupālaya .. 6.102.44 ..
na jīvan yāsyate śatrustava bāṇapathaṃ gataḥ .nardatastīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrasya siṃhasyeva mahāgajaḥ .. 6.102.45 ..
ahaṃ tu vadhamicchāmi śīghramasya durātmanaḥ .yāvadastaṃ na yātyeṣa kṛtakarmā divākaraḥ .. 6.102.46 ..
yadi vadhamicchasi rāvaṇasya saṅkhye yadi ca kṛtāṃ tvamihecchasi pratijñām .yadi tava rājavarātmajābhilāṣaḥ kuru ca vaco mama śīghramadyavīra .. 6.102.47 ..
lakṣmaṇena tu tadvākyamuktaṃ śrutvā sa rāghavaḥ .sandadhe paravīraghno dhanurādāya vīryavān .rāvaṇāya śarān ghorān visasarja camūmukhe .. 6.103.1 ..
athānyaṃ rathamāruhya rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ .abhyadravata kākutsthaṃ svarbhānuriva bhāskaram .. 6.103.2 ..
daśagrīvo rathasthastu rāmaṃ vajropamaiḥ śaraiḥ .ājaghāna mahāghorairdhārābhiriva toyadaḥ .. 6.103.3 ..
dīptapāvaka saṅkāśaiḥ śaraiḥ kāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ .nirbibheda raṇe rāmo daśagrīvaṃ samāhitam .. 6.103.4 ..
bhūmau sthitasya rāmasya rathasthasya ca rakṣasaḥ .na samaṃ yuddhamityāhurdevagandharvadānavāḥ .. 6.103.5 ..
tataḥ kāñcanacitrāṅgaḥ kiṅkiṇīśatabhūṣitaḥ .taruṇādityasaṅkāśo vaiḍūryamayakūbaraḥ .. 6.103.6 ..
sadaśvaiḥ kāñcanāpīḍairyuktaḥ śvetaprakīrṇakaiḥ .haribhiḥ sūryasaṅkāśairhemajālavibhūṣitaiḥ .. 6.103.7 ..
rukmaveṇudhvajaḥ śrīmān devarājaratho varaḥ .devarājena sandiṣṭo rathamāruhya mātaliḥ .. 6.103.8 ..
abhyavartata kākutsthamavatīrya triviṣṭapāt .. 6.103.9 ..
abravīcca tadā rāmaṃ sapratodo rathe sthitaḥ .prāñjalirmātalirvākyaṃ sahasrākṣasya sārathiḥ .. 6.103.10 ..
sahasrākṣeṇa kākutstha ratho 'yaṃ vijayāya te .dattastava mahāsattva śrīmān śatrunibarhaṇa .. 6.103.11 ..
idamaindraṃ mahaccāpaṃ kavacaṃ cāgnisannibham .śarāścādityasaṅkāśāḥ śaktiśca vimalā śitā .. 6.103.12 ..
āruhyemaṃ rathaṃ vīra rākṣasaṃ jahi rāvaṇam .mayā sārathinā rājan mahendra iva dānavān .. 6.103.13 ..
ityuktaḥ samparikramya rathaṃ samabhivādya ca .āruroha tadā rāmo lokān lakṣmyā virājayan .. 6.103.14 ..
tadbabhūvādbhutaṃ yuddhaṃ tumulaṃ romaharṣaṇam .rāmasya ca mahābāho rāvaṇasya ca rakṣasaḥ .. 6.103.15 ..
sa gāndharveṇa gāndharvaṃ daivaṃ daivena rāghavaḥ .astraṃ rākṣasarājasya jaghāna paramāstravit .. 6.103.16 ..
astraṃ tu paramaṃ ghoraṃ rākṣasaṃ rākṣasādhipaḥ .sasarja paramakruddhaḥ punareva niśācaraḥ .. 6.103.17 ..
te rāvaṇadhanurmuktāḥ śarāḥ kāñcanabhūṣaṇāḥ .abhyavartanta kākutsthaṃ sarpā bhūtvā mahāviṣāḥ .. 6.103.18 ..
te dīptavadanā dīptaṃ vamanto jvalanaṃ mukhaiḥ .rāmamevābhyavartanta vyāditāsyā bhayānakāḥ .. 6.103.19 ..
tairvāsukisamasparśairdīptabhogairmahāviṣaiḥ .diśaśca santatāḥ sarvāḥ pradiśaśca samāvṛtāḥ .. 6.103.20 ..
tān dṛṣṭvā pannagān rāmaḥ samāpatata āhave .astraṃ gārutmataṃ ghoraṃ prāduścake bhayāvaham .. 6.103.21 ..
te rāghavaśarā muktā rukmapuṅkhāḥ śikhiprabhāḥ .suparṇāḥ kāñcanā bhūtvā viceruḥ sarpaśatravaḥ .. 6.103.22 ..
te tān sarvān śarān jaghnuḥ sarparūpān mahājavān .suparṇarūpā rāmasya viśikhāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ .. 6.103.23 ..
astre pratihate kruddho rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ .abhyavarṣattadā rāmaṃ ghorābhiḥ śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ .. 6.103.24 ..
tataḥ śarasahasreṇa rāmamakliṣṭakāriṇam .ardayitvā śaraugheṇa mātaliṃ pratyavidhyata .. 6.103.25 ..
ciccheda ketumuddhiśya śareṇaikena rāvaṇaḥ .pātayitvā rathopasthe rathāt ketuṃ ca kāñcanam .aindrānapi jaghānāśvān śarajālena rāvaṇaḥ .. 6.103.26 ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sumahatkarma rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ .viṣedurdevagandharvā dānavāścāraṇaiḥ saha .. 6.103.27 ..
rāmamārtaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ .vyathitā vānarendrāśca babhūvuḥ savibhīṣaṇāḥ .. 6.103.28 ..
rāmacandramasaṃ dṛṣṭvā grastaṃ rāvaṇarāhuṇā .prājāpatyaṃ ca nakṣatraṃ rohiṇīṃ śaśinaḥ priyām .. 6.103.29 ..
samākramya budhastasthau prajānāmaśubhāvahaḥ .. 6.103.30 ..
sadhūmaparivṛttormiḥ prajvalanniva sāgaraḥ .utpapāta tadā kruddhaḥ spṛśanniva divākaram .. 6.103.31 ..
śastravarṇaḥ suparuṣo mandaraśmirdivākaraḥ .adṛśyata kabandhāṅkaḥ saṃsakto dhūmaketunā .. 6.103.32 ..
kosalānāṃ ca nakṣatraṃ vyaktamindrāgnidaivatam .ākramyāṅgārakastasthau viśākhāmapi cāmbare .. 6.103.33 ..
daśāsyo viṃśatibhujaḥ pragṛhītaśarāsanaḥ .adṛśyata daśagrīvo maināka iva parvataḥ .. 6.103.34 ..
nirasyamāno rāmastu daśagrīveṇa rakṣasā .nāśaknodabhisandhātuṃ sāyakān raṇamūrdhani .. 6.103.35 ..
sa kṛtvā bhrukuṭiṃ kruddhaḥ kiñcit saṃraktalocanaḥ .jagāma sumahākrodhaṃ nirdahanniva cakṣuṣā .. 6.103.36 ..
ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe tryuttaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ .. 103 ..
tasya kruddhasya vadanaṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmasya dhīmataḥ .sarvabhūtāni vitresuḥ prākampata ca medinī .. 6.104.1 ..
siṃhaśārdūlavān śailaḥ sañcacāla caladrumaḥ .babhūva cātikṣubhitaḥ samudraḥ saritāṃ patiḥ .. 6.104.2 ..
khagāśca kharanirghoṣā gagane paruṣā ghanāḥ .autpātikāni nardantaḥ samantāt paricakramuḥ .. 6.104.3 ..
rāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā susaṅkruddhamutpātāṃśca sudāruṇān .vitresuḥ sarvabhūtāni rāvaṇasyābhavadbhayem .. 6.104.4 ..
vimānasthāstadā devā gandharvāśca mahoragāḥ .ṛṣidānavadaityāśca garutmantaśca khecarāḥ .. 6.104.5 ..
dadṛśuste mahāyuddhaṃ lokasaṃvartasaṃsthitam .nānāpraharaṇairbhīmaiḥ śūrayoḥ samprayuddhyatoḥ .. 6.104.6 ..
ūcuḥ surāsurāḥ sarve tadā vigrahamāgatāḥ .prekṣamāṇā mahadyuddhaṃ vākyaṃ bhaktyā prahṛṣṭavat .. 6.104.7 ..
daśagrīvaṃ jayetyāhurasurāḥ samavasthitāḥ .devā rāmamathocuste tvaṃ jayeti punaḥpunaḥ .. 6.104.8 ..
etasminnantare krodhādrāghavasya sa rāvaṇaḥ .prahartukāmo duṣṭātmā spṛśan praharaṇaṃ mahat .. 6.104.9 ..
vajrasāraṃ mahānādaṃ sarvaśatrunibarhaṇam .śailaśṛṅganibhaiḥ kūṭaiścitaṃ dṛṣṭibhayāvaham .. 6.104.10 ..
sadhūmamiva tīkṣṇāgraṃ yugāntāgnicayopamam .atiraudramanāsādyaṃ kālenāpi durāsadam .. 6.104.11 ..
trāsanaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ dāraṇaṃ bhedanaṃ tadā .pradīptamiva roṣeṇa śūlaṃ jagrāha rāvaṇaḥ .. 6.104.12 ..
tacchūlaṃ paramakruddho madhye jagrāha vīryavān .anekaiḥ samare śūrai rākṣasaiḥ parivāritaḥ .. 6.104.13 ..
samudyamya mahākāyo nanāda yudhi bhairavam .saṃraktanayano roṣāt svasainyamabhiharṣayan .. 6.104.14 ..
pṛthivīṃ cāntarikṣaṃ ca diśaśca pradiśastathā .prākampayattadā śabdo rākṣasendrasya dāruṇaḥ .. 6.104.15 ..
atinādasya nādena tena tasya durātmanaḥ .sarvabhūtāni vitresuḥ sāgaraśca pracukṣubhe .. 6.104.16 ..
sa gṛhītvā mahāvīryaḥ śūlaṃ tadrāvaṇo mahat .vinadya sumahānādaṃ rāmaṃ paruṣamabravīt .. 6.104.17 ..
śūlo 'yaṃ vajrasāraste rāma roṣānmayodyataḥ .tava bhrātṛsahāyasya sadyaḥ prāṇān hariṣyati .. 6.104.18 ..
rakṣasāmadya śūrāṇāṃ nihatānāṃ camūmukhe .tvāṃ nihatya raṇaślāghin karomi tarasā samam .tiṣṭhedānīṃ nihanmi tvāmeṣa śūlena rāghava .. 6.104.19 ..
evamuktvā sa cikṣepa tacchūlaṃ rākṣasādhipaḥ .. 6.104.20 ..
tadrāvaṇakarānmuktaṃ vidyujjvālāsamākulam .aṣṭaghaṇṭaṃ mahānādaṃ viyadgatamaśobhata .. 6.104.21 ..
tacchūlaṃ rāghavo dṛṣṭvā jvalantaṃ ghoradarśanam .sasarja viśikhān rāmaścāpamāyamya vīryavān .. 6.104.22 ..
āpatantaṃ śaraugheṇa vārayāmāsa rāghavaḥ .utpatantaṃ yugāntāgniṃ jalaughairiva vāsavaḥ .. 6.104.23 ..
nirdadāha sa tān bāṇān rāmakārmukanissṛtān .rāvaṇasya mahāśūlaḥ pataṅgāniva pāvakaḥ .. 6.104.24 ..
tān dṛṣṭvā bhasmasādbhūtān śūla saṃsparśacūrṇitān .sāyakānantarikṣasthān rāghavaḥ krodhamāharat .. 6.104.25 ..
sa tāṃ mātalinā ' 'nītāṃ śaktiṃ vāsavanirmitām .jagrāha paramakruddho rāghavo raghunandanaḥ .. 6.104.26 ..
sā tolitā balavatā śaktirghaṇṭākṛtasvanā .nabhaḥ prajvālayāmāsa yugāntolkeva saprabhā .. 6.104.27 ..
sā kṣiptā rākṣasendrasya tasmin śūle papāta ha .bhinnaḥ śaktyā mahān śūlo nipapāta hatadyutiḥ .. 6.104.28 ..
nirbibheda tato bāṇairhayānasya mahājavān .rāmastīkṣṇairmahāvegairvajrakalpaiḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ .. 6.104.29 ..
nirbibhedorasi tato rāvaṇaṃ niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ .rāghavaḥ paramāyatto lalāṭe patribhistribhiḥ .. 6.104.30 ..
sa śarairbhinnasarvāṅgo gātraprasrutaśoṇitaḥ .rākṣasendraḥ samūhasthaḥ phullāśoka ivābabhau .. 6.104.31 ..
sa rāmabāṇairabhividdhagātro niśācarendraḥ kṣatajārdragātraḥ .jagāma khedaṃ ca samājamadhye krodhaṃ ca cakre subhṛśaṃ tadānīm .. 6.104.32 ..
ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe caturuttaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ .. 104 ..
sa tena tu tathā krodhāt kākutsthenārdito raṇe .rāvaṇaḥ samaraślāghī mahākrodhamupāgamat .. 6.105.1 ..
sa dīptanayano roṣāccāpamāyamya vīryavān .abhyardayat susaṅkruddho rāghavaṃ paramāhave .. 6.105.2 ..
bāṇadhārāsahasraistaiḥ sa toyada ivāmbarāt .rāghavaṃ rāvaṇo bāṇaistaṭākamiva pūrayat .. 6.105.3 ..
pūritaḥ śarajālena dhanurmuktena saṃyuge .mahāgiririvākampyaḥ kākutstho na prakampate .. 6.105.4 ..
sa śaraiḥ śarajālāni vārayan samare sthitaḥ .gabhastīniva sūryasya pratijagrāha vīryavān .. 6.105.5 ..
tataḥ śarasahasrāṇi kṣiprahasto niśācaraḥ .nijaghānorasi kruddho rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ .. 6.105.6 ..
sa śoṇita samādigdhaḥ samare lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ .dṛṣṭaḥ phulla ivāraṇye sumahān kiṃśukadrumaḥ .. 6.105.7 ..
śarābhighātasaṃrabdhaḥ so 'pi jagrāha sāyakān .kākutsthaḥ sumahātejā yugāntādityatejasaḥ .. 6.105.8 ..
tato 'yonyaṃ susaṃrabdhāvubhau tau rāmarāvaṇau .śarāndhakāre samare nopālakṣayatāṃ tadā .. 6.105.9 ..
tataḥ krodhasamāviṣṭo rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ .uvāca rāvaṇaṃ vīraḥ prahasya paruṣaṃ vacaḥ .. 6.105.10 ..
mama bhāryā janasthānādajñānādrākṣasādhama .hṛtā te vivaśā yasmāttasmāttvaṃ nāsi vīryavān .. 6.105.11 ..
mayā virahitāṃ dīnāṃ vartamānāṃ mahāvane .vaidehīṃ prasabhaṃ hṛtvā śūro 'hamiti manyase .. 6.105.12 ..
strīṣu śūra vināthāsu paradārābhimarśaka .kṛtvā kāpuruṣaṃ karma śūro 'hamiti manyase .. 6.105.13 ..
bhinnamaryāda nirlajja cāritreṣvanavasthita .darpānmṛtyumupādāya śūro 'hamiti manyase .. 6.105.14 ..
śūreṇa dhanadabhrātrā balaiḥ samuditena ca .ślāghanīyaṃ yaśasyaṃ ca kṛtaṃ karma mahattvayā .. 6.105.15 ..
utsekenābhipannasya garhitasyāhitasya ca .karmaṇaḥ prāpnuhīdānīṃ tasyādya sumahat phalam .. 6.105.16 ..
śūro 'hamiti cātmānamavagacchasi durmate .naiva lajjā 'sti te sītāṃ coravad vyapakarṣataḥ .. 6.105.17 ..
yadi matsannidhau sītā dharṣitā syāttvayā balāt .bhrātaraṃ tu kharaṃ paśyestadā matsāyakairhataḥ .. 6.105.18 ..
diṣṭyā 'si mama duṣṭātmaṃścakṣurviṣayamāgataḥ .adya tvāṃ sāyakaistīkṣṇairnayāmi yamasādanam .. 6.105.19 ..
adya te maccharaiśchinnaṃ śiro jvalitakuṇḍalam .kravyādā vyapakarṣantu vikīrṇaṃ raṇapāṃsuṣu .. 6.105.20 ..
nipatyorasi gṛdhrāste kṣitau kṣiptasya rāvaṇa .pibantu rudhiraṃ tarṣāccharaśalyāntarotthitam .. 6.105.21 ..
adya madbāṇabhinnasya gatāsoḥ patitasya te .karṣantvantrāṇi patagā garutmanta ivoragān .. 6.105.22 ..
ityevaṃ saṃvadan vīro rāmaḥ śatrunibarhaṇaḥ .rākṣasendraṃ samīpasthaṃ śaravarṣairavākirat .. 6.105.23 ..
babhūva dviguṇaṃ vīryaṃ balaṃ harṣaśca saṃyuge .rāmasyāstrabalaṃ caiva śatrornidhanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ .. 6.105.24 ..
prādurbabhūvurastrāṇi sarvāṇi viditātmanaḥ .praharṣācca mahātejāḥ śīghrahastataro 'bhavat .. 6.105.25 ..
śubhānyetāni cihnāni vijñāyātmagatāni saḥ .bhūya evārdayadrāmo rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasāntakṛt .. 6.105.26 ..
harīṇāṃ cāśmanikaraiḥ śaravarṣaiśca rāghavāt .hanyamāno daśagrīvo vighūrṇahṛdayo 'bhavat .. 6.105.27 ..
yadā ca śastraṃ nārebhe na vyakarṣaccharāsanam .nāsya pratyakarodvīryaṃ viklevenāntarātmanā .. 6.105.28 ..
kṣiptāścāpi śarāstena śastrāṇi vividhāni ca .na raṇārthāya vartante mṛtyukāle 'bhivartataḥ .. 6.105.29 ..
sūtastu rathanetā 'sya tadavasthaṃ samīkṣya tam .śanairyuddhādasambhrānto rathaṃ tasyāpavāhayat .. 6.105.30 ..
ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe pañcottaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ .. 105 ..
sa tu mohāt susaṅkruddhaḥ kṛtāntabalacoditaḥ .krodhasaṃraktanayano rāvaṇaḥ sūtamabravīt .. 6.106.1 ..
hīnavīryamivāśaktaṃ pauruṣeṇa vivarjitam .bhīruṃ laghumivāsattvaṃ vihīnamiva tejasā .. 6.106.2 ..
vimuktamiva māyābhirastrairiva bahiṣkṛtam .māmavajñāya durbuddhe svayā buddhyā viceṣṭase .. 6.106.3 ..
kimarthaṃ māmavajñāya macchandamanavekṣya ca .tvayā śatroḥ samakṣaṃ me ratho 'yamapavāhitaḥ .. 6.106.4 ..
tvayā 'dya hi mamānārya cirakālasamārjitam .yaśo vīryaṃ ca tejaśca pratyayaśca vināśitaḥ .. 6.106.5 ..
śatroḥ prakhyātavīryasya rañjanīyasya vikramaiḥ .paśyato yuddhalubdho 'haṃ kṛtaḥ kāpuruṣastvayā .. 6.106.6 ..
yastvaṃ rathamimaṃ mohāt na codvahasi durmate .satyo 'yaṃ pratitarko me pareṇa tvamupaskṛtaḥ .. 6.106.7 ..
na hi tadvidyate karma suhṛdo hitakāṅkṣiṇaḥ .ripūṇāṃ sadṛśaṃ caitanna tvayaitat svanuṣṭhitam .. 6.106.8 ..
nivartaya rathaṃ śīghraṃ yāvannopaiti me ripuḥ .yadi vā 'dhyuṣito vā 'si smaryante yadi vā guṇāḥ .. 6.106.9 ..
evaṃ paruṣamuktastu hitabuddhirabuddhinā .abravīdrāvaṇaṃ sūto hitaṃ sānunayaṃ vacaḥ .. 6.106.10 ..
na bhīto 'smi na mūḍho 'smi nopajapto 'smi śatrubhiḥ .na pramatto na nisneho vismṛtā na ca satkriyā .. 6.106.11 ..
mayā tu hitakāmena yaśaśca parirakṣatā .snehapraskannamanasā priyamityapriyaṃ kṛtam .. 6.106.12 ..
nāsminnarthe mahārāja tvaṃ māṃ priyahite ratam .kaścillaghurivānāryo doṣato gantumarhasi .. 6.106.13 ..
śrūyatāṃ tvabhidhāsyāmi yannimittaṃ mayā rathaḥ .nadīvega ivābhoge saṃyuge vinivartitaḥ .. 6.106.14 ..
kṣamaṃ tavāvagacchāmi mahatā raṇakarmaṇā .na hi te vīra saumukhyaṃ praharṣaṃ vopadhāraye .. 6.106.15 ..
rathodvahanakhinnāśca ta ime rathavājinaḥ .dīnā dharmapariśrāntā gāvo varṣahatā iva .. 6.106.16 ..
nimittāni ca bhūyiṣṭhaṃ yāni prādurbhavanti naḥ .teṣu teṣvabhipanneṣu lakṣayāmyapradakṣiṇam .. 6.106.17 ..
deśakālau ca vijñeyau lakṣaṇānīṅgītāni ca .dainyaṃ khedaśca harṣaśca rathinaśca balābalam .. 6.106.18 ..
sthalanimnāni bhūmeśca samāni viṣamāṇi ca .yuddhakālaśca vijñeyaḥ parasyāntaradarśanam .. 6.106.19 ..
upayānāpayāne ca sthānaṃ pratyapasarpaṇam .sarvametadrathasthena jñeyaṃ rathakuṭumbinā .. 6.106.20 ..
tava viśramahetośca tathaiṣāṃ rathavājinām .raudraṃ varjayatā khedaṃ kṣamaṃ kṛtamidaṃ mayā .. 6.106.21 ..
na mayā svecchayā vīra ratho 'yamapavāhitaḥ .. 6.106.22 ..
bhartṛsnehaparītena mayedaṃ yatkṛtaṃ vibho .. 6.106.23 ..
ājñāpaya yathātattvaṃ vakṣyasyariniṣūdana .tatkariṣyāmyahaṃ vīra gatānṛṇyena cetasā .. 6.106.24 ..
santuṣṭastena vākyena rāvaṇastasya sāratheḥ .praśasyainaṃ bahuvidhaṃ yuddhalubdho 'bravīdidam .. 6.106.25 ..
rathaṃ śīghramimaṃ sūta rāghavābhimukhaṃ kuru .nāhatvā samare śatrūn nivartiṣyati rāvaṇaḥ .. 6.106.26 ..
evamuktvā tatastuṣṭo rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ .dadau tasmai śubhaṃ hyekaṃ hastābharaṇamuttamam .. 6.106.27 ..
śrutvā rāvaṇavākyaṃ tu sārathiḥ sannyavartata .. 6.106.28 ..
tato drutaṃ rāvaṇavākyacoditaḥ pracodayāmāsa hayān sa sārathiḥ .sa rākṣasendrasya tato mahārathaḥ kṣaṇena rāmasya raṇāgrato 'bhavat .. 6.106.29 ..
ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe ṣaḍuttaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ .. 106 ..
.. ādityahṛdayaprārambhaḥ ..tato yuddhapariśrantaṃ samare cintayā sthitam .rāvaṇaṃ cāgrato dṛṣṭvā yuddhāya samupasthitam .. 6.107.1 ..
daivataiśca samāgamya draṣṭumabhyāgato raṇam .upāgamyābravīdrāmamagastyo bhagavānṛṣiḥ .. 6.107.2 ..
rāma rāma mahābāho śṛṇu guhyaṃ sanātanam .yena sarvānarīn vatsa samare vijayiṣyasi .. 6.107.3 ..
ādityahṛdayaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaśatruvināśanam .jayāvahaṃ japennityamakṣayyaṃ paramaṃ śivam .. 6.107.4 ..
sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .cintāśokapraśamanamāyurvardhanamuttamam .. 6.107.5 ..
raśmimantaṃ samudyantaṃ devāsuranamaskṛtam .pūjayasva vivasvantaṃ bhāskaraṃ bhuvaneśvaram .. 6.107.6 ..
sarvadevātmako hyeṣa tejasvī raśmibhāvanaḥ .eṣa devāsuragaṇān lokān pāti gabhistibhiḥ .. 6.107.7 ..
eṣa brahmā ca viṣṇuśca śivaḥ skandaḥ prajāpatiḥ .mahendro dhanadaḥ kālo yamaḥ somo hyapāṃ patiḥ .. 6.107.8 ..
pitaro vasavaḥ sādhyā hyaśvinau maruto manuḥ .vāyurvahniḥ prajāpāṇa ṛtukartā prabhākaraḥ .. 6.107.9 ..
ādityaḥ savitā sūryaḥ khagaḥ pūṣā gabhastimān .suvarṇasadṛśo bhānurhiraṇyaretā divākaraḥ .. 6.107.10 ..
haridaśvaḥ sahasrārciḥ saptasaptirmarīcimān .timironmathanaḥ śambhustvaṣṭā mārtaṇḍa aṃśumān .. 6.107.11 ..
hiraṇyagarbhaḥ śiśirastapano bhāskaro raviḥ .agnigarbho 'diteḥ putraḥ śaṅkhaḥ śiśiranāśanaḥ .. 6.107.12 ..
vyomanāthastamobhedī ṛgyajussāmapāragaḥ .ghanavṛṣṭirapāṃ mitro vindhyavīthīplavaṅgamaḥ .. 6.107.13 ..
ātapī maṇḍalī mṛtyuḥ piṅgalaḥ sarvatāpanaḥ .kavirviśvo mahātejā raktaḥ sarvabhavodbhavaḥ .. 6.107.14 ..
nakṣatragrahatārāṇāmadhipo viśvabhāvanaḥ .tejasāmapi tejasvī dvādaśātmannamo 'stu te .. 6.107.15 ..
namaḥ pūrvāya giraye paścime giraye namaḥ .jyotirgaṇānāṃ pataye dinādhipataye namaḥ .. 6.107.16 ..
jayāya jayabhadrāya haryaśvāya namo namaḥ .namo namaḥ sahasrāṃśo ādityāya namo namaḥ .. 6.107.17 ..
nama ugrāya vīrāya sāraṅgāya namo namaḥ .namaḥ padmaprabodhāya mārtāṇḍāya namo namaḥ .. 6.107.18 ..
brahmośānācyuteśāya sūryāyādityavarcase .bhāsvate sarvabhakṣāya raudrāya vapuṣe namaḥ .. 6.107.19 ..
tamoghnāya himadhnāya śatrughnāyāmitātmane .kṛtaghnaghnāya devāya jyotiṣāṃ pataye namaḥ .. 6.107.20 ..
taptacāmīkarābhāya vahnaye viśvakarmaṇe .namastamobhinighnāya rucaye lokasākṣiṇe .. 6.107.21 ..
nāśayatyeṣa vai bhūtaṃ tadeva sṛjati prabhuḥ .pāyatyeṣa tapatyeṣa varṣatyeṣa gabhastibhiḥ .. 6.107.22 ..
eṣa supteṣu jāgarti bhūteṣu pariniṣṭhitaḥ .eṣa evāgnihotraṃ ca phalaṃ caivāgnihotriṇām .. 6.107.23 ..
vedāśca kratavaścaiva kratūnāṃ phalameva ca .yāni kṛtyāni lokeṣu sarva eṣa raviḥ prabhuḥ .. 6.107.24 ..
enamāpatsu kṛcchreṣu kāntāreṣu bhayeṣu ca .kīrtayan puruṣaḥ kaścinnāvasīdati rāghava .. 6.107.25 ..
pūjayasvainamekāgro devadevaṃ jagatpatim .etatriguṇitaṃ japtvā yuddheṣu vijayiṣyasi .. 6.107.26 ..
asmin kṣaṇe mahābāho rāvaṇaṃ tvaṃ vadhiṣyasi .evamuktvā tadā 'gastyo jagāma ca yathāgatam .. 6.107.27 ..
etacchutvā mahātejā naṣṭaśoko 'bhavattadā .dhārayāmāsa suprīto rāghavaḥ prayatātmavān .. 6.107.28 ..
ādityaṃ prekṣya japtvā tu paraṃ harṣamavāptavān .trirācamya śucirbhūtvā dhanurādāya vīryavān .. 6.107.29 ..
rāvaṇaṃ prekṣya hṛṣṭātmā yuddhāya samupāgamat .sarvayatnena mahatā vadhe tasya dhṛto 'bhavat .. 6.107.30 ..
atha raviravadannirīkṣya rāmaṃ muditamanāḥ paramaṃ prahṛṣyamāṇaḥ .niśicarapatisaṅkṣayaṃ viditvā suragaṇamadhyagato vacastvareti .. 6.107.31 ..
ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe saptottaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ .. 107 ..
sa rathaṃ sārathirhṛṣṭaḥ parasainyapradharṣaṇam .gandharvanagarākāraṃ samucchritapatākinam .. 6.108.1 ..
yuktaṃ paramasampannairvājibhirhemamālibhiḥ .yuddhopakaraṇaiḥ pūrṇaṃ patākādhvajamālinam .. 6.108.2 ..
grasantamiva cākāśaṃ nādayantaṃ vasundharām .praṇāśaṃ parasainyānāṃ svasainyānāṃ praharṣaṇam .rāvaṇasya rathaṃ kṣipraṃ codayāmāsa sārathiḥ .. 6.108.3 ..

tamāpatantaṃ sahasā svanavantaṃ mahāsvanam .rathaṃ rākṣasarājasya nararājo dadarśa ha .. 6.108.4 .. .kṛṣṇavājisamāyuktaṃ yuktaṃ raudreṇa varcasā .taḍitpatākāgahanaṃ darśitendrāyudhāyudham .. 6.108.5 ..
śaradhārā vimuñcantaṃ dhārāsāramivāmbudam .taṃ dṛṣṭvā meghasaṅkāśamāpatantaṃ rathaṃ ripoḥ .. 6.108.6 ..
girairvajrābhimṛṣṭasya dīryataḥ sadṛśasvanam .visphārayan vai vegena bālacandranataṃ dhanuḥ .. 6.108.7 ..
uvāca mātaliṃ rāmaḥ sahasrākṣasya sārathim .. 6.108.8 ..
mātale paśya saṃrabdhamāpatantaṃ rathaṃ ripoḥ .. 6.108.9 ..
yathā ' 'pasavyaṃ patatā vegena mahatā punaḥ .samare hantumātmānaṃ tathā tena kṛtā matiḥ .. 6.108.10 ..
tadapramādamātiṣṭhan pratyudgaccha rathaṃ ripoḥ .vidhvaṃsayitumicchāmi vāyurmeghamivotthitam .. 6.108.11 ..
aviklavamasambhrāntamavyagrahṛdayekṣaṇam .raśmisañcāraniyataṃ pracodaya rathaṃ drutam .. 6.108.12 ..
kāmaṃ na tvaṃ samādheyaḥ purandararathocitaḥ .yuyutsurahamekāgraḥ smāraye tvāṃ na śikṣaye .. 6.108.13 ..
parituṣṭaḥ sa rāmasya tena vākyena mātaliḥ .pracodayāmāsa rathaṃ surasārathisattamaḥ .. 6.108.14 ..
apasavyaṃ tataḥ kurvan rāvaṇasya mahāratham .cakrotkṣiptena rajasā rāvaṇaṃ vyavadhānayat .. 6.108.15 ..
tataḥ kruddho daśagrīvastāmravisphāritekṣaṇaḥ .rathapratimukhaṃ rāmaṃ sāyakairavadhūnayat .. 6.108.16 ..
dharṣaṇāmarṣito rāmo dhairyaṃ roṣeṇa lambhayan .jagrāha sumahāvegamaindraṃ yudhi śarāsanam .śarāṃśca sumahātejāḥ sūryaraśmisamaprabhān .. 6.108.17 ..
tadopoḍhaṃ mahadyuddhamanyonyavadhakāṅkṣiṇoḥ .parasparābhimukhayordṛptayoriva siṃhayoḥ .. 6.108.18 ..
tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ .sameyurdvairathaṃ dṛṣṭuṃ rāvaṇakṣayakāṅkṣiṇaḥ .. 6.108.19 ..
samutpeturathotpātā dāruṇā romaharṣaṇāḥ .rāvaṇasya vināśāya rāghavasya jayāya ca .. 6.108.20 ..
vavarṣa rudhiraṃ devo rāvaṇasya rathopari .vātā maṇḍalinastīkṣṇā hyapasavyaṃ pracakramuḥ .. 6.108.21 ..
mahad gṛdhrakulaṃ cāsya bhramamāṇaṃ nabhassthale .yena yena ratho yāti tena tena pradhāvati .. 6.108.22 ..
sandhyayā cāvṛtā laṅkā japāpuṣpanikāśayā .dṛśyate sampradīpteva divase 'pi vasundharā .. 6.108.23 ..
sanirghātā maholkāśca sampracerurmahāsvanāḥ .viṣādayaṃste rakṣāṃsi rāvaṇasya tadā 'hitāḥ .. 6.108.24 ..
rāvaṇaśca yatastatra sañcacāla vasundharā .rakṣasāṃ ca praharatāṃ gṛhītā iva bāhavaḥ .. 6.108.25 ..
tāmrāḥ pītāḥ sitāśvetāḥ patitāḥ sūryaraśmayaḥ .dṛśyante rāvaṇasyāṅge parvatasyeva dhātavaḥ .. 6.108.26 ..
gṛdhrairanugatāścāsya vamantyo jvalanaṃ mukhaiḥ .praṇedurmukhamīkṣantyaḥ saṃrabdhamaśivaṃ śivāḥ .. 6.108.27 ..
pratikūlaṃ vavau vāyū raṇe pāṃsūn samākiran .tasya rākṣasarājasya kurvan dṛṣṭivilopanam .. 6.108.28 ..
nipeturindrāśanayaḥ sainye cāsya samantataḥ .durviṣahyasvanā ghorā vinā jaladharasvanam .. 6.108.29 ..
diśaśca pradiśaḥ sarvā babhūvustimirāvṛtāḥ .pāṃsuvarṣeṇa mahatā durdarśaṃ ca nabho 'bhavat .. 6.108.30 ..
kurvantyaḥ kalahaṃ ghoraṃ śārikāstadrathaṃ prati .nipetuḥ śataśastatra dāruṇaṃ dāruṇārutāḥ .. 6.108.31 ..
jaghanebhyaḥ sphuliṅgāṃśca netrebhyo 'śrūṇi santatam .mumucustasya turagāstulyamagniṃ ca vāri ca .. 6.108.32 ..
evamprakārā bahavaḥ samutpātā bhayāvahāḥ .rāvaṇasya vināśāya dāruṇāḥ samprajajñire .. 6.108.33 ..
rāmasyāpi nimittāni saumyāni ca śubhāni ca .babhūvurjayaśaṃsīni prādurbhūtāni sarvaśaḥ .. 6.108.34 ..
nimittāni ca saumyāni rāghavaḥ svajayāya ca .dṛṣṭvā paramasaṃhṛṣṭo hataṃ mene ca rāvaṇam .. 6.108.35 ..
tato nirīkṣyātmagatāni rāghavo raṇe nimittāni nimittakovidaḥ .jagāma harṣaṃ ca parāṃ ca nirvṛttiṃ cakāra yuddhe hyadhikaṃ ca vikramam .. 6.108.36 ..
ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe aṣṭottaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ .. 108 ..
tataḥ pravṛttaṃ sukrūraṃ rāmarāvaṇayostadā .sumahaddvairathaṃ yuddhaṃ sarvalokabhayāvaham .. 6.109.1 ..
tato rākṣasasainyaṃ ca harīṇāṃ ca mahadbalam .pragṛhītapraharaṇaṃ niśceṣṭaṃ samatiṣṭhata .. 6.109.2 ..
samprayuddhau tato dṛṣṭvā balavannararākṣasau .vyākṣiptahṛdayāḥ sarve paraṃ vismayamāgatāḥ .. 6.109.3 ..
nānāpraharaṇairvyagrairbhujairvismitabuddhayaḥ .sarpantaṃ prekṣya saṅgrāmaṃ nābhijagmuḥ parasparam .. 6.109.4 ..
rakṣasāṃ rāvaṇaṃ cāpi vānarāṇāṃ ca rāghavam .paśyatāṃ vismitākṣāṇāṃ sainyaṃ citramivābabhau .. 6.109.5 ..
tau tu tatra nimittāni dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇarāghavau .kṛtabuddhī sthirāmarṣau yuyudhāte byabhītavat .. 6.109.6 ..
jetavyamiti kākutstho martavyamiti rāvaṇaḥ .dhṛtau svavīryasarvasvaṃ yuddhe 'darśayatāṃ tadā .. 6.109.7 ..
tataḥ krodhāddaśagrīvaḥ śarān sandhāya vīryavān .mumoca dhvajamuddiśya rāghavasya rathe sthitam .. 6.109.8 ..
te śarāstamanāsādya purandararathadhvajam .rathaśaktiṃ parāmṛśya nipeturdharaṇītale .. 6.109.9 ..
tato rāmo 'bhisaṅkruddhaścāpamāyamya vīryavān .kṛtapratikṛtaṃ kartuṃ manasā sampracakrame .. 6.109.10 ..
rāvaṇadhvajamuddiśya mumoca niśitaṃ śaram .mahāsarpamivāsahyaṃ jvalantaṃ svena tejasā .. 6.109.11 ..
jagāma sa mahīṃ chittvā daśagrīvadhvajaṃ śaraḥ .sa nikṛtto 'patadbhūmau rāvaṇasya rathadhvajaḥ .. 6.109.12 ..
dhvajasyonmathanaṃ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇaḥ sumahābalaḥ .sampradīpto 'bhavat krodhādamarṣāt pradahanniva .. 6.109.13 ..
sa roṣavaśamāpannaḥ śaravarṣaṃ mahadvaman .rāmasya turagān dīptaiḥ śarairvivyādha rāvaṇaḥ .. 6.109.14 ..
te viddhā harayastatra nāskhalannāpi babhramuḥ .babhūvuḥ svasthahṛdayāḥ padmanālairivāhatāḥ .. 6.109.15 ..
teṣāmasambhramaṃ dṛṣṭvā vājināṃ rāvaṇastadā .bhūya eva susaṅkruddhaḥ śaravarṣaṃ mumoca ha .. 6.109.16 ..
gadāśca parighāścaiva cakrāṇi musalāni ca .giriśṛṅgāṇi vṛkṣāṃśca tathā śūlaparaśvadhān .. 6.109.17 ..
māyāvihitametattu śastravarṣamapātayat .tumulaṃ trāsajananaṃ bhīmaṃ bhīmapratisvanam .. 6.109.18 ..
tadvarṣamabhavadyuddhe naikaśastramayaṃ mahat .vimucya rāghavarathaṃ samāntādvānare bale .. 6.109.19 ..
sāyakairantarikṣaṃ ca cakārāśu nirantaram .sahasraśastato bāṇānaśrāntahṛdayodyamaḥ .mumoca ca daśagrīvo nissaṅgenā 'ntarātmanā .. 6.109.20 ..
vyāyacchamānaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā tatparaṃ rāvaṇaṃ raṇe .prahasanniva kākutsthaḥ sandadhe sāyakān śitān .. 6.109.21 ..
sa mumoca tato bāṇān raṇe śatasahasraśaḥ .tān dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇaścakre svaśaraiḥ khaṃ nirantaram .. 6.109.22 ..
tatastābhyāṃ pramuktena śaravarṣeṇa bhāsvatā .śarabaddhamivābhāti dvitīyaṃ bhāsvadambaram .. 6.109.23 ..
nānimitto 'bhavadbāṇo nātibhettā na niṣphalaḥ .. 6.109.24 ..
anyonyamabhisaṃhatya nipeturdharaṇītale .tathā visṛjatorbāṇān rāmarāvaṇayormṛdhe .. 6.109.25 ..
prāyuddhyatāmavicchinnamasyantau savyadakṣiṇam .cakratuśca śaraughaistau nirucchvāsamivāmbaram .. 6.109.26 ..
rāvaṇasya hayān rāmo hayān rāmasya rāvaṇaḥ .jaghnatustau tathā 'nyonyaṃ kṛtānukṛtakāriṇau .. 6.109.27 ..
evaṃ tau tu susaṅkruddhau cakraturyuddhamadbhutam .muhūrtamabhavadyuddhaṃ tumulaṃ romaharṣaṇam .. 6.109.28 ..
prayudhyamānau samare mahābalau śitaiḥ śarai rāvaṇalakṣmaṇāgrajau .dhvajāvapātena sa rākṣasādhipo bhṛśaṃ pracukrodha tadā raghūttame .. 6.109.29 ..
ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe navottaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ .. 109 ..
tau tadā yuddhyamānau tu samare rāmarāvaṇau .dadṛśuḥ sarvabhūtāni vismitenāntarātmanā .. 6.110.1 ..
ardayantau tu samare tayostau syandanottamau .parasparamabhikruddhau parasparamabhidrutau .. 6.110.2 ..
parasparavadhe yuktau ghorarūpau babhūvatuḥ .maṇḍalāni ca vīthīśca gatapratyāgatāni ca .darśayantau bahuvidhāṃ sūtasārathyajāṃ gatim .. 6.110.3 ..
ardayan rāvaṇaṃ rāmo rāghavaṃ cāpi rāvaṇaḥ .gativegaṃ samāpannau pravartananivartane .. 6.110.4 ..
kṣipatoḥ śarajālāni tayostau syandanottamau .ceratuḥ saṃyugamahīṃ sāsārau jaladau yathā .. 6.110.5 ..
darśayitvā tathā tau tu gatiṃ bahuvidhāṃ raṇe .parasparasyābhimukhau punarevāvatasthatuḥ .. 6.110.6 ..
dhuraṃ dhureṇa rathayorvaktraṃ vaktreṇa vājinām .patākāśca patākābhiḥ sameyuḥ sthitayostadā .. 6.110.7 ..
rāvaṇasya tato rāmo dhanurmuktaiḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ .caturbhiścaturo dīptairhayān pratyapasarpayat .. 6.110.8 ..
sa krodhavaśamāpanno hayānāmapasarpaṇe .mumoca niśitān bāṇān rāghavāya niśācaraḥ .. 6.110.9 ..
so 'tividdho balavatā daśagrīveṇa rāghavaḥ .jagāma na vikāraṃ ca na cāpi vyathito 'bhavat .. 6.110.10 ..
cikṣepa ca punarbāṇān vajrapātasamasvanān .sārāthiṃ vajrahastasya samuddiśya niśācaraḥ .. 6.110.11 ..
mātalestu mahāvegāḥ śarīre patitāḥ śarāḥ .na sūkṣmamapi sammohaṃ vyathāṃ vā pradaduryudhi .. 6.110.12 ..
tayā dharṣaṇayā kruddho mātalerna tathā ' 'tmanaḥ .cakāra śarajālena rāghavo vimukhaṃ ripum .. 6.110.13 ..
viṃśataṃ triṃśataṃ ṣaṣṭiṃ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ .mumoca rāghavo vīraḥ sāyakān syandane ripoḥ .. 6.110.14 ..
rāvaṇo 'pi tataḥ kruddho rathastho rākṣaseśvaraḥ .gadāmusalavarṣeṇa rāmaṃ pratyardayadraṇe .. 6.110.15 ..
tatpravṛttaṃ mahadyuddhaṃ tumulaṃ romaharṣaṇam .. 6.110.16 ..
gadānāṃ musalānāṃ ca parighāṇāṃ ca nisvanaiḥ .śarāṇāṃ puṅkhapātaiśca kṣubhitāḥ sapta sāgarāḥ .. 6.110.17 ..
kṣubdhānāṃ sāgarāṇāṃ ca pātālatalavāsinaḥ .vyathitāḥ pannagāḥ sarve dānavāśca sahasraśaḥ .. 6.110.18 ..
cakampe medinī kṛtsnā saśailavanakānanā .bhāskaro niṣprabhaścāsīnna vavau cāpi mārutaḥ .. 6.110.19 ..
tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ .cintāmāpedire sarve sakinnaramahoragāḥ .. 6.110.20 ..
svasti gobrāhmaṇebhyastu lokāstiṣṭhantu śāśvatāḥ .jayatāṃ rāghavaḥ saṅkhye rāvaṇaṃ rākṣaseśvaram .. 6.110.21 ..
evaṃ japanto 'paśyaṃste devāḥ sarṣigaṇāstadā .rāmarāvaṇayoryuddhaṃ sughoraṃ romaharṣaṇam .. 6.110.22 ..
gandharvāpsarasāṃ saṅghā dṛṣṭvā yuddhamanūpamam .. 6.110.23 ..
gaganaṃ gaganākāraṃ sāgaraḥ sāgaropamaḥ .rāmarāvaṇayoryuddhaṃ rāmarāvaṇayoriva .evaṃ bruvanto dadṛśustadyuddhaṃ rāmarāvaṇam .. 6.110.24 ..
tataḥ kruddho mahābāhū raghūṇāṃ kīrtivardhanaḥ .sandhāya dhanuṣā rāmaḥ kṣuramāśīviṣopamam .. 6.110.25 ..
rāvaṇasya śiro 'cchindacchrīmajjvalitakuṇḍalam .tacchiraḥ patitaṃ bhūmau dṛṣṭvaṃ lokaistribhistadā .. 6.110.26 ..
tasyaiva sadṛśaṃ cānyadrāvaṇasyotthitaṃ śiraḥ .tat kṣipraṃ kṣiprahastena rāmeṇa kṣiprakāriṇā .. 6.110.27 ..
dvitīyaṃ rāvaṇaśiraśchinnaṃ saṃyati sāyakaiḥ .chinnamātraṃ tu tacchīrṣaṃ punaranyat sma dṛśyate .. 6.110.28 ..
tadapyaśanisaṅkāśaiśchinnaṃ rāmeṇa sāyakaiḥ .evamekaśataṃ chinnaṃ śirasāṃ tulyavarcasām .. 6.110.29 ..
na caiva rāvaṇasyānto dṛśyate jīvitakṣaye .. 6.110.30 ..
tataḥ sarvāstravidvīraḥ kausalyānandavardhanaḥ .mārgaṇairbahubhiryuktaścintayāmāsa rāghavaḥ .. 6.110.31 ..
mārīco nihato yaistu kharo yaistu sadūṣaṇaḥ .krauñcāvane virādhastu kabandho daṇḍakāvane .. 6.110.32 ..
yaiḥ sālā girayo bhagnā vālī ca kṣubhito 'mbudhiḥ .ta ime sāyakāḥ sarve yuddhe prātyayikā mama .kiṃ nu tatkāraṇaṃ yena rāvaṇe mandatejasaḥ .. 6.110.33 ..

iti cintāparaścāsīdapramattaśca saṃyuge .vavarṣa śaravarṣāṇi rāghavo rāvaṇorasi .. 6.110.34 ..ā mama .rāvaṇo 'pi tataḥ kruddho rathastho rākṣaseśvaraḥ .gadāmusalavarṣeṇa rāmaṃ pratyardayadraṇe .. 6.110.35 ..
tat pravṛttaṃ mahadyuddhaṃ tumulaṃ romaharṣaṇam .antarikṣe ca bhūmau ca punaśca girimūrdhani .. 6.110.36 ..
devadānavayakṣāṇāṃ piśācoragarakṣasām .paśyatāṃ tanmahadyuddhaṃ sarvarātramavartata .. 6.110.37 ..
naiva rātraṃ na divasaṃ na muhūrtaṃ na ca kṣaṇam .rāmarāvaṇayoryuddhaṃ virāmamupagacchati .. 6.110.38 ..
daśarathasutarākṣasendrayorjayamanavekṣya raṇe sa rāghavasya .suravararathasārathirmahān raṇagatamenamuvāca vākyamāśu .. 6.110.39 ..
ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe daśottaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ .. 110 ..
atha saṃsmārayāmāsa rāghavaṃ mātalistadā .ajānanniva kiṃ vīra tvamenamanuvartase .. 6.111.1 ..
visṛjāsmai vadhāya tvamastraṃ paitāmahaṃ prabho .vināśakālaḥ kathito yaḥ suraiḥ so 'dya vartata .. 6.111.2 ..
tataḥ saṃsmārito rāmastena vākyena mātaleḥ .jagrāha saśaraṃ dīptaṃ niśvasantamivoragam .. 6.111.3 ..
yamasmai prathamaṃ prādādagastyo bhagavānṛṣiḥ .brahmadattaṃ mahābāṇamamoghaṃ yudhi vīryavān .. 6.111.4 ..
brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ pūrvamindrārthamamitaujasā .dattaṃ surapateḥ pūrvaṃ trilokajayakāṅkṣiṇaḥ .. 6.111.5 ..
yasya vājeṣu pavanaḥ phale pāvakabhāskarau .śarīramākāśamayaṃ gaurave merumandarau .. 6.111.6 ..
jājvalyamānaṃ vapuṣā supuṅkhaṃ hemabhūṣitam .tejasā sarvabhūtānāṃ kṛtaṃ bhāskaravarcasam .. 6.111.7 ..
sadhūmamiva kālāgniṃ dīptamāśīviṣaṃ yathā .paranāgāśvavṛndānāṃ bhedanaṃ kṣiprakāriṇam .. 6.111.8 ..
dvārāṇāṃ parighāṇāṃ ca girīṇāmapi bhedanam .nānārudhirasiktāṅgaṃ medodigdhaṃ sudāruṇam .. 6.111.9 ..
vajrasāraṃ mahānādaṃ nānāsamitidāraṇam .sarvavitrāsanaṃ bhīmaṃ śvasantamiva pannagam .. 6.111.10 ..
kaṅkagṛdhravalānāṃ ca gomāyugaṇarakṣasām .nityaṃ bhakṣyapradaṃ yuddhe yamarūpaṃ bhayāvaham .. 6.111.11 ..
nandanaṃ vānarendrāṇāṃ rakṣasāmavasādanam .vājitaṃ vividhairvājaiścārucitrairgarutmataḥ .. 6.111.12 ..
tamuttameṣuṃ lokānāmikṣvākubhayanāśanam .dviṣatāṃ kīrtiharaṇaṃ praharṣakaramātmanaḥ .. 6.111.13 ..
abhimantrya tato rāmastaṃ maheṣuṃ mahābalaḥ .vedaproktena vidhinā sandadhe kārmuke balī .. 6.111.14 ..

tasmin sandhīyamāne tu rāghaveṇa śarottame .sarvabhūtāni vitresuścacāla ca vasundharā .. 6.111.15 ..sa rāvaṇāya saṅkruddho bhṛśamāyamya kārmukam .cikṣepa paramāyattastaṃ śaraṃ marmaghātinam .. 6.111.16 ..
sa vajra iva durdharṣo vajribāhuvisarjitaḥ .kṛtānta iva cāvāryo nyapatadrāvaṇorasi .. 6.111.17 ..
sa visṛṣṭo mahāvegaḥ śarīrāntakaraḥ śaraḥ .bibheda hṛdayaṃ tasya rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ .. 6.111.18 ..
rudhirāktaḥ sa vegena jīvitāntakaraḥ śaraḥ .rāvaṇasya haran prāṇān viveśa dharaṇītalam .. 6.111.19 ..
sa śaro rāvaṇaṃ hatvā rudhirārdīkṛtacchaviḥ .kṛtakarmā nibhṛtavat svatūṇīṃ punarāgamat .. 6.111.20 ..
tasya hastāddhatasyāśu kārmukaṃ tat sasāyakam .nipapāta saha prāṇairbhraśyamānasya jīvitāt .. 6.111.21 ..
gatāsurbhīmavegastu nairṛtendro mahādyutiḥ .papāta syandanādbhūmau vṛtro vajrahato yathā .. 6.111.22 ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā patitaṃ bhūmau hataśeṣā niśācarāḥ .hatanāthā bhayatrastāḥ sarvataḥ sampradudruvuḥ .. 6.111.23 ..
nardantaścābhipetustān vānarā drumayodhinaḥ .. 6.111.24 ..
daśagrīvavadhaṃ dṛṣṭvā vijayaṃ rāghavasya ca .arditā vānarairhṛṣṭairlaṅkāmabhyapatan bhayāt .gatāśrayatvāt karuṇairbāṣpaprasravaṇairmukhaiḥ .. 6.111.25 ..
tato vineduḥ saṃhṛṣṭā vānarā jitakāśinaḥ .vadanto rāghavajayaṃ rāvaṇasya ca tadvadham .. 6.111.26 ..
athāntarikṣe vyanadat saumyastridaśadundubhiḥ .divyagandhavahastatra mārutaḥ sasukho vavau .. 6.111.27 ..
nipapātāntarikṣācca puṣpavṛṣṭistadā bhuvi .kirantī rāghavarathaṃ duravāpā manoramā .. 6.111.28 ..
rāghavastavasaṃyuktā gagane 'pi ca śuśruve .sādhu sādhviti vāgagryā daivatānāṃ mahātmanām .. 6.111.29 ..
āviveśa mahāharṣo devānāṃ cāraṇaiḥ saha .rāvaṇe nihate raudre sarvalokabhayaṅkare .. 6.111.30 ..
tataḥ sakāmaṃ sugrīvamaṅgadaṃ ca mahābalam .cakāra rāghavaḥ prīto hatvā rākṣasapuṅgavam .. 6.111.31 ..
tataḥ prajagmuḥ praśamaṃ marudgaṇā diśaḥ prasedurvimalaṃ nabho 'bavat .mahī cakampe na hi māruto vavau sthiraprabhaścāpyabhavaddivākaraḥ .. 6.111.32 ..
tatastu sugrīvavibhīṣaṇādayaḥ suhṛdviśeṣāḥ sahalakṣmaṇāstadā .sametya hṛṣṭā vijayena rāghavaṃ raṇe 'bhirāmaṃ vidhinā hyapūjayan .. 6.111.33 ..
sa tu nihataripuḥ sthirapratijñaḥ svajanabalābhivṛto raṇe rarāja .raghukulanṛpanandano mahaujāstridaśagaṇairabhisaṃvṛto yathendraḥ .. 6.111.34 ..
ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe ekādaśottaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ .. 111 ..
bhrātaraṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā śayānaṃ rāmanirjitam .śokavegaparītātmā vilalāpa vibhīṣaṇaḥ .. 6.112.1 ..
vīra vikrānta vikhyāta vinīta nayakovida .mahārhaśayanopeta kiṃ śeṣe 'dya hato bhuvi .. 6.112.2 ..
vikṣipya dīrghau niśceṣṭau bhujāvaṅgadabhūṣitau .mukuṭenāpavṛttena bhāskarākāravarcasā .. 6.112.3 ..
tadidaṃ vīra samprāptaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ samīritam .kāmamohaparītasya yatte na rucitaṃ vacaḥ .. 6.112.4 ..
yanna darpāt prahasto vā nendrajinnāpare janāḥ .na kumbhakarṇo 'tiratho nātikāyo narāntakaḥ .na svayaṃ tvamamanyethāstasyodarko 'yamāgataḥ .. 6.112.5 ..
gataḥ setuḥ sunītānāṃ gato dharmasya vigrahaḥ .gataḥ sattvasya saṅkṣepaḥ prastāvānāṃ gatirgatā .. 6.112.6 ..
ādityaḥ patito bhūmau magnastamasi candramāḥ .. 6.112.7 ..
citrabhānuḥ praśāntārcirvyavasāyo nirudyamaḥ .asminnipatite bhūmau vīre śastrabhṛtāṃ vare .. 6.112.8 ..
kiṃ śeṣamiva lokasya hatavīrasya sāmpratam .raṇe rākṣasaśārdūle prasupta iva pāṃsuṣu .. 6.112.9 ..
dhṛtipravālaḥ prasahāgryapuṣpastapobalaḥ śauryanibaddhamūlaḥ .raṇe mahān rākṣasarājavṛkṣaḥ sammardito rāghavamārutena .. 6.112.10 ..
tejoviṣāṇaḥ kulavaṃśavaṃśaḥ kopaprasādāparagātrahastaḥ .ikṣvākusiṃhāvagṛhītadehaḥ suptaḥ kṣitau rāvaṇagandhahastī .. 6.112.11 ..
parākramotsāhavijṛmbhitārcirniśvāsadhūmaḥ svabalapratāpaḥ .pratāpavān saṃyati rākṣasāgnirnirvāpito rāmapayodhareṇa .. 6.112.12 ..
siṃharkṣalāṅgūlakakudviṣāṇaḥ parābhijidgandhanagandhahastī .rakṣovṛṣaścāpalakarṇacakṣuḥ kṣitīśvaravyāghrahato 'vasannaḥ .. 6.112.13 ..
vadantaṃ hetumadvākyaṃ parimṛṣṭārthaniścayam .rāmaḥ śokasamāviṣṭamityuvāca vibhīṣaṇam .. 6.112.14 ..
nāyaṃ vinaṣṭo niśceṣṭaḥ samare caṇḍavikramaḥ .atyunnatamahotsāhaḥ patito 'yamaśaṅkitaḥ .. 6.112.15 ..
naivaṃ vinaṣṭāḥ śocyante kṣatradharmamavasthitāḥ .vṛddhimāśaṃsamānā ye nipatanti raṇājire .. 6.112.16 ..
yena sendrāstrayo lokāstrāsitā yudhi dhīmatā .tasmin kālasamāyukte na kālaḥ pariśocitum .. 6.112.17 ..
naikāntavijayo yuddhe bhūtapūrvaḥ kadācana .parairvā hanyate vīraḥ parān vā hanti saṃyuge .. 6.112.18 ..
iyaṃ hi pūrvaiḥ sandiṣṭā gatiḥ kṣatriyasammatā .kṣatriyo nihataḥ saṅkhye na śocya iti niścaya .. 6.112.19 ..
tadevaṃ niścayaṃ dṛṣṭvā tattvamāsthāya vijvaraḥ .yadihānantaraṃ kāryaṃ kalpyaṃ tadanucintaya .. 6.112.20 ..
tamuktavākyaṃ vikrāntaṃ rājaputraṃ vibhīṣaṇaḥ .uvāca śokasantapto bhrāturhitamanantaram .. 6.112.21 ..
yo 'yaṃ vimardeṣu na bhagnapūrvaḥ suraiḥ sametaiḥ saha vāsavena .bhavantamāsādya raṇe vibhagno velāmivāsādya yathā samudraḥ .. 6.112.22 ..
anena dattāni supūjitāni bhuktāśca bhogā nibhṛtāśca bhṛtyāḥ .dhanāni mitreṣu samarpitāni vairāṇyamitreṣu ca yāpitāni .. 6.112.23 ..
eṣohitāgniśca mahātapāśca vedāntagaḥ karmasu cāgryavīryaḥ .etasya yat pretagatasya kṛtyaṃ tat kartumicchāmi tava prasādāt .. 6.112.24 ..
sa tasya vākyaiḥ karuṇairmahātmā sambodhitaḥ sādhu vibhīṣaṇena .ājñāpayāmāsa narendrasūnuḥ svargīyamādhānamadīnasattvaḥ .. 6.112.25 ..
maraṇāntāni vairāṇi nirvṛttaṃ naḥ prayojanam .kriyatāmasya saṃskāro mamāpyeṣa yathā tava .. 6.112.26 ..
ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe dvādaśottaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ .. 112 ..
rāvaṇaṃ nihataṃ śrutvā rāghaveṇa mahātmanā .antaḥpurādviniṣpetū rākṣasyaḥ śokakarśitāḥ .. 6.113.1 ..
vāryamāṇāḥ subahuśo veṣṭantyaḥ kṣitipāṃsuṣu .vimuktakeśyo duḥkhārtā gāvo vatsahatā iva .. 6.113.2 ..
uttareṇa viniṣkramya dvāreṇa saha rākṣasaiḥ .praviśyāyo dhanaṃ ghoraṃ vicinvantyo hataṃ patim .. 6.113.3 ..
rājaputreti vādinyo hā nātheti ca sarvaśaḥ .paripetuḥ kabandhāṅkāṃ mahīṃ śoṇitakardamām .. 6.113.4 ..
tā bāṣpaparipūrṇākṣyo bhartṛśokaparājitāḥ .kareṇva iva nardantyo vinedurhatayūthapāḥ .. 6.113.5 ..
dadṛśustaṃ mahāvīryaṃ mahākāyaṃ mahādyutim .rāvaṇaṃ nihataṃ bhūmau nīlāñjanacayopamam .. 6.113.6 ..
tāḥ patiṃ sahasā dṛṣṭvā śayānaṃ raṇapāṃsuṣu .nipetustasya gātreṣu cchinnā vanalatā iva .. 6.113.7 ..
bahumānāt pariṣvajya kācidenaṃ ruroda ha .caraṇau kācidāliṅgya kācit kaṇṭhe 'valambya ca .. 6.113.8 ..
uddhṛtya ca bhujau kācidbhūmau sma parivartate .hatasya vadanaṃ dṛṣṭvā kācinmohamupāgamat .. 6.113.9 ..
kācidaṅke śiraḥ kṛtvā ruroda mukhamīkṣatī .snāpayantī mukhaṃ bāṣpaistuṣārairiva paṅkajam .. 6.113.10 ..
evamārtāḥ patiṃ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇaṃ nihataṃ bhuvi .cukruśurbahudhā śokādbhūyastāḥ paryadevayan .. 6.113.11 ..
yena vitrāsitaḥ śakro yena vitrāsito yamaḥ .yena vaiśravaṇo rājā puṣpakeṇa viyojitaḥ .. 6.113.12 ..
gandharvāṇāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca mahātmanām .bhayaṃ yena mahaddattaṃ so 'yaṃ śete raṇe hataḥ .. 6.113.13 ..
asurebhyaḥ surebhyo vā pannagebhyo 'pi vā tathā .na bhayaṃ yo vijānāti tasyedaṃ mānuṣādbhayam .. 6.113.14 ..
avadhyo devatānāṃ yastathā dānavarakṣasām .hataḥ so 'yaṃ raṇe śete mānuṣeṇa padātinā .. 6.113.15 ..
yo na śakyaḥ surairhantuṃ na yakṣairnāsuraistathā .so 'yaṃ kaścidivāsattvo mṛtyuṃ martyena lambhitaḥ .. 6.113.16 ..
evaṃ vadantyo bahudhā rurudustasya tāḥ striyaḥ .bhūya eva ca duḥkhārtā vilepuśca punaḥpunaḥ .. 6.113.17 ..
aśṛṇvatā ca suhṛdāṃ satataṃ hitavādinām .maraṇāyāhṛtā sītā ghātitāśca niśācarāḥ .. 6.113.18 ..
etāḥ samamidānīṃ te vayamātmā ca pātitāḥ .bruvāṇo 'pi hitaṃ vākyamiṣṭo bhrātā vibīṣaṇaḥ .dhṛṣṭaṃ paruṣito mohāttvayā ' 'tmavadhakāṅkṣiṇā .. 6.113.19 ..
yadi niryātitā te syāt sītā rāmāya maithilī .na naḥ syād vyasanaṃ ghoramidaṃ mūlaharaṃ mahat .. 6.113.20 ..
vṛttakāmo bhavedbhrātā rāmo mitrakulaṃ bhavet .vayaṃ cāvidhavāḥ sarvāḥ sakāmā na ca śatravaḥ .. 6.113.21 ..
tvayā punarnṛśaṃsena sītāṃ saṃrundhatā balāt .rākṣasā vayamātmā ca trayaṃ tulyaṃ nipātitam .. 6.113.22 ..
na kāmakāraḥ kāmaṃ vā tava rākṣasapuṅgava .daivaṃ ceṣṭayate sarvaṃ hataṃ daivena hanyate .. 6.113.23 ..
vānarāṇāṃ vināśo 'yaṃ rakṣasāṃ ca mahāhave .tava caiva mahābāho daivayogādupāgataḥ .. 6.113.24 ..
naivārthena na kāmena vikrameṇa na cājñayā .śakyā daivagatirloke nivartayitumudyatā .. 6.113.25 ..
vilepurevaṃ dīnāstā rākṣasādhipayoṣitaḥ .kurarya iva duḥkhārtā bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇāḥ .. 6.113.26 ..
ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe trayodaśottaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ .. 113 ..
tāsāṃ vilapamānānāṃ tathā rākṣasayoṣitām .jyeṣṭhā patnī priyā dīnā bhartāraṃ samudaikṣata .. 6.114.1 ..
daśagrīvaṃ hataṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmeṇācintyakarmaṇā .patiṃ maṇḍodarī tatra kṛpaṇā paryadevayat .. 6.114.2 ..
nanu nāma mahābhāga tava vaiśravaṇānuja .kruddhasya pramukhe sthātuṃ trasyatyapi purandaraḥ .. 6.114.3 ..
ṛṣayaśca mahīdevā gandharvāśca yaśasvinaḥ .. 6.114.4 ..
nanu nāma tavodvegāccāraṇāśca diśo gatāḥ .sa tvaṃ mānuṣamātreṇa rāmeṇa yudhi nirjitaḥ .na vyapatrapase rājan kimidaṃ rākṣasarṣabha .. 6.114.5 ..
kathaṃ trailokyamākramya śriyā vīryeṇa cānvitam .aviṣahyaṃ jaghāna tvāṃ mānuṣo vanagocaraḥ .. 6.114.6 ..
mānuṣāṇāmaviṣaye carataḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ .vināśastava rāmeṇa saṃyuge nopapadyate .. 6.114.7 ..
na caitat karma rāmasya śraddadhāmi camūmukhe .sarvataḥ samupetasya tava tenābhimarśanam .. 6.114.8 ..
yadaiva ca janasthāne rākṣasairbahubhirvṛtaḥ .kharastava hato bhrātā tadevāsau na mānuṣaḥ .. 6.114.9 ..
yadaiva nagarīṃ laṅkāṃ duṣpraveśāṃ surairapi .praviṣṭo hanumān vīryāttadaiva vyathitā vayam .. 6.114.10 ..
yadaiva vānarairghorairbaddhaḥ seturmahārṇave .tadaiva hṛdayenāhaṃ śaṅke rāmamamānuṣam .. 6.114.11 ..
athavā rāmarūpeṇa kṛtāntaḥ svayamāgataḥ .māyāṃ tava vināśāya vidhāyāpratitarkitām .. 6.114.12 ..
athavā vāsavena tvaṃ dharṣito 'si mahābala .vāsavasya kutaḥ śaktistvāṃ draṣṭumapi saṃyuge .. 6.114.13 ..
vyaktameṣa mahāyogī paramātmā sanātanaḥ .anādimadhyanidhano mahataḥ paramo mahān .. 6.114.14 ..
tamasaḥ paramo dhātā śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ .śrīvatsavakṣā nityaśrīrajayyaḥ śāśvato dhruvaḥ .. 6.114.15 ..
mānuṣaṃ vapurāsthāya viṣṇuḥ satyaparākramaḥ .sarvaiḥ parivṛto devairvānaratvamupāgataiḥ .. 6.114.16 ..
sarvalokeśvaraḥ sākṣāllokānāṃ hitakāmyayā .sarākṣasaparīvāraṃ hatavāṃstvāṃ mahādyutiḥ .. 6.114.17 ..
indriyāṇi purā jitvā jitaṃ tribhuvanaṃ tvayā .smaradbhiriva tadvairamindriyaireva nirjitaḥ .. 6.114.18 ..
kriyatāmavirodhaśca rāghaveṇeti yanmayā .ucyamāno na gṛhṇāsi tasyeyaṃ vyuṣṭirāgatā .. 6.114.19 ..
akasmāccābhikāmo 'si sītāṃ rākṣasapuṅgava .aiśvaryasya vināśāya dehasya svajanasya ca .. 6.114.20 ..
arundhatyā viśiṣṭāṃ tāṃ rohiṇyāścāpi durmate .sītāṃ dharṣayatā mānyāṃ tvayā hyasadṛśaṃ kṛtam .. 6.114.21 ..
vasudhāyāśca vasudhāṃ śriyaḥ śrīṃ bhartṛvatsalām .sītāṃ sarvānavadyāṅgīmaraṇye vijane śubhām .. 6.114.22 ..
ānayitvā tu tāṃ dīnāṃ chadmanā ' 'tmasvadūṣaṇa .aprāpya caiva taṃ kāmaṃ maithilīsaṅkame kṛtam .pativratāyāstapasā nūnaṃ dagdho 'si me prabho .. 6.114.23 ..
tadaiva yanna dagdhastvaṃ dharṣayaṃstanumadhyamām .devā bibhyati te sarve sendrāḥ sāgnipurogamāḥ .. 6.114.24 ..
avaśyameva labhate phalaṃ pāpasya karmaṇaḥ .ghoraṃ paryāgate kāle kartā nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ .. 6.114.25 ..
śubhakṛcchubhamāpnoti pāpakṛt pāpamaśnute .vibhīṣaṇaḥ sukhaṃ prāptastvaṃ prāptaḥ pāpamīdṛśam .. 6.114.26 ..
santyanyāḥ pramadāstubhyaṃ rūpeṇābhyadhikāstataḥ .anaṅgavaśamāpannastvaṃ tu mohānna budhyase .. 6.114.27 ..
na kulena na rūpeṇa na dākṣiṇyena maithilī .mayā 'dhikā vā tulyā vā tvaṃ tu mohānna budhyase .. 6.114.28 ..
sarvathā sarvabhūtānāṃ nāsti mṛtyuralakṣaṇaḥ .tava tāvadayaṃ mṛtyurmaithilīkṛtalakṣaṇaḥ .. 6.114.29 ..
sītānimittajo mṛtyustvayā dūrādupāhṛtaḥ .. 6.114.30 ..
maithilī saha rāmeṇa viśokā vihariṣyati .alpapuṇyā tvahaṃ ghore patitā śokasāgare .. 6.114.31 ..
kailāse mandare merau tathā caitrarathe vane .devodyāneṣu sarveṣu vihṛtya sahitā tvayā .. 6.114.32 ..
vimānenānurūpeṇa yā yāmyatulayā śriyā .paśyantī vividhān deśāṃstāṃstāṃścitrasragambarā .bhraṃśitā kāmabhogebhyaḥ sā 'smi vīra vadhāttava .. 6.114.33 ..
saivānyevāsmi saṃvṛttā dhig rājñāṃ cañcalāḥ śriyaḥ .. 6.114.34 ..tāṃstāṃścitrasragambarā .hā rājan sukumāraṃ te subhru sutvak samunnasam .kāntiśrīdyutibhistulyamindupadmadivākaraiḥ .. 6.114.35 ..
kirīṭakūṭojjvalitaṃ tāmrāsyaṃ dīptakuṇḍalam .madavyākulalolākṣaṃ bhūtvā yat pānabhūmiṣu .. 6.114.36 ..
vividhasragdharaṃ cāru valgusmitakathaṃ śubham .tadevādya tavedaṃ hi vaktraṃ na bhrājate prabho .. 6.114.37 ..
rāmasāyakanirbhinnaṃ siktaṃ rudhiravisravaiḥ .viśīrṇamedomastiṣkaṃ rūkṣaṃ syandanareṇubhiḥ .. 6.114.38 ..
hā paścimā me samprāptā daśā vaidhavyakāriṇī .yā mayā ' 'sīnna sambuddhā kadācidapi mandayā .. 6.114.39 ..
pitā dānavarājo me bhartā me rākṣaseśvaraḥ .putro me śaktanirjetā ityevaṃ garvitā bhṛśam .. 6.114.40 ..
dṛptārimardanāḥ śūrāḥ prakhyātabalapauruṣāḥ .akutaścidbhayā nāthā mametyāsīnmatirddaḍhā .. 6.114.41 ..
teṣāmevaṃprabhāvānāṃ yuṣmākaṃ rākṣasarṣabha .kathaṃ bhayamasambuddhaṃ mānuṣādidamāgatam .. 6.114.42 ..
snigdhendranīlanīlaṃ tu prāṃśuśailopamaṃ mahat .keyūrāṅgadavaiḍūryamuktādāmasragujjvalam .. 6.114.43 ..
kāntaṃ vihāreṣvadhikaṃ dīptaṃ saṅgrāmabhūmiṣu .bhātyābharaṇabhābhiryadvidyudbhiriva toyadaḥ .. 6.114.44 ..
tadevādya śarīraṃ te tīkṣṇairnaikaiḥ śaraiścitam .punardurlabhasaṃsparśaṃ pariṣvaktuṃ na śakyate .. 6.114.45 ..
śvāvidhaḥ śalalairyadvadbāṇairlagnairnirantaram .svarpitairmarmasu bhṛśaṃ sañchinnasnāyubandhanam .kṣitau nipatitaṃ rājan śyāvaṃ rudhirasacchavi .. 6.114.46 ..

vajraprahārābhihato vikīrṇa iva parvataḥ .. 6.114.47 ..varpitairmarmasu bhṛśaṃ sañchinnasnāyubandhanam .hā svapnaḥ satyamevedaṃ tvaṃ rāmeṇa kathaṃ hataḥ .tvaṃ mṛtyorapi mṛtyuḥ syāḥ kathaṃ mṛtyuvaśaṃ gataḥ .. 6.114.48 ..
trailokyavasubhoktāraṃ trailokyodvegadaṃ mahat .jetāraṃ lokapālānāṃ kṣeptāraṃ śaṅkarasya ca .. 6.114.49 ..
dṛptānāṃ nigrahītāramāviṣkṛtaparākramam .lokakṣobhayitāraṃ ca nādairbhūtavirāviṇam .. 6.114.50 ..
ojasā dṛptavākyānāṃ vaktāraṃ ripusannidhau .svayūthabhṛtyavargāṇāṃ goptāraṃ bhīmakarmaṇām .. 6.114.51 ..
hantāraṃ dānavendrāṇāṃ yakṣāṇāṃ ca sahasraśaḥ .nivātakavacānāṃ ca saṅgrahītāramīśvaram .. 6.114.52 ..
naikayajñaviloptāraṃ trātāraṃ svajanasya ca .dharmavyavasthābhettāraṃ māyāsraṣṭāramāhave .. 6.114.53 ..
devāsuranṛkanyānāmāhartāraṃ tatastataḥ .śatrustrīśokadātāraṃ netāraṃ svajanasya ca .. 6.114.54 ..
laṅkādvīpasya goptāraṃ kartāraṃ bhīmakarmaṇām .asmākaṃ kāmabhogānāṃ dātāraṃ rathināṃ varam .. 6.114.55 ..
evaṃprabhāvaṃ bhartāraṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmeṇa pātitam .sthirā 'smi yā dehamimaṃ dhārayāmi hatapriyā .. 6.114.56 ..
śayaneṣu mahārheṣu śayitvā rākṣaseśvara .iha kasmāt prasupto 'si dharaṇyāṃ reṇupāṭalaḥ .. 6.114.57 ..
yadā me tanayaḥ śasto lakṣmaṇenendrajidyudhi .tadā 'smyabhihatā tīvramadya tvasminnipātitā .. 6.114.58 ..
nāhaṃ bandhujanairhīnā hīnā nāthena tu tvayā .vihīnā kāmabhogaiśca śociṣye śāśvatīḥ samāḥ .. 6.114.59 ..
prapanno dīrghamadhvānaṃ rājannadyāsi durgamam .naya māmapi duḥkhārtāṃ na jīviṣye tvayā vinā .. 6.114.60 ..
kasmāt tvaṃ māṃ vihāyeha kṛpaṇāṃ gantumicchasi .dīnāṃ vilapitairmandāṃ kiṃvā māṃ nābhibhāṣase .. 6.114.61 ..
dṛṣṭvā na khalvasi kruddho māmihānavakuṇṭhitām .nirgatāṃ nagaradvārāt padbhyāmevāgatāṃ prabho .. 6.114.62 ..
paśyeṣṭadāra dārāṃste bhraṣṭalajjāvakuṇṭhitān .bahirniṣpatitān sarvān kathaṃ dṛṣṭvā na kupyasi .. 6.114.63 ..
ayaṃ krīḍāsahāyaste nātha lālapyate janaḥ .na cainamāśvāsayase kiṃ vā na bahumanyase .. 6.114.64 ..
yāstvayā vidhavā rājan kṛtā naikāḥ kulastriyaḥ .pativratā dharmaparā guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ .tābhiḥ śokābhitaptābhiḥ śaptaḥ paravaśaṃ gataḥ .. 6.114.65 ..
tvayā viprakṛtābhiryattadā śaptaṃ tadāgatam .. 6.114.66 ..
pravādaḥ satya evāyaṃ tvāṃ prati prāyaśo nṛpa .pativratānāṃ nākasmāt patantyaśrūṇi bhūtale .. 6.114.67 ..
kathaṃ ca nāma te rājan lokānākramya tejasā .nārīcauryamidaṃ kṣudraṃ kṛtaṃ śauṇḍīryamāninā .. 6.114.68 ..
apanīyāśramādrāmaṃ yanmṛgacchadmanā tvayā .ānītā rāmapatnī sā tatte kātaryalakṣaṇam .. 6.114.69 ..
kātaryaṃ ca na te yuddhe kadācit saṃsmarāmyaham .tattubhāgyaviparyāsānnūnaṃ te pakvalakṣaṇam .. 6.114.70 ..
atītānāgatārthajño vartamānavicakṣaṇaḥ .maithilīmāhṛtāṃ dṛṣṭvā dhyātvā niśvasya cāyatam .. 6.114.71 ..
satyavāk sa mahābhāgo devaro me yadabravīt .so 'yaṃ rākṣasamukhyānāṃ vināśaḥ paryupasthitaḥ .kāmakrodhasamutthena vyasanena prasaṅginā .. 6.114.72 ..
nirvṛttastvatkṛte 'narthaḥ so 'yaṃ mūlaharo mahān .tvayā kṛtamidaṃ sarvamanāthaṃ rakṣasāṃ kulam .. 6.114.73 ..
na hi tvaṃ śocitavyo me prakhyātabalapauruṣaḥ .strīsvabhāvāttu me buddhiḥ kāruṇye parivartate .. 6.114.74 ..
sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ ca tvaṃ gṛhītvā svāṃ gatiṃ gataḥ .ātmānamanuśocāmi tvadviyogena duḥkhitā .. 6.114.75 ..
suhṛdāṃ hitakāmānāṃ na śrutaṃ vacanaṃ tvayā .bhrāta'ṇāṃ cāpi kārtsnyena hitamuktaṃ tvayā 'nagha .. 6.114.76 ..
hetvarthayuktaṃ vidhivat śreyaskaramadāruṇam .vibhīṣaṇenābhihitaṃ na kṛtaṃ hetumattvayā .. 6.114.77 ..
mārīcakumbhakarṇābhyāṃ vākyaṃ mama pitustadā .na śrutaṃ vīryamattena tasyedaṃ phalamīdṛśam .. 6.114.78 ..
nīlajīmūtasaṅkāśa pītāmbara śubhāṅgada .. 6.114.79 ..
svagātrāṇi vinikṣipya kiṃ śeṣe rudhirāplutaḥ .prasupta iva śokārtāṃ kiṃ māṃ na pratibhāṣase .. 6.114.80 ..
mahāvīryasya dakṣasya saṃyugeṣvapalāyinaḥ .yātudhānasya dauhitra kiṃ ca māṃ nābhyudīkṣase .. 6.114.81 ..
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha kiṃ śeṣe prāpte paribhave nave .adya vai nirbhayāṃ laṅkāṃ praviṣṭāḥ sūryaraśmayaḥ .. 6.114.82 ..
yena sūdayase śatrūn samare sūryavarcasā .vajro vajradharasyeva so 'yaṃ te satatārcitaḥ .. 6.114.83 ..
raṇe śatrupraharaṇo hamajālapariṣkṛtaḥ .parigho vyavakīrṇaste bāṇaiśchinnaḥ sahasradhā .. 6.114.84 ..
priyāmivopaguhya tvaṃ śeṣe samaramedinīm .apriyāmiva kasmācca māṃ necchasyabhibhāṣitum .. 6.114.85 ..
dhigastu hṛdayaṃ yasyā mamedaṃ na sahasradhā .tvayi mañcatvamāpanne phalate śokapīḍitam .. 6.114.86 ..
ityevaṃ vilapantyeva bāṣpavyākulalocanā .snehāvaskannahṛdayā devī mohamupāgamat .. 6.114.87 ..
kaśmalābhihatā sannā babhau sā rāvaṇorasi .sandhyā 'nurakte jalade dīptā vidyudivāsite .. 6.114.88 ..
tathāgatāṃ samutpatya sapatnyastā bhṛśāturāḥ .paryavasthāpayāmāsū rudantyo rudatīṃ bhṛśam .. 6.114.89 ..
na te suviditā devi lokānāṃ sthitiradhruvā .daśāvibhāgaparyāye rājñāṃ cañcalayā śriyā .. 6.114.90 ..
ityevamucyamānā sā saśabdaṃ praruroda ha .snāpayantī tvabhimukhau stanāvasrāmbuvisravaiḥ .. 6.114.91 ..
etasminnantare rāmo vibhīṣaṇamuvāca ha .saṃskāraḥ kriyatāṃ bhrātuḥ striyaścaitā nivartaya .. 6.114.92 ..
taṃ praśritastato rāmaṃ śrutavākyo vibhīṣaṇaḥ .vimṛśya buddhyā dharmajño dharmārthasahitaṃ vacaḥ .rāmasyaivānuvṛttyarthamuttaraṃ pratyabhāṣata .. 6.114.93 ..
tyaktadharmavrataṃ krūraṃ nṛśaṃsamanṛtaṃ tathā .nāhamarho 'smi saṃskartuṃ paradārābhimarśinam .. 6.114.94 ..
bhrātṛrūpo hi me śatrureṣasarvāhite rataḥ .rāvaṇo nārhate pūjāṃ pūjyo 'pi gurugauravāt .. 6.114.95 ..
nṛśaṃsa iti māṃ kāmaṃ vakṣyanti manujā bhuvi .śrutvā tasyāguṇān sarve vakṣyanti sukṛtaṃ punaḥ .. 6.114.96 ..
tacchrutvā paramaprīto rāmo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ .vibhīṣaṇamuvācedaṃ vākyajño vākyakovidam .. 6.114.97 ..
tavāpi me priyaṃ kāryaṃ tvatprabhāvācca me jitam .avaśyaṃ tu kṣamaṃ vācyo mayā tvaṃ rākṣaseśvara .. 6.114.98 ..
adharmānṛtasaṃyuktaḥ kāmaṃ tveṣa niśācaraḥ .tejasvī balavān śūro saṃyugeṣu ca nityaśaḥ .. 6.114.99 ..
śatakratumukhairdevaiḥ śrūyate na parājitaḥ .mahātmā balasampanno rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ .. 6.114.100 ..
maraṇāntāni vairāṇi nirvṛttaṃ naḥ prayojanam .kriyatāmasya saṃskāro mamāpyeṣa yathā tava .. 6.114.101 ..
tvatsakāśāddaśagrīvaḥ saṃskāraṃ vidhipūrvakam .prāptumarhati dharmajña tvaṃ yaśobhāg bhaviṣyasi .. 6.114.102 ..
rāghavasya vacaḥ śrutvā tvaramāṇo vibhīṣaṇaḥ .saṃskāreṇānurūpeṇa yojayāmāsa rāvaṇam .. 6.114.103 ..
citāṃ candanakāṣṭhānāṃ padmakośīrasaṃvṛtām .brāhmyā saṃveśayāñcakrū rāṅkavāstaraṇāvṛtām .. 6.114.104 ..
vartate vedavihito rājño vai paścimaḥ kratuḥ .pracakrū rākṣasendrasya pitṛmedhamanukramam .. 6.114.105 ..
vediṃ ca dakṣiṇaprācyāṃ yathāsthānaṃ ca pāvakam .pṛṣadājyena sampūrṇaṃ sruvaṃ sarve pracikṣipuḥ .. 6.114.106 ..
pādayoḥ śakaṭaṃ prādurantarūrvorulūkhalam .dārupātrāṇi sarvāṇi araṇiṃ cottarāraṇim .dattvā tu musalaṃ cānyadyathā sthānaṃ vicakṣaṇāḥ .. 6.114.107 ..
śāstradṛṣṭena vidhinā maharṣivihitena ca .tatra medhyaṃ paśuṃ hatvā rākṣasendrasya rākṣasāḥ .. 6.114.108 ..
paristaraṇikāṃ rājño ghṛtāktāṃ samaveśayan .. 6.114.109 ..
gandhairmālyairalaṅkṛtya rāvaṇaṃ dīnamānasāḥ .vibhīṣaṇasahāyāste vastraiśca vividhairapi .. 6.114.110 ..
lājaiścāvakiranti sma bāṣpapūrṇamukhāstadā .. 6.114.111 ..
dadau ca pāvakaṃ tasya vidhiyuktaṃ vibhīṣaṇaḥ .. 6.114.112 ..
snātvā caivārdravastreṇa tilān dūrvābhimiśritān .udakena ca saṃmiśrān pradāya vidhipūrvakam .. 6.114.113 ..
pradāya codakaṃ tasmai mūrdhnā cainaṃ namasya ca .tāḥ striyo 'nunayāmāsa sāntvamuktvā punaḥpunaḥ .. 6.114.114 ..
gamyatāmiti tāḥ sarvā viviśurnagaraṃ tadā .praviṣṭāsu ca sarvāsu rākṣasīṣu vibhīṣaṇaḥ .rāmapārśvamupāgamya tadā 'tiṣṭhadvinītavat .. 6.114.115 ..
rāmo 'pi saha sainyena samugrīvaḥ salakṣmaṇaḥ .harṣaṃ lebhe ripuṃ hatvā yathā vṛtraṃ śatakratuḥ .. 6.114.116 ..
ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe caturdaśottaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ .. 114 ..
te rāvaṇavadhaṃ dṛṣṭvā devagandharvadānavāḥ .jagmuḥ svaisvairvimānaiste kathayantaḥ śubhāḥ kathāḥ .. 6.115.1 ..
rāvaṇasya vadhaṃ ghoraṃ rāghavasya parākramam .suyuddhaṃ vānarāṇāṃ ca sugrīvasya ca mantritam .. 6.115.2 ..
anurāgaṃ ca vīryaṃ ca saumitrerlakṣmaṇasya ca .kathayanto mahābhāgā jagmurhṛṣṭā yathāgatam .. 6.115.3 ..
rāghavastu rathaṃ divyamindradattaṃ śikhiprabham .anujñāya mahābhāgo mātaliṃ pratyapūjayat .. 6.115.4 ..
rāghaveṇābhyanujñāto mātaliḥ śakrasārathiḥ .divyaṃ taṃ rathamāsthāya divamevāruroha saḥ .. 6.115.5 ..
tasmiṃstu divamārūḍhe surasārathisattame .rāghavaḥ paramaprītaḥ sugrīvaṃ pariṣasvaje .. 6.115.6 ..
pariṣvajya ca sugrīvaṃ lakṣmaṇena pracoditaḥ .pūjyamāno hariśreṣṭhairājagāma balālayam .. 6.115.7 ..
abravīcca tadā rāmaḥ samīpaparivartinam .saumitriṃ satyasampannaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ dīptatejasam .. 6.115.8 ..
vibhīṣaṇamimaṃ saumya laṅkāyāmabhiṣecaya .anuraktaṃ ca bhaktaṃ ca mama caivopakāriṇam .. 6.115.9 ..
eṣa me paramaḥ kāmo yadīmaṃ rāvaṇānujam .laṅkāyāṃ saumya paśyeyamabhiṣiktaṃ vibīṣaṇam .. 6.115.10 ..
evamuktastu saumitrī rāghaveṇa mahātmanā .tathetyuktvā tu saṃhṛṣṭaḥ sauvarṇaṃ ghaṭamādade .. 6.115.11 ..
taṃ ghaṭaṃ vānarendrāṇāṃ haste dattvā manojavān .ādideśa mahāsattvān samudrasalilānaye .. 6.115.12 ..
iti śīghraṃ tato gatvā vānarāste mahābalāḥ .āgatāstajjalaṃ gṛhya samudrādvānarottamāḥ .. 6.115.13 ..
tatastvekaṃ ghaṭaṃ gṛhya saṃsthāpya paramāsane .ghaṭena tena saumitrirabhyaṣiñcadvibhīṣaṇam .. 6.115.14 ..
laṅkāyāṃ rakṣasāṃ madhye rājānaṃ rāmaśāsanāt .vidhinā mantradṛṣṭena suhṛdgaṇasamāvṛtam .abhyaṣiñcat sa dharmātmā śuddhātmānaṃ vibhīṣaṇam .. 6.115.15 ..
tasyāmātyā jahṛṣire bhaktā ye cāsya rākṣasāḥ .dṛṣṭvā 'bhiṣiktaṃ laṅkāyāṃ rākṣasendraṃ vibhīṣaṇam .. 6.115.16 ..
sa tadrājyaṃ mahat prāpya rāmadattaṃ vibhīṣaṇaḥ .prakṛtīḥ sāntvayitvā ca tato rāmamupāgamat .. 6.115.17 ..
akṣatān modakān lājān divyāḥ sumanasastadā .ājahruratha saṃhṛṣṭāḥ paurāstasmai niśācarāḥ .. 6.115.18 ..
sa tān gṛhītvā durdharṣo rāghavāya nyavedayat .maṅgalyaṃ maṅgalaṃ sarvaṃ lakṣmaṇāya ca vīryavān .. 6.115.19 ..
kṛtakāryaṃ samṛddhārthaṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmo vibhīṣaṇam .pratijagrāha tat sarvaṃ tasyaiva priyakāmyayā .. 6.115.20 ..
tataḥ śailopamaṃ vīraṃ prāñjaliṃ pārśvataḥ sthitam .abravīdrāghavo vākyaṃ hanumantaṃ plavaṅgamam .. 6.115.21 ..
anumānyaṃ mahārājamimaṃ saumya vibhīṣaṇam .. 6.115.22 ..
gaccha saumya purīṃ laṅkāmanujñāpya yathāvidhi .praviśya rāvaṇagṛhaṃ vijayenābhinandya ca .. 6.115.23 ..
vaidehyai māṃ kuśalinaṃ sasugrīvaṃ salakṣmaṇam .ācakṣva jayatāṃ śreṣṭha rāvaṇaṃ ca mayā hatam .. 6.115.24 ..
priyametadudāhṛtya maithilyāstvaṃ harīśvara .pratigṛhya ca sandeśamupāvartitumarhasi .. 6.115.25 ..
ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe pañcadaśottaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ .. 115 ..
iti pratisamādiṣṭo hanumān mārutātmajaḥ .praviveśa purīṃ laṅkāṃ pūjyamāno niśācaraiḥ .. 6.116.1 ..
praviśya ca mahātejā rāvaṇasya niveśanam .dadarśa mṛjayā hīnāṃ sātaṅkāmiva rohiṇīm .vṛkṣamūle nirānandāṃ rākṣasībhiḥ samāvṛtām .. 6.116.2 ..
nibhṛtaḥ praṇataḥ prahvaḥ so 'bhigamyābhivādya ca .. 6.116.3 ..
dṛṣṭvā tamāgataṃ devī hanumantaṃ mahābalam .tūṣṇīmāsta tadā dṛṣṭvā smṛtvā pramuditā 'bhavat .. 6.116.4 ..
saumyaṃ dṛṣṭvā mukhaṃ tasyā hanumān plavagottamaḥ .rāmasya vacanaṃ sarvamākhyātumupacakrame .. 6.116.5 ..
vaidehi kuśalī rāmaḥ sahasugrīvalakṣmaṇaḥ .vibhīṣaṇasahāyaśca harīṇāṃ sahito balaiḥ .. 6.116.6 ..
kuśalaṃ cāhu siddhārtho hataśatrurarindamaḥ .. 6.116.7 ..
vibhīṣaṇasahāyena rāmeṇa haribhiḥ saha .nihato rāvaṇo devi lakṣmaṇasya nayena ca .. 6.116.8 ..
pṛṣṭvā tu kuśalaṃ rāmo vīrastvāṃ raghunandanaḥ .abravīt paramaprītaḥ kṛtārthenāntarātmanā .. 6.116.9 ..
priyamākhyāmi te devi tvāṃ tu bhūyaḥ sabhājaye .diṣṭyā jīvasi dharmajñe jayena mama saṃyuge .. 6.116.10 ..
labdho no vijayaḥ sīte svasthā bhava gatavyathā .rāvaṇaśca hataḥ śatrurlaṅkā ceyaṃ vaśe sthitā .. 6.116.11 ..
mayā hyalabdhanidreṇa dṛḍhena tava nirjaye .pratijñaiṣā vinistīrṇā baddhvā setuṃ mahodadhau .. 6.116.12 ..
sambhramaśca na gantavyo vartantyā rāvaṇālaye .vibhīṣaṇavidheyaṃ hi laṅkaiśvaryamidaṃ kṛtam .. 6.116.13 ..
tadāśvasihi viśvastā svagṛhe parivartase .ayaṃ cābhyeti saṃhṛṣṭastvaddarśanasamutsukaḥ .. 6.116.14 ..
evamuktā samutpatya sītā śaśinibhānanā .praharṣeṇāvaruddhā sā vyājahāra na kiñcana .. 6.116.15 ..
abravīcca hariśreṣṭhaḥ sītāmapratijalpatīm .kiṃ nu cintayase devi kiṃ nu māṃ nābhibhāṣase .. 6.116.16 ..
evamuktā hanumatā sītā dharme vyavasthitā .abravīt paramaprītā harṣagadgadayā girā .. 6.116.17 ..
priyametadupaśrutya bharturvijayasaṃśritam .praharṣavaśamāpannā nirvākyā 'smi kṣaṇāntaram .. 6.116.18 ..
na hi paśyāmi sadṛśaṃ cintayantī plavaṅgama .matpriyākhyānākasyeha tava pratyabhinandanam .. 6.116.19 ..
na hi paśyāmi tat saumya pṛthivyāmapi vānara .sadṛśaṃ matpriyākhyāne tava dātuṃ bhavet samam .. 6.116.20 ..
hiraṇyaṃ vā suvarṇaṃ vā ratnāni vividhāni ca .rājyaṃ vā triṣu lokeṣu naitadarhati bhāṣitum .. 6.116.21 ..
evamuktastu vaidehyā pratyuvāca plavaṅgamaḥ .gṛhītaprāñjalirvākyaṃ sītāyāḥ pramukhe sthitaḥ .. 6.116.22 ..
bhartuḥ priyahite yukte bharturvijayakāṅkṣiṇi .snigdhamevaṃvidhaṃ vākyaṃ tvamevārhasi bhāṣitum .. 6.116.23 ..
tavaitadvacanaṃ saumye sāravat snigdhameva ca .ratnaughādvividhāccāpi devarājyādviśiṣyate .. 6.116.24 ..
arthataśca mayā prāptā devarājyādayo guṇāḥ .hataśatruṃ vijayinaṃ rāmaṃ paśyāmi susthitam .. 6.116.25 ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā maithilī janakātmajā .tataḥ śubhataraṃ vākyamuvāca pavanātmajam .. 6.116.26 ..
atilakṣaṇasampannaṃ mādhuryaguṇabhūṣitam .buddhyā hyaṣṭāṅgayā yuktaṃ tvamevārhasi bhāṣitum .. 6.116.27 ..
ślāghanīyo 'nilasya tvaṃ putraḥ paramadhārmikaḥ .balaṃ śauryaṃ śrutaṃ sattvaṃ vikramo dākṣyamuttamam .. 6.116.28 ..
tejaḥ kṣamādhṛtirdhairyaṃ vinītatvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ .ete cānye ca bahavo guṇāstvayyeva śobhanāḥ .. 6.116.29 ..
athovāca punaḥ sītāmasambhrānto vinītavat .pragṛhītāñjalirharṣāt sītāyāḥ pramukhe sthitaḥ .. 6.116.30 ..
imāstu khalu rākṣasyo yadi tvamanumanyase .hantumicchāmyahaṃ sarvā yābhistvaṃ tarjitā purā .. 6.116.31 ..
kliśyantīṃ patidevāṃ tvāmaśokavanikāṃ gatām .. 6.116.32 ..

ghorarūpasamācārāḥ krūrāḥ krūratarekṣaṇāḥ .rākṣasyo dāruṇakathā varametat prayaccha me .. 6.116.33 ..muṣṭibhiḥ pāṇibhiḥ sarvāścaraṇaiścaiva śobhane .icchāmi vividhairghātairhantumetāḥ sudāruṇāḥ .. 6.116.34 ..
ghātairjānuprahāraiśca daśanānāṃ ca pātanaiḥ .bhakṣaṇaiḥ karṇanāsānāṃ keśānāṃ luñcanaistathā .. 6.116.35 ..
nakhaiḥ śuṣkamukhībhiśca dāraṇairlaṅghanairhataiḥ .nipātya hantumicchāmi tava vipriyakāriṇīḥ .. 6.116.36 ..
evaṃprakārairbahubhirviprakārairyaśasvini .hantumicchāmyahaṃ devi tavemāḥ kṛtakilbiṣāḥ .. 6.116.37 ..
evamuktā hanumatā vaidehī janakātmajā .uvāca dharmasahitaṃ hanumantaṃ yaśasvinī .. 6.116.38 ..
rājasaṃśrayavaśyānāṃ kurvantīnāṃ parājñayā .vidheyānāṃ ca dāsīnāṃ kaḥ kupyedvānarottama .. 6.116.39 ..
bhāgyavaiṣamyayogena purāduścaritena ca .mayaitat prāpyate sarvaṃ svakṛtaṃ hyupabhujyate .. 6.116.40 ..
prāptavyaṃ tu daśāyogānmayaitaditi niścitam .dāsīnāṃ rāvaṇasyāhaṃ marṣayāmīha durbalā .. 6.116.41 ..
ājñaptā rāvaṇenaitā rākṣasyo māmatarjayan .hate tasminna kuryurhi tarjanaṃ vānarottama .. 6.116.42 ..
ayaṃ vyāghrasamīpe tu purāṇo dharmasaṃsthitaḥ .ṛkṣeṇa gītaḥ śloko me tannibodha plavaṅgama .. 6.116.43 ..
na paraḥ pāpamādatte pareṣāṃ pāpakarmaṇām .samayo rakṣitavyastu santaścāritrabhūṣaṇāḥ .. 6.116.44 ..
pāpānāṃ vā śubhānāṃ vā vadhārhāṇāṃ plavaṅgama .kāryaṃ karuṇamāryeṇa na kaścinnāparādhyati .. 6.116.45 ..
lokahiṃsāvihārāṇāṃ rakṣasāṃ kāmarūpiṇām .kurvatāmapi pāpāni naiva kāryamaśobhanam .. 6.116.46 ..
evamuktastu hanumān sītayā vākyakovidaḥ .pratyuvāca tataḥ sītāṃ rāmapatnīṃ yaśasvinīm .. 6.116.47 ..
yuktā rāmasya bhavatī dharmapatnī yaśasvinī .pratisandiśa māṃ devi gamiṣye yatra rāghavaḥ .. 6.116.48 ..
evamuktā hanumatā vaidehī janakātmajā .abravīddraṣṭumicchāmi bhartāraṃ vānarottama .. 6.116.49 ..
tasyāstadvanaṃ śrutvā hanumān mārutātmajaḥ .harṣayan maithilīṃ vākyamuvācedaṃ mahādyutiḥ .. 6.116.50 ..
pūrṇacandrānanaṃ rāmaṃ drakṣyasyārye salakṣmaṇam .sthiramitraṃ hatāmitraṃ śacīva tridaśeśvaram .. 6.116.51 ..
tāmevamuktvā rājantīṃ sītāṃ sākṣādiva śriyam .ājagāma mahāvego hanumān yatra rāghavaḥ .. 6.116.52 ..
ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe ṣoḍaśottaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ .. 116 ..
sa uvāca mahāprājñamabhigamya plavaṅgamaḥ .rāmaṃ vacanamarthajño varaṃ sarvadhanuṣmatām .. 6.117.1 ..
yannimitto 'yamārambhaḥ karmaṇāṃ ca phalodayaḥ .tāṃ devīṃ śokasantaptāṃ maithilīṃ draṣṭumarhasi .. 6.117.2 ..
sā hi śokasamāviṣṭā bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇā .maithilī vijayaṃ śrutvā tava harṣamupāgamat .. 6.117.3 ..
pūrvakāt pratyayāccāhamukto viśvastayā tayā .bhartāraṃ draṣṭumicchāmi kṛtārthaṃ sahalakṣmaṇam .. 6.117.4 ..
evamukto hanumatā rāmo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ .agacchat sahasā dhyānamīṣadbāṣpapariplutaḥ .. 6.117.5 ..
dīrghamuṣṇaṃ viniśvasya medinīmavalokayan .uvāca meghasaṅkāśaṃ vibhīṣaṇamupasthitam .. 6.117.6 ..
divyāṅgarāgāṃ vaidehīṃ divyābharaṇabhūṣitām .iha sītāṃ śirassnātāmupasthāpaya mā ciram .. 6.117.7 ..
evamuktastu rāmeṇa tvaramāṇo vibhīṣaṇaḥ .praviśyāntaḥpuraṃ sītāṃ svābhiḥ strībhiracodayat .. 6.117.8 ..
divyāṅgarāgā vaidehi divyābharaṇabhūṣitā .yānamāroha bhadraṃ te bhartā tvāṃ draṣṭumicchati .. 6.117.9 ..
evamuktā tu vedehī pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇam .asnātā draṣṭumicchāmi bhartāraṃ rākṣasādhipa .. 6.117.10 ..
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇaḥ .yadāha rājā bhartā te tattathā kartumarhasi .. 6.117.11 ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā maithilī bhartṛdevatā .bhartṛbhaktivratā sādhvī tatheti pratyabhāṣata .. 6.117.12 ..
tataḥ sītāṃ śirassnātāṃ yuvatībhiralaṅkṛtām .mahārhābharaṇopetāṃ mahārhāmbaradhāriṇīm .. 6.117.13 ..
āropya śibikāṃ dīptāṃ parārdhyāmbarasaṃvṛtām .rakṣobhirbahubhirguptāmājahāra vibhīṣaṇaḥ .. 6.117.14 ..
so 'bhigamya mahātmānaṃ jñātvā 'pi dhyānamāsthitam .praṇataśca prahṛṣṭaśca prāptaṃ sītāṃ nyavedayat .. 6.117.15 ..
tāmāgatāmupaśrutya rakṣogṛhaciroṣitām .harṣo dainyaṃ ca roṣaśca trayaṃ rāghavamāviśat .. 6.117.16 ..
tataḥ pārśvagataṃ dṛṣṭvā savimarśaṃ vicārayan .vibhīṣaṇamidaṃ vākyamahṛṣṭaṃ rāghavo 'bravīt .. 6.117.17 ..
rākṣasādhipate saumya nityaṃ madvijaye rata .vaidehī sannikarṣaṃ me śīghraṃ samupagacchatu .. 6.117.18 ..
sa tadvacanamājñāya rāghavasya vibhīṣaṇaḥ .tūrṇamutsāraṇe yatnaṃ kārayāmāsa sarvataḥ .. 6.117.19 ..
kañcukoṣṇīṣiṇastatra vetrajarjarapāṇayaḥ .utsārayantaḥ puruṣāḥ samantāt paricakramuḥ .. 6.117.20 ..
ṛkṣāṇāṃ vānarāṇāṃ ca rākṣasānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ .vṛndānyutsāryamāṇāni dūramutsasṛjustadā .. 6.117.21 ..
teṣāmutsāryamāṇānāṃ sarveṣāṃ dhvanirutthitaḥ .vāyunodvartamānasya sāgarasyeva nisvanaḥ .. 6.117.22 ..
utsāryamāṇāṃstān dṛṣṭvā samantājjātasambhramān .dākṣiṇyāttadamarṣācca vārayāmāsa rāghavaḥ .. 6.117.23 ..
saṃrabdhaścābravīdrāmaścakṣuṣā pradahanniva .vibhīṣaṇaṃ mahāprājñaṃ sopālambhamidaṃ vacaḥ .. 6.117.24 ..
kimarthaṃ māmanādṛtya kliśyate 'yaṃ tvayā janaḥ .nivartayainamudyogaṃ jano 'yaṃ svajano mama .. 6.117.25 ..
na gṛhāṇi na vastrāṇi na prākārāstiraskriyāḥ .nedṛśā rājasatkārā vṛttamāvaraṇaṃ striyāḥ .. 6.117.26 ..
vyasaneṣu na kṛcchreṣu na yuddheṣu svayaṃvare .na krutau na vivāhe ca darśanaṃ duṣyati striyāḥ .. 6.117.27 ..
saiṣā yuddhagatā caiva kṛcchre ca mahati sthitā .darśane 'syā na doṣaḥ syānmatsamīpe viśeṣataḥ .. 6.117.28 ..
tadānaya samīpaṃ me śīghramenāṃ vibhīṣaṇa .sītā paśyatu māmeṣā suhṛdgaṇavṛtaṃ sthitam .. 6.117.29 ..
evamuktastu rāmeṇa savimarśo vibhīṣaṇaḥ .rāmasyopānayat sītāṃ sannikarṣaṃ vinītavat .. 6.117.30 ..
tato lakṣmaṇasugrīvau hanumāṃśca plavaṅgamaḥ .niśamya vākyaṃ rāmasya babhūvurvyathitā bhṛśam .. 6.117.31 ..
kalatranirapekṣaiśca iṅgitairasya dāruṇaiḥ .aprītamiva sītāyāṃ tarkayanti sma rāghavam .. 6.117.32 ..
lajjayā tvavalīyantī sveṣu gātreṣu maithilī .vibhīṣaṇenānugatā bhartāraṃ sā 'bhyavartata .. 6.117.33 ..
sā vastrasaṃruddhamukhī lajjayā janasaṃsadi .rurodāsādya bhartāramāryaputreti bhāṣiṇī .. 6.117.34 ..
vismayācca praharṣācca snehācca patidevatā .udaikṣata mukhaṃ bhartuḥ saumyaṃ somyatarānanā .. 6.117.35 ..
atha samapanudanmanaḥklamaṃ sā suciramadṛṣṭamudīkṣya vai priyasya .vadanamuditapūrṇacandrakāntaṃ vimalaśaśāṅkanibhānanā tadānīm .. 6.117.36 ..
ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe saptadaśottaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ .. 117 ..
tāṃ tu pārśvasthitāṃ prahvāṃ rāmaḥ samprekṣya maithilīm .hṛdayāntargatakrodho vyāhartumupacakrame .. 6.118.1 ..
eṣā 'si nirjitā bhadre śatruṃ jitvā mayā raṇe .pauruṣādyadanuṣṭheyaṃ tadetadupapāditam .. 6.118.2 ..
gato 'smyantamamarṣasya dharṣaṇā sampramārjitā .avamānaśca śatruśca mayā yugapaduddhṛtau .. 6.118.3 ..
adya me pauruṣaṃ dṛṣṭamadya me saphalaḥ śramaḥ .adya tīrṇapratijñatvāt prabhavāmīha cātmanaḥ .. 6.118.4 ..
yā tvaṃ virahitā nītā calacittena rakṣasā .daivasampādito doṣo mānuṣeṇa mayā jitaḥ .. 6.118.5 ..
samprāptamavamānaṃ yastejasā na pramārjati .kastasya puruṣārtho 'sti puruṣasyālpatejasaḥ .. 6.118.6 ..
laṅghanaṃ ca samudrasya laṅkāyāścāvamardanam .saphalaṃ tasya tacchlādhyaṃ mahat karma hanūmataḥ .. 6.118.7 ..
yuddhe vikramataścaiva hitaṃ mantrayataśca me .sugrīvasya sasainyasya saphalo 'dya pariśramaḥ .. 6.118.8 ..
nirguṇaṃ bhrātaraṃ tyaktvā yo māṃ svayamupasthitaḥ .vibhīṣaṇasya bhaktasya saphalo 'dya pariśramaḥ .. 6.118.9 ..
ityevaṃ bruvatastasya sītā rāmasya tadvacaḥ .mṛgīvotphullanayanā babhūvāśrupariplutā .. 6.118.10 ..
paśyatastāṃ tu rāmasya bhūyaḥ krodho vyavardhata .prabhūtājyāvasiktsya pāvakasyeva dīpyataḥ .. 6.118.11 ..
sa baddhvā bhrukuṭīṃ vaktre tiryakprekṣitalocanaḥ .abravīt paruṣaṃ sītāṃ madhye vānararakṣasām .. 6.118.12 ..
yat kartavyaṃ manuṣyeṇa dharṣaṇāṃ parimārjatā .tat kṛtaṃ sakalaṃ sīte śatruhastādamarṣaṇāt .. 6.118.13 ..
nirjitā jīvalokasya tapasā bhāvitātmanā .agastyena durādharṣā muninā dakṣiṇeva dik .. 6.118.14 ..
viditaścāstu te bhadre yo 'yaṃ raṇapariśramaḥ .sa tīrṇaḥ suhṛdāṃ vīryānna tvadarthaṃ mayā kṛtaḥ .. 6.118.15 ..
rakṣatā tu mayā vṛttamapāvadaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ .prakhyātasyātmavaṃśasya nyaṅgaṃ ca parirakṣatā .. 6.118.16 ..
prāptacāritrasandehā mama pratimukhe sthitā .dīpo netrāturasyeva pratikūlā 'si me dṛḍham .. 6.118.17 ..
tadgaccha hyabhyanujñātā yatheṣṭaṃ janakātmaje .etā daśa diśo bhadre kāryamasti na me tvayā .. 6.118.18 ..
kaḥ pumān hi kule jātaḥ striyaṃ paragṛhoṣitām .tejasvī punarādadyāt suhṛllekhyena cetasā .. 6.118.19 ..
rāvaṇāṅkaparibhraṣṭāṃ dṛṣṭāṃ duṣṭena cakṣuṣā .kathaṃ tvāṃ punarādadyāṃ kulaṃ vyapadiśan mahat .. 6.118.20 ..
tadarthaṃ nirjitā me tvaṃ yaśaḥ pratyāhṛtaṃ mayā .nāsti me tvayyabhiṣvaṅgo yatheṣṭaṃ gamyatāmitaḥ .. 6.118.21 ..
iti pravyāhṛtaṃ bhadre mayaitat kṛtabuddhinā .lakṣmaṇe bharate vā tvaṃ kuru buddhiṃ yathāsukham .. 6.118.22 ..
sugrīve vānarendre vā rākṣasendre vibhīṣaṇe .niveśaya manaḥ sīte yathā vā sukhamātmanaḥ .. 6.118.23 ..
na hi tvāṃ rāvaṇo dṛṣṭvā divyarūpāṃ manoramām .marṣayeta ciraṃ sīte svagṛhe parivartinīm .. 6.118.24 ..
tataḥ priyārhaśravaṇā tadapriyaṃ priyādupaśrutya cirasya maithilī .mumoca bāṣpaṃ subhṛśaṃ pravepitā gajendrahastābhihateva sallakī .. 6.118.25 ..
ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe aṣṭādaśottaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ .. 118 ..
evamuktā tu vaidehī paruṣaṃ romaharṣaṇam .rāghaveṇa saroṣeṇa bhṛśaṃ pravyathitā 'bhavat .. 6.119.1 ..
sā tadaśrutapūrvaṃ hi jane mahati maithilī .śrutvā bhartṛvaco rūkṣaṃ lajjayā vrīḍitā 'bhavat .. 6.119.2 ..
praviśantīva gātrāṇi svānyeva janakātmajā .vākchalyaistaiḥ saśalyeva bhṛśamaśrūṇyavartayat .. 6.119.3 ..
tato bāṣpaparikliṣṭaṃ pramārjantī svamānanam .śanairgadgadayā vācā bhartāramidamabravīt .. 6.119.4 ..
kiṃ māmasadṛśaṃ vākyamīdṛśaṃ śrotradāruṇam .rūkṣaṃ śrāvayase vīra prākṛtaḥ prākṛtāmiva .. 6.119.5 ..
na tathā 'smi mahābāho yathā tvamavagacchasi .pratyayaṃ gaccha me yena cāritreṇaiva te śape .. 6.119.6 ..
pṛthakstrīṇāṃ pracāreṇa jātiṃ tāṃ pariśaṅkase .parityajemāṃ śaṅkāṃ tu yadi te 'haṃ parīkṣitā .. 6.119.7 ..
yadyahaṃ gātrasaṃsparśaṃ gatā 'smi vivaśā prabho .kāmakāro na me tatra daivaṃ tatrāparādhyati .. 6.119.8 ..
madadhīnaṃ tu yattanme hṛdayaṃ tvayi vartate .parādhīneṣu gātreṣu kiṃ kariṣyāmyanīśvarā .. 6.119.9 ..
sahasaṃvṛddhabhāvācca saṃsargeṇa ca mānada .yadyahaṃ te na vijñātā hatā tenāsmi śāśvatam .. 6.119.10 ..
preṣitaste yadā vīro hanumānavalokakaḥ .laṅkāsthā 'haṃ tvayā vīra kiṃ tadā na visarjitā .. 6.119.11 ..
pratyakṣaṃ vānarendrasya tadvākyasamanantaram .tvayā santyaktayā vīra tyaktaṃ syājjīvitaṃ mayā .. 6.119.12 ..
na vṛthā te śramo 'yaṃ syāt saṃśaye nyasya jīvitam .suhṛjjanaparikleśo na cāyaṃ niṣphalastava .. 6.119.13 ..
tvayā tu naraśārdūla krodhamevānuvartatā .laghuneva manuṣyeṇa strītvameva puraskṛtam .. 6.119.14 ..
apadeśena janakānnotpattirvasudhātalāt .mama vṛttaṃ ca vṛttajña bahu te na puraskṛtam .. 6.119.15 ..
na pramāṇīkṛtaḥ pāṇirbālye bālena pīḍitaḥ .mama bhaktiśca śīlaṃ ca sarvaṃ te pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtam .. 6.119.16 ..
evaṃ bruvāṇā rudatī bāṣpagadgadabhāṣiṇī .abravīllakṣmaṇaṃ sītā dīnaṃ dhyānaparaṃ sthitam .. 6.119.17 ..
citāṃ me kuru saumitre vyasanasyāsya bheṣajam .mithyopaghātopahatā nāhaṃ jīvitumutsahe .. 6.119.18 ..
aprītasya guṇairbhartustyaktāyā janasaṃsadi .yā kṣamā me gatirgantuṃ pravekṣye havyavāhanam .. 6.119.19 ..
evamuktastu vaidehyā lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā .amarṣavaśamāpanno rāghavānanamaikṣata .. 6.119.20 ..
sa vijñāya tataśchandaṃ rāmasyākārasūcitam .citāṃ cakāra saumitrirmate rāmasya vīryavān .. 6.119.21 ..
adhomukhaṃ tadā rāmaṃ śanaiḥ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam .upāsarpata vaidehī dīpyamānaṃ hutāśanam .. 6.119.22 ..
praṇamya devatābhyaśca brāhmaṇebhyaśca maithilī .baddhāñjalipuṭā cedamuvācāgnisamīpataḥ .. 6.119.23 ..
yathā me hṛdayaṃ nityaṃ nāpasarpati rāghavāt .tathā lokasya sākṣī māṃ sarvataḥ pātu pāvakaḥ .. 6.119.24 ..
yathā māṃ śuddhacāritrāṃ duṣṭāṃ jānāti rāghavaḥ .tathā lokasya sākṣī māṃ sarvataḥ pātu pāvakaḥ .. 6.119.25 ..
